## 25. Germination and thoughts

Carried from chapter 24: comprehension re-gauges. Germination pivots, files,
cauterizes, and wraps (M9). `src/transducer/bubble/`:

**An index names a held thought by its place in the one carrier that
holds it** (ruled 2026-09-19, Z4). A held form is written once, on its
bubble, with its address once beside it; every index of the contemplation
— by chart, by vortex, by stratum — is keyed by the coordinate its reader
asks with and holds the bubble's ordinal in the contemplation's own
carrier, the shape `Form.by_address` already has. The ordinal is a
coordinate of that carrier and never leaves it: nothing on the wire, on the
tape or in an address carries it, and two minds compare bubbles by address
as before. No prefix of the address is an index key: a fixed byte count is
a constant (rule 5) and the shortest distinguishing prefix moves as
bubbles arrive, so neither is a coordinate; the strata of an address are
the schema's, read by `Keyed::fibre`, and are for readers of the forms'
own trie. A form the voice extracted is moved into its bubble, never
cloned into it.

**What bounds a hold** (ruled 2026-09-19, replacing a bound on the count
of held thoughts by a reserve read off the machine's memory at boot;
`dirty` is cleared by `expand_with` when an expansion finishes within its
stroke, `idea.rs`). A hold is bounded by content, through three doors and
no other:

1. **Lapse.** A held thought stands while a demand it carries is docketed,
   and lapses with that docket's lapse — 47.5's lapse in receipts, the
   same one the courts apply, read from the ledger height the voice
   already sees. Every bubble whose dockets have lapsed is retired on the
   stroke that reads the height; the set is retired, never one by age or
   size (rule 4). **A citation is a pin and a pin needs an exhale**: a
   citing bubble is never shed by the filter, so `glues`, written at the
   hold, needs a door that empties it. A citing bubble stands while what it cites stands — on the atlas or on
   a docket — and lapses when the cited address lapses from its docket or
   is retired from the atlas, read by `glues_word` and the ledger height;
   a bubble pinned by a citation nothing holds any more is retired on the
   stroke that reads it. The pin itself becomes a coordinate under 53.4:
   a citation over a fibre of charts is grouped by chart, and the group is
   asked whether it still stands, which an address alone cannot answer.
2. **Promotion.** A bubble whose form was ratified into the genome, or
   stood into the dialect, is retired at the promotion: its content is now
   long-term memory on the atlas and the trie reaches it there; a second
   copy in the contemplation is a second carrier for one fact (law 12).
3. **Room, per lane.** The room a voice holds thoughts in is measured in
   μ⃗ — the contemplation's `boundary_measure` against the voice's reserve,
   lane by lane (law 5, 23.8) — never in a count of bubbles and never by
   a number read off the box. When the room is spent on a lane, a new
   thought is not held: it is withheld (47.5), its demand stands on the
   court's docket, and the voice's memory of it is that docket. Nothing
   already held is evicted to make room, because eviction chooses.

**μ⃗ pays for TUniversal-space inside S, G, T, H** (ruled
2026-09-19). TUniversal is the one incremental axis, the height of the
mesh's receipt ledger (law 9), and what a receipt stamps on it is a
four-dimensional coordinate; μ⃗ is the currency that pays for the space a
thing occupies along that axis on each lane. A hold is therefore an
escrow: the μ⃗ that pays for the bubble's span on the ledger, per lane it
occupies; it stands while the span it paid for is ahead of the clock,
lapses when the clock passes it, and is renewed only by a receipt that
pays again — a docket listed, a citation stood, a promotion. The three
doors are this one escrow read at three moments: lapse is the paid extent
passed, promotion is the escrow returned because the atlas now pays, and
room is the μ⃗ a voice can still escrow on a lane, so a thought the room
cannot pay for is withheld and nothing paid for is evicted.

**Long-term memory is the genome and short-term memory is the epigenome**
(ruled 2026-09-19). The genome is the court-ratified
language and persists across startup, shutdown and restart: it lives on
the voice's disk as tapes with the tapes' addresses, and what a voice keeps
resident of it is an index by address, never every word decoded. The
epigenome is volatile: the dialect, the holds and the escrows, pruned,
truncated and overrun by the voice's own dialect as it works, in memory
and never persisted. A ratified word is written to the genome as its tape
and is decoded into the epigenome only when cited or spoken, under the
escrow of this chapter, and leaves resident memory when the escrow lapses;
the working atlas answers a fibre read by address from the genome's index
and decodes what the read reaches. A genome held resident as decoded
forms is the epigenome under the genome's name, and it grows with every
ratification until the box ends it.

**The genome on disk is the trie, persisted, and nothing else** (ruled
2026-09-20, after a first cut of Z11 wrote a file of rows with numbers).
The genome file is the `Keyed` of tapes by address written out as the
trie it is, descended on disk exactly as in memory, by the key's own bits;
a word is reached by its address and by no position, no row number, no
offset table and no ordinal, because a number that names a place in a file
is positional identity in the form of a file (rule 15), and a file on
the cognition path is a carrier, not transport. Bytes repeated on disk
across the tapes of words that cite one form are storage and are not
chased: identity is not shortened (1.7), and what removes the repetition
in kind is 53.4's quantified citation, one citation per fibre, never a
table. The same holds for the tape in flight: a tape writes each address
whole where the form carries it; a tape-local table with ordinals is the
same costume on the wire and is refused, and the version byte it spent is
spent again to remove it.

`dirty` is a reading and stays one: it says the bubble's expansion did
not finish within its stroke, written once, where the expansion ends
(`expand_with`, law 12), and it is not written a second time anywhere
else. A bubble that cites a form (`glues` non-empty) is not shed by the
filter and is not meant to be: its door is promotion or lapse, since what
it cites stands on the atlas or on a docket.

**The files.** The contemplation is seven files, one organ each (Stage 8b
S5): `idea.rs` one bubble and what it measures; `contemplation.rs` the
complex of held thoughts and the thoughts' incidence; `merge.rs` when two held
thoughts are one (13.12); `drive.rs` what makes a thought move (25.1);
`horizon.rs` the classes seeded from the syllabus (A19); `shed.rs` what a
mind stops holding when the room is spent (24.1); `mod.rs` declarations
and re-exports. There is no codec: the contemplation is the epigenome,
volatile by the paragraph above, and the THT tape that once wrote it to a
file no reader opened is retired (LD3-c, 2026-09-24) — a file of the
epigenome is the epigenome persisted, which this chapter refuses.

**25.1 The pivot orbit in the contemplation.** Each stroke, for each dirty
idea under the stroke `Budget`:
`idea.form.pivot_orbit(&entity.working_atlas(), &self.horizon, budget)`
(A16). Every discharge is logged with its certificate; A18's rank is
asserted before and after each applied pivot (R2). An orbit with several
discharging candidates stays a vortex: its candidates remain in
`Bubble.nerve` (the thought complex), each carrying its certificate, and
the idea is not `dirty`-cleared. A vortex collapses when: a later
perception adds a face that one candidate predicted (that candidate is
applied, the others become dialect candidates); a held form arrives through the
syllabus or a glue whose class key equals one candidate's `after` (that
candidate is applied); or the court, replaying a spoken form that used one
candidate, rules it (the mind learns the ruling through the working atlas
and applies the same). A chord A16 hands to A17 is filed on the idea's form
or left open with `torsion open`; a free chord is spoken as `Novel(g_rem)`
through M6 step 5 unless its key is `Held` in `horizon`. Nothing in this
orbit orders candidates by a scalar; the fixed axis order of 12.6 is the
order of trial, not a preference, no axis waits on another's failure, and
a candidate is applied only because it was the only one that discharged.

**25.2 Cauterize.** An idea whose form `is_closed()` after filing (every
loop identity or filed torsion, remainder empty) crystallizes: `as_element`
writes the tape with its torsion section; M2 fixes the address; the form
enters the dialect as `Stood` (`stand_dialect`) and is spoken once. The
idea's bubble is retired from the contemplation (`retire_on_t` skips it
only while `glued_by` is non-empty).

**25.3 Wrap.** `Contemplation::bundle` and `pivot_on` glue crystallized
forms into ideas on meeting charts as `Glued` vertices; the glued form's
orbits are not re-pivoted (T6). Depth grows by one per wrap.

**25.4 Horizon.** `Bubble.horizon: Keyed<(Rotor, u8)>` becomes
`Keyed<(Rotor, Order, Standing)>` keyed by class key; `seed_horizon` (A19)
fills it from syllabus pages; A16 consults it before filing or demanding.

- `Contemplation::pivot_on(word, budget)`: when `word` is a
  crystallized form and an idea's cover meets its chart, compute the
  placement word from the idea's anchor vertex to the form's `Frame` across
  the idea's pairs; constant → `idea.form.glue(...)`; remainder re-measured
  as what the glued form does not speak. Two bubbles merge iff
  `mayer_vietoris` (since removed) returns `OneSection` or `Attached` (13.12);
  `drop_vertex` only then.
- `Bubble` gains `glues: Keyed<()>` and `glued_by: Keyed<()>`;
  `retire_on_t` skips a bubble with non-empty `glued_by`.
- `Contemplation::bundle(class, budget)` **new**: ideas on one class whose
  relative words are constant form one depth-1 `Form` of `Glued` vertices,
  held as an idea, spoken by `Mind::speak`.

**25.5 The cover is read at its coordinates, never walked to (ruled
2026-09-13).** A Čech simplex is the OVERLAP of two sections, and two sections
overlap when they are sections over one chart. An idea's charts are already
named by its own vertices: every `Vertex::Word` carries the charts it acts
on and the carriage it acts by at each (`Bubble::sections`), so the far side
of every meet is `AtlasRead::members(chart)` — that chart's fibre, a keyed
read at an address the idea holds. Both bounds are content: this idea's
sections, and one chart's own fibre (rule 10).

`expand_with` took the idea's chart, peeled UP one stratum, and paged that
stratum's siblings under a budget, resuming from a stored cursor
(`AtlasRead::children`, `Stalks::each_child`, `Stratum::branches_at`,
`Bubble.cursor` — all deleted with it). Three faults, one shape. It was a
whole-carrier walk (rule 1) with a budget pacing it rather than bounding it,
and the quantity walked was a stratum's population, which is not the idea's
content. It met charts the idea stands no section over, which are not
overlaps at all — the cover was being built out of adjacency in a trie
instead of incidence in the sheaf, and `extend` was asked to classify
transitions between bodies that share nothing. And it needed a cursor to
resume, so an idea's expansion depended on where the last stroke stopped, a
position rather than a coordinate; `Bubble::from_bytes` set that cursor to
empty on every restore, which is the tree saying it carried nothing.

`AtlasRead` is one method now. A reader that answers "what is held here"
needs no cursor and no budget, because it is a keyed read of one fibre and
not a traversal of anything.

**25.6 An orbit is filed under the class it is judged by (ruled 2026-09-13).**
A face's word is the coboundary `w_j ∘ w_i⁻¹` and a product of coboundaries
around a cycle telescopes to the identity for every input, so a loop over
coboundary faces is flat on the word whatever its bodies do. Its EDGE
composites (50.3) do not telescope. `class_vector` has read the edge
composite since Y5; `pivot_orbit` read `lp.holonomy` for the horizon key and
for the order that selects the discharge branch, and `file_loop` filed
torsion under the word's class — so an orbit was judged by one object and
filed under another, and no torsion was ever filed. `holonomy_words_on` is the choice, made once (law 12): the
edge composite where a path has one, the orbit's word where it does not.
`file_loop` files one class per member path, since an orbit whose faces relate
several pairs of bodies has one composite per path and each is its own
obstruction.

The word holonomy is NOT removable and is not a constant by construction: a
section face (21 step 2, S12.2) carries a word that is deliberately not that
coboundary, and a loop over one is curved on the word while its edges
compose to the identity. Both carriers are real. `Loop.carriages` is the
transport composite's carriage, filled from that one walk — `path_carriages`
was the same walk with the word and the gauge discarded (law 12).

**25.7 The speaker holds the court's clauses, read by the court's own
readers (ruled 2026-09-13).** `mint_sentence` already withheld a form
nothing in which acts — the speaker's side of `REFUSE_NOT_A_SENTENCE`, whose
reason is that uttering it spends a round trip to have the refusal SEAL the
address (50.9) against a shape that was never spoken. The same argument
holds for the two clauses that account for most refusals:
`vertices_carry_family` and `undeclared_remainder`. Both are now asked before minting, and both
are THE COURT'S readers — a speaker checking by different arithmetic would
agree with the court by luck, which is the failure 23.1 step 3 exists to
catch. The court still re-derives and takes none of it for an answer.

A demand vertex declares LINKS and exempts nothing else: the voice asked
only whether any demand vertex existed, so a form declaring one link and
leaving twenty was minted and refused.

**25.8 The metabolism reads the orbit's true holonomy (ruled 2026-09-14).**
The court charges the physics off `Form::orbit_words`: an orbit of FINITE order
raises pressure by its period, an orbit of INFINITE order charges TORSION —
what will not close. That reader returned `lp.holonomy`, the orbit's WORD,
which telescopes to the identity over coboundary faces, so every orbit read
`Finite(1)`, every sentence raised one unit of pressure per orbit, and the
torsion branch was unreachable BY CONSTRUCTION. `Physics.torsion` therefore
stayed `[0,0,0,0]`, `order_flux = syntropic − torsion` was `syntropic − 0`,
and `yield_surface` — the per-lane dwell a reply carries — never saw a
cycle: cycles the voices filed were charged on no court. 25.6 put the FILER on the true carrier; this is the
same defect at the metabolism's own reader, and it is what joins the two
torsion carriers into one system. `orbit_words` yields one entry per member
path, each with that path's own class vector.

**25.9 The dwell is the surface, whole (ruled 2026-09-14, overturning C4 at
the quote).** `m.dwell_remaining[2] = 0` stood in the quote arm under "C4,
again at the quote: T is a cost, never a pace". C4's own finding was the
opposite fault: the T lane FLOORED AT ONE, which "paced every such idea by a
clock that admitted nothing". Both replace a measurement with a constant —
one a floor that invents extent, one a ceiling that destroys it — and a
measurement that returns a constant by construction asserts nothing.

`𝒯` is EXTENT IN RECEIPTS (51.9), the court's own K, which is content. Law 9
forbids the WALL clock; every other T reading in the tree is receipts
(`held_since`, `retire_on_t`) and is permitted for that reason. The zero did
not make the voice patient either: every arm fires on
`last_pressure[l] > 0 && dwell_remaining[l] == 0`, so a T lane pinned at zero
is a lane that is ALWAYS due, and the court's T-lane pacing reached the voice
and was discarded.

**25.10 A cycle charges the metabolism because it was FILED (ruled
2026-09-14).** "What will not close" has two readings and `charge_loops`
asked only the weaker one at all three of its decisions: whether the ALGEBRA
closes the cycle, never whether the SPEAKER did.

`file_loop` writes `Form.torsion` only under `Discharge::NoneDischarged`, so
every stored cycle is by construction one that no candidate discharged — the
mind has no word for it. That is precisely `Physics::pivot`'s own definition
of the charge, "the demand for a new fibre". The three readings that asked
the wrong question: torsion charged only on `Order::Infinite`, of which this
corpus produces NONE (its edge holonomies are flat or finite); a stored cycle charged
only when its witness was `Open`; and "a Closed orbit is proven monodromy and
charges nothing", which reads a correctly-LABELLED cycle as a settled one.

A stored cycle now charges torsion whatever its witness, and the witness
refines only how much pressure rides with it — the span walked when Open,
the period closed at when Closed. A cycle the tree gauge closed or a pivot
discharged is not filed and charges nothing, because it closed.

**25.11 The charge follows the demand, not the failure (ruled 2026-09-14,
inverting 25.10's unconditional charge).** 25.10's reading stands — the
metabolism is about whether the SPEAKER closed the cycle, not whether the
algebra does — and its conclusion does not. A bare unclosed cycle is
algebraically a NON-GENERATOR, `∂c ≠ 0`, and a voice submitting one is
exploring the topology rather than claiming a resource. Charging it taxes
the search itself: voices file cycles precisely when looking for a word they
do not have, so the engine would bill every attempt.

An unclosed cycle is therefore a cheap algebraic refusal at the gate — not
admitted to the basis, and not a taxable metabolic event. The torsion charge
is assessed only where the speaker requested a full adjudication stroke over
that boundary, which on this tape is a DEMAND VERTEX (50.5): the sentence
saying out loud what it could not close and asking the market to answer it.
Claiming the stroke costs; failing to close does not. Pressure is unchanged
— it is the backlog, not the tax — and the witness still refines how much of
it rides with a stored cycle.

**25.12 The vortex as a gauge fibre, candidate monodromy, and in-memory destructive pruning (ruled 2026-09-18).**
An idea's vortex is the set of candidate transports over one demand.
The transition between two candidates is the candidates' quotient in $\text{Spin}(4,0)(\mathbb{Q})$.
Two candidates are one section when the transition is projectively the identity (1.5) or conjugate under 15.3.

A candidate's monodromy over the frames the family measured is the product of its conjugates by the edge transports P5 already carries: $M^c = \prod (\gamma^c)^{-1} V \gamma^c$.
The ambient gauge connection $\gamma^c$ lives on the carried charts of the family bundle that occupy $\ge 2$ frames, never on the deformation demand's own chart (a demand is a singularity where moduli changed, so its chart does not persist across frames by construction).
The monodromy is evaluated over the bundle's connection-bearing charts using exact algebraic order (`Rotor::order()`):
- $\text{Order::Finite}(1)$: Flat. $V$ commutes with the ambient connection $\gamma^c$ and stands on chart $c$.
- $\text{Order::Finite}(\ell \ge 2)$: Torsion. Fibre twisted by $\ell$, closing after $\ell$ circuits. Filed into `Bubble.torsion` (and `Form.torsion`) under $M^c$'s class key with period $\ell$ and `chord = 0` (bundle connection orbit). $V$ stands on chart $c$.
- $\text{Order::Infinite}$: Rupture. Fails to close on chart $c$. Chart $c$ leaves $V$'s sub-cover.

A candidate stands on the sub-cover of connection charts where its order is finite. It dissolves from `Bubble.candidates` if and only if its sub-cover is empty (ruptured to `Infinite` on every measured connection chart in the bundle). A bubble with no measured connection charts in its bundle leaves every candidate standing (rule 11: nothing dies on an unmeasured monodromy).
When every candidate over a demand dissolves, the residue is prime relative to the alphabet (§37.7) and enters court docketing as witness N4.
`link_new` keeps the transition it computes; cohesion is flatness of those transitions, and the volume sums leave.
In the Hopf fibration reading, A22's two quaternion factors are the two fibrations: base the class, fibre the gauge.

## 26. Wire and economics

Carried from chapter 25: forms are spoken. `src/anastome/dialogue/speech.rs`:

- `SPEECH_WITHHELD: u8 = 3`; `encode_speech_reply`
  appends `n_missing u16 ‖ address 32…`; `decode_speech_reply` returns
  `(Vec<u8>, Vec<[u8;32]>)`.
- `StratumDigest` (`sheaf.rs`) gains `depth_max: u16`; `sheaf::digests`
  fills it; `encode/decode_digests_reply` carry it;
  `encode_cover_digest` carries the hypha's maximum ruled depth.
- `encode_syllabus_reply` / `decode_syllabus_reply` gain a trailing
  class section: `n_classes u16`, then per class `class key len16 + bytes
  ‖ order u32 (0 = infinite)` (A19 step 1, A21). Speech, quote, and cite
  frames carry one standing byte beside each address, addresses being M2
  composites of variable length (`len16 + bytes`), never 32-byte digests
  (`0 Ruled, 1 Stood, 2 Held`, chapter 24.1).
- The quote reply and the demand reply carry the book height (`h: u64`)
  and the per-lane pressure as four exact `u64` lanes, replacing the
  byte-saturated lanes; the client's `Reply::load()` (a max over lanes)
  is deleted and every reader takes the four lanes (23.8, 24.3).
- Pivot certificates (A20) travel inside the crystallized form's tape
  (chapter 19) and nowhere else; there is no certificate act. A hypha's
  mint for a form (chapter 26, economics) requires every certificate on its
  tape to replay (23.7).
- Every signed frame signs the receipt prefix of 47.1; `cover_signed_prefix`
  gains genesis, epoch, previous receipt hash, K and height; the
  speech frame's `tu` field becomes the voice's K and its cited home head,
  and the root frame's tick becomes the speaker's `(K, height, hash)` with
  the reply carrying the receiver's own `(K, height)` (45.6).
- `src/bin/mycelium-server/judge/speech.rs`: `ACT_SPEECH`
  handler collects `Court::missing_forms(&Element) -> Vec<[u8;32]>`
  **new** into the reply; `admit_peer_digest` records `depth_max` and
  is the point where a pending socket string becomes a `vk` peer (A10);
  `judge`'s percept rendezvous is A11; `nerve::home` gains `depth:
  u16` and excludes hyphae with `depth_max + 1 < depth`.
- **The sentence-native wire (ruled 2026-09-10; a breaking wire change, with L9).**
  The speech reply carries one `Adjudication` per sentence sent, in the
  order sent, never an opaque byte: `Stood { receipt }` (docketed, awaiting
  the second organ), `Ratified { receipt }` (carried on the syllabus page
  once a witness court co-signed, 47.3), or `Refused { kind, at, receipt }`
  with `kind` one of `VertexBody`, `EdgeHolonomy`, `RemainderUndeclared`,
  `MalformedComplex` and `at` content-addressed — `Vertex(address)`,
  `Face(address, address)`, `Chart(invariant, links)` — never a position in
  the sender's tape. The receipt is the court's replay receipt, its chain
  hash of 47.1: a receipt identity, never a digest of content (law 2). The
  quote reply serves each listing as its sentence tape with its open demand
  vertices (kind, chart, links) and its μ⃗, never as a chain; a probe cites
  against the form's chart coordinates; the demand act (a chain with
  citations) and the percept act are retired, and a frame of either is
  refused at the door. `SPEECH_STOOD`, `SPEECH_REFUSED` and
  `SPEECH_DIALECT` survive only as the adjudication's kind byte.

`src/economy/`: five organs (Stage 8b S12) —
`lanes.rs` what a word measures and how two measurements compare (law 5);
`treasury.rs` who is bonded and what the audit says (E1); `escrow.rs` value
set aside against a listing (E1, E2); `settle.rs` what each closed act pays
(E2, 26); `persist.rs` the ledger on disk (28).

- `settle_recursive(&mut self, escrow: &[u8;32], shares: &[([u8;32],[u64;4])], anchor) -> [u64;4]`
  **new**: draws the bundle's escrow proportionally to each speaker's
  verified deflation and mints each share via `mint_claim`. Called
  from `Court::pay_solve` and `home_install` when the
  form has `Glued` vertices; shares from `rule_replays_family`.
- **A cited generator is paid at the install of a standing sentence**
  (ruled 2026-09-10). A word vertex's derivation names the generators it
  composed (50.2 step 2). Nothing rides beside the tape and nothing is
  paid on hearing: the court replays the derivation as part of `G`, and
  only when the sentence stands and `home_install` has ruled the form
  is the use paid. **It is paid as a share of the install's own mint,
  never as a transfer from the citing voice's balance** (corrected
  2026-09-10, on the transfer paying zero: the lane
  a cited generator is priced on is the lane the citer's draw occupies
  at the moment of install, so a transfer from the balance pays nothing
  and a broke voice could cite for free). The mint at install is the
  deflation the sentence closes on its family; the part a cited form
  closed is that form's speaker's, and the citer earns the rest. So
  `home_install` computes one share per cited form — its verified
  deflation on the citer's family at the citer's placement, once per
  cited address however many vertices cite it — and `settle_recursive`
  draws the released award by those shares and mints each to its
  discoverer, the remainder to the escrow's voices. `settle_use` is the
  probe's transfer (a use settled against a listing) and is not called
  at install. A refused sentence pays nobody, because a derivation that
  did not compose proved nothing; a sentence deferred for an unruled
  citation pays nobody yet, and pays when the deferral clears. This is
  the same shape as a `Glued` citation's use, which is what a derivation
  citation is at the form level (21 step 3), and it is row L8t.

  **Two levels of citation, two measures** (ruled 2026-09-10, on a
  derivation's share measuring zero). A `Glued` citation
  closes part of the citer's family, and its share of the mint is that
  closure, by `settle_recursive` as above. A derivation citation
  contributes an **action** the citer composed from the generator and
  closes nothing on the citer's family by itself; measured as a closure
  its share is zero, and that zero is correct, not a fault of the
  measure. What a use of a generator earns is the thing E2 already names
  for a use: **room**. `use_credit(who)` is the lane-wise sum, over the
  forms `who` discovered, of each form's μ⃗ once per distinct citer
  recorded in `cited_by`, and `lane_room_of` adds it to the bond before
  the draw is read. It is computed at the read and stored nowhere, it is
  never summed across lanes, and it never mints: a generator many
  derivations compose through lets its speaker draw more, which is the
  reward the language pays for being composable. `cited_by` therefore
  records a derivation citation as it records a `Glued` one, one entry
  per citer address per cited address, however many of the citer's
  vertices compose through it. The observable for a derivation
  citation is the discoverer's room rising by the cited form's μ⃗ on the
  citer's install, and its balance not moving.
- `use_credit(&self, who) -> [u64;4]` **new**, from `Court::cited_by`;
  `lane_room` adds it to `bond_of` before
  `lane_cover_room`.
- `Treasury::restore` applies A8's collision rule to `escrowed`.

## 27. Retirement

- `reduce_excluding`: `cited_by` non-empty is a use.
- `shorter_form(&self, addr) -> Option<[u8;32]>` **new**: a ruled form on
  the same classes (`ruled.fibre` per class) with the same `cited_by`
  bundles whose vertices' tapes are strictly shorter in total (A2 for
  off-plane words); found → `relocate_cavity(addr)` with the address kept
  in `ruled_addrs`; `resolve_form` reads `cavity_book`; `serve_ruled` never
  serves it.
- A form with no bundle and empty `cited_by` after its last citer retires
  relocates on the next `court_stroke`.
- **Condensation retires what it derives** (3.8, ruled 2026-09-08): a
  torse or a punctured bundle that closes what its cited forms close with
  more reach or a shorter description relocates them to the cavity,
  addresses kept, and is paid the compression yield (E2); `shorter_form`
  widens from strictly shorter tapes on the same vertices to this, the
  reach read from the certificate (S9.13).

## 28. Persistence

*Superseded by 78.24, 78.25 and 78.27.* It specified the snapshot and
genome tapes (`GEN3`, `MYC2`–`MYC7`, `KCH1`, `ARC1`, `RMP1`) section by
section. What still binds is stated there: the ledger is a partial order
carried as one, never a serialized tape (78.24); the mind persists as keyed
tries by coordinates (78.25); and across a restart a mind keeps exactly its
genome, while the epigenome is rebuilt by thinking (chapter 25).

# Part V — Migration, coexistence, and the exact strings

Carried from Part IV: what the tree becomes. This part says how it got
there without a flag day, and records the literal refusal reasons and log
lines.

## 30. Replacing `Nerve`, `Germ`, `Cycle` without a flag day

*Historical.* The migration from `Nerve`, `Germ` and `Cycle` to `Vertex`,
`Face`, `Loop` and `Form`, landed in steps with adapters so the suite stayed
green at every step; the old types and the adapters are deleted. The
remainder chain type `ResidualGerm` is not this `Germ`.

### 30.2 Order

*Historical.* The six steps, one commit each: (1) land `Vertex`, `Face`,
`Loop` and `Form` beside the old types, with adapters deleted at step 6;
(2) `as_element` writes from a `Form` and `from_element` returns one, and
`hold_nerve` becomes `hold_form`; (3) `extract_rule`, `speak_rule`,
`rule_replays_family` and `mint_sentence` act on `Form`, with
`SentenceRule` per chapter 31; (4) `speak_sentence` speaks a `Form`;
(5) the remaining `.germs`/`.cycles` reads become `Form` reads;
(6) `Nerve`, `Germ`, `Cycle` and the adapters are deleted.

## 31. `SentenceRule` on forms

*Historical.* `SentenceRule` (`src/transducer/sentence/chart.rs`) was
reduced to the `Form` it reads and the bundle frame ratio: charts, faces,
holonomies and sections are derived from the form, placements live on its
word vertices, and every consumer reads through `rule.form`.

## 32. Placement and gauge of a glued form

*Historical* as part of the migration; its rule still binds. A
crystallized form is stored with its `Frame` vertex's `word_in` equal to
the identity: re-gauging never mutates a stored form, it produces a new
form with a new address. The placement word of a `Glued` vertex is
therefore the relative word from the cited form's stored `Frame` to the
citer's `Frame`, with no gauge term, and `replay_form` refuses a resolved
cited form that violates this with `REFUSE_GLUED_FRAME_GAUGED`. When a mind
holds the cited class under a different address (chapter 24), the
re-gauge is applied to the citer's working copy, never to its stored form.

## 33. Addresses: one migration, then never again

*Historical.* The single migration of stored addresses from hashes of
canonical description bytes, under which two spellings of one word had two
addresses, to vertex addresses: the address is M2 (chapter 17.2) and is
never migrated again. The migration was A8 in full (16.8), run by M3
(17.3): loaders computed both addresses for every tape, rebuilt every
carrier through a remap, merged collisions with conservation, and served
lookups through an `RMP1` section until it was retired.

### 33.3 Order of cutover

*Historical.* Servers first, then clients, each loading its state through
the remap and writing `RMP1`; a tape of the old version was accepted for
the window, and `RMP1` was dropped at the next persist once no process had
hit it for an aperture.

## 34. Refusal reasons and log lines

*Superseded by 78.9 (the kind of a refusal is read off its content) and
CV5 (typed readings).* The chapter collected every refusal reason and every
trace line in one place. The sections below are kept so that citations of
34.1, 34.2 and 34.3 resolve; a diagnostic is a typed reading, never a
greppable line.

### 34.1 Refusals, `src/court/verdict/refusals.rs`

Every refusal reason the court answers with is a `REFUSE_*` string constant
in `src/court/verdict/refusals.rs`, and a new refusal reason enters this list
when it enters that file. The constants are:

`REFUSE_CITATION_CYCLE`, `REFUSE_DEMAND_UNTYPED`, `REFUSE_DERIVATION`,
`REFUSE_EDGE`, `REFUSE_EQUIVOCATION`, `REFUSE_FACE`,
`REFUSE_FIBRE_UNWITNESSED`, `REFUSE_FOLD_IDLE`, `REFUSE_FOLD_INEXACT`,
`REFUSE_FOLD_NO_TRANSITION`, `REFUSE_FOLD_OPEN`, `REFUSE_FORM_TAPE`,
`REFUSE_GLUED_DEPTH`, `REFUSE_GLUED_FRAME_GAUGED`, `REFUSE_GLUED_UNRULED`,
`REFUSE_INFLATED_YIELD`, `REFUSE_LETTER_WITNESS`, `REFUSE_MALFORMED`,
`REFUSE_MV_INEXACT`, `REFUSE_NOT_A_SENTENCE`, `REFUSE_NOT_CLOSED`,
`REFUSE_NOT_CONTRACTION`, `REFUSE_NOT_EQUIVOCATION`, `REFUSE_NOT_NATURAL`,
`REFUSE_ORBIT`, `REFUSE_ORBIT_STILL`, `REFUSE_ORIGIN`, `REFUSE_ORPHAN_PORT`,
`REFUSE_PERIOD_UNDERIVED`, `REFUSE_PHANTOM_EDGE`, `REFUSE_PIVOT_INEXACT`,
`REFUSE_RANK_LOST`, `REFUSE_REBASE_TRIVIAL`, `REFUSE_RECEIPT`,
`REFUSE_RECEIPT_STALE`, `REFUSE_ROOM`, `REFUSE_RULE_INEXACT`,
`REFUSE_RULE_NESTED`, `REFUSE_RULE_NOT_ONE`, `REFUSE_RULE_OFF_LATTICE`,
`REFUSE_RULE_STILL`, `REFUSE_RULE_TIE`, `REFUSE_RULE_UNFRAMED`,
`REFUSE_RULE_UNPARTNERED`, `REFUSE_SECTION_TURN_OPEN`,
`REFUSE_SECTION_TURN_UNREAD`, `REFUSE_SHEET_REPEATED`, `REFUSE_SIGNATURE`,
`REFUSE_UNFOLD_STILL`, `REFUSE_UNREAD`, `REFUSE_VERTEX_BODY`,
`REFUSE_VERTEX_TAPE`, `REFUSE_WITNESS_DEPENDENT`, `REFUSE_WITNESS_ROOM`.

A sentence that does not replay is refused to its voice, never slashed,
because it was never installed. The refusal travels as the kind of the
adjudication of 50.9, read off its content (78.9): `VertexBody`
(`REFUSE_VERTEX_BODY`), `EdgeHolonomy` (`REFUSE_EDGE`),
`RemainderUndeclared` (`REFUSE_NOT_CLOSED`), `MalformedComplex`
(`REFUSE_NOT_A_SENTENCE`, `REFUSE_FORM_TAPE`, `REFUSE_DEMAND_UNTYPED`,
`REFUSE_NOT_CONTRACTION` and the tape refusals of 23.1), `OrbitStill`,
`FaceDerivation` and `RemainderWrong` (`RefusalKind`,
`src/transducer/sentence/form/certificate.rs`). `REFUSE_FOLD_OPEN` and
`REFUSE_FOLD_INEXACT` are the two answers to a fold (45.8): a prefix that
is not final is not folded, and a fold that does not conserve is not
co-signed. `REFUSE_MALFORMED` answers an act whose fields disagree with one
another, and `REFUSE_NOT_EQUIVOCATION` an equivocation act whose two
receipts are not a proof; the admission (`src/court/admission/`,
`admit_signature`, `admit_equivocation`) decides both before any carrier is
touched, after `REFUSE_ORIGIN`, `REFUSE_SIGNATURE` and `REFUSE_RECEIPT`.
The constants are returned by `replay_form`, `blind_replay`, the admission
of 47.2 and `Court::perceive_speech`.

### 34.2 Server log lines, `src/bin/mycelium-server/` and `src/server/cognition/`

A court line is prefixed `  court `; it writes an address as its first two
bytes in hex followed by `…`, a height as `h {n}` (`Height::stamp`,
`src/chronometry/receipt.rs`), a refusal by its 34.1 constant, and a
refusal kind, a coordinate and a demand kind by the words naming them (`RefusalKind::label`
and `At::label`, `src/transducer/sentence/form/certificate.rs`;
`Demand::label`, `src/transducer/sentence/demand.rs`). The lines of this
section still written by the code are `court book height`, `court exchange
asked`, `court exchange deferred by`, `court fold refused`, `court fold
witnessed`, `court genesis … epoch`, `court nerve deferred by {addr} acts
{n}`, `court offered {n} germs to the overlap`, `court offer refused`,
`court offer unmeasured`, `court organs reached` and `court phase h …`.

The two `court offer refused` lines are the two ends of one act: `from`
is the witness refusing a frame 47.2 would not admit
(`src/bin/mycelium-server/judge/offer.rs`), `by` is the home reading a
witness's refusal off the reply (`src/bin/mycelium-server/offer.rs`).
`court offer unmeasured` is the third arm of that reply: the witness
admitted the frame and has re-derived nothing of its own on the class,
which is neither agreement nor refusal (47.3). A deferral (`court exchange
deferred by`) is impedance, never a refusal: the peer refused nothing and
witnessed nothing, and the act is asked again after that peer's Λ, never
on the next cycle. `court nerve deferred by` is written once per aperture
of acts per peer, never per act. `court phase` is written once per window,
an aperture of docket circuits (45.9).

The mint reads the form THE COURT WILL HOLD, `from_address` of the minted
address (`held_form`, `src/transducer/sentence/address.rs`), against the
envelope, never the form in hand; an address that does not decode is its
own typed refusal (`Refused::MintAddressUndecoded`,
`src/transducer/sentence/obstruction.rs`), so the court would hold no form.

### 34.3 Client log lines, `src/client/`

A mind's diagnostics are typed readings (CV5), never tagged log lines.
What still binds from this section: a refusal kind, its coordinate and a
demand kind are written by the same words as in 34.2; a probe reply is a
reading, the settled μ⃗ per lane, the closure with its versor and the
remaining μ⃗, with no outcome code; and a mint refusal is a typed `ObstructionRefusal`
arm, whose one line `mint refused ({arm}): {proof} [{kind}] demands
[{kinds}]` is written by `mint_refusal_line`
(`src/transducer/family/deflation.rs`).

**Vocabulary ruling (2026-09-18).**
- *Interference* means closure to identity or its bivector obstruction.
- *Superposition* means a vortex with transitions between candidates.
- *Prune* means a measured non-identity monodromy rupture across frames.

A circuit of a carrier (45.7) is read once per completed circuit, with
the circuit count and the period in strokes, so velocity is read in
kernel coordinates.

## 35. Closing invariants

Checked by tests, greppable by the reviewer:

- A stored form's `Frame` vertex has identity `word_in`.
- Every `Glued` vertex's depth is strictly below its form's depth.
- Every address in `cited_by` resolves through `resolve_form`, directly or
  via `RMP1` during the window.
- Every `court form installed` has exactly one `court form settled` or one
  `mint` line for its address.
- The number of `form spoken` lines across the minds equals the number
  of `ACT_SPEECH` frames across the servers.
- No function outside `family::extract_rule_with`, `family::speak_rule`, and
  `family::orbit` reads a site coordinate of a grid.
- No digest, hash, or fingerprint of any mathematical structure exists in
  cognition: every key is the canonical coordinates of an exact object
  written out (A21) and `decode(key)` returns the object; `blake3` appears
  only in `network/`, `court/identity`, `chronometry`, and the persistence
  loaders, over wire bytes, file bytes, and receipts; no `Keyed` is keyed
  by a 32-byte digest, and no two keys are compared as digests.
- No `(ℚ, ℚ)`, `(BigRational, BigRational)`, or `(i64, i64)` pair is carried
  as a placement, shift, or residue outside `extract_rule_with`, `speak_rule`, and
  `orbit`; every placement is a carriage versor and every residue a
  component of a holonomy versor (law 11).
- Every coordinate a form stores re-derives from the form's own words and
  faces (law 12); a coordinate that does not is filed as a section
  coordinate and never enters a key, a class vector, or a certificate.
- No `QMatrix`, affine block, or matrix product carries, composes, or
  compares an action anywhere in `transducer/`, `server/`, `client/`, or
  `court/`; `core::exponents` (HNF) holds the only matrix arithmetic, for ranks,
  and A3's sensor-plane block is read from a rotor and never stored.
- `cocycle_at` holds at most one entry per (chart, pair, class key), and
  every `court mv` line is preceded by a `court goodness … good component`
  line for its component.
- Every chart axis is an exact invariant; no axis is a hash fragment.
- Rank (A18) is conserved by every move except discharge, which moves it
  from `H¹` to an axis, and closure of a trivial-class chord, which was
  never rank (chapter 42, R1–R6); no `REFUSE_RANK_LOST` line appears on a
  clean tape.
- A class key in any voice's `horizon` is on the chart's hypha, and a
  hypha's class on a chart is in the `horizon` of every voice that quoted
  that chart within one aperture (M9 invariant).
- No pivot is selected by a measure: every `pivot … discharged` line names
  an axis the orbit's class vector occupied, every applied pivot has a
  certificate that replays on the court, and a `vortex … held` line is never
  followed by an applied pivot on that orbit without a `collapsed by` line
  naming the perception, glue, or ruling that collapsed it (law 10).
- No `SystemTime`, `Instant`, or `Duration` is named in a kernel, court,
  ledger, physics, or transducer file; every duration is a stroke count or
  a height difference (45.4), and the clock gate of `MU-ENGINEERING.md` §7
  fails the build otherwise.
- Every `_tu` carrier is a height and every `_k` carrier a receipt index; no
  field anywhere holds a unix second.
- Every signed frame's prefix carries the node's own genesis and epoch; a
  differing one appears only as a `court origin refused` line.
- Every `court form installed` line is preceded by a `court witness …
  co-signed` line for the same address from a key outside the home's
  delegation closure (47.3).
- Every equivocation proof produces exactly one `burn` entry and one `court
  equivocation` line per hypha, and `Treasury::audit` holds on each (R9).
- No `court concurrent … held` pair is followed by a resolution by order; it
  is followed by a merge with conservation, a `court mv` line, or a burn
  (45.3).
- Every `form withheld` line is followed in the same stroke by a `dialect
  stood` line and one `sentence spoken` line whose `demands` count is the
  number of (kind, chart) pairs the withheld bodies fall under; no
  `remainder expressed` line and no `uttered … cites 0` line on a chain
  appears on any voice (50.6); a voice that has logged a withheld form
  never shows `dialect 0` on its next stroke line (24.3).
- Every `uttered` line names a sentence address that a `dialect stood` or
  `sentence spoken` line on the same voice logged earlier, and there is
  one `uttered` line per (address, K) on that voice; every listing on any
  book carries a demand kind (50.5), and every `court attest` line reports
  a sentence replayed, never a chain docketed.
- No hypha reaches `reduce_all` or `reduce_germ` from a wire act; every
  `court attest` line reports citations replayed and a residue measured
  (23.8).
- Every `court syllabus` line has exactly one `form learned` or one
  `syllabus refused` line on the receiving voice, and no `form learned`
  appears without a replay before it.
- On any voice, `quote asked` lines per aperture cycle never exceed one
  plus the changes of its working language plus the advances of the book
  height in that cycle; an idle voice writes one stroke line per aperture
  cycle, each `stroke idle` line carrying four lane dwells; no `max` over
  lanes and no clamp appears anywhere in the pacing path, and no standing
  byte is multiplied into a μ⃗ or ordered against another.
- `court room refused` never appears on a voice whose bond covers its open
  dockets; no count of utterances, dockets, or quotes is compared with a
  literal anywhere in the court or the client.

# Part VI — Extensions: breaking the two walls

Carried from Parts I–V: the engine on ℚ over the sensor plane. Three
limits are built into the carriers, not the doctrine; the third, the prime
wall, was named on 2026-09-10 when the ruling of law 6 gave the court the
effector chapter 50's demand had been missing. This part specifies the
upgrades as language extensions: nothing in Parts I–V changes, the 17
letters remain the base no voice changes, exact arithmetic remains exact,
each upgrade opens only where a demand asks for it, and since 37.7 the
court answers the demand at run time.

## 36. Where the walls bite, exactly

### 36.1 The field wall

A rotation by `θ` in the plane `e_i e_j` is the rotor `cos(θ/2) − sin(θ/2)
e_ij`, projectively `1 − tan(θ/2) e_ij`. The 90° turn is `tan(π/4) =
1`, which is why `1 + e_ij` is a letter over ℚ; the `(3,4,5)` and
`(5,12,13)` letters are the rational points of the circle at the primes 5
and 13. Every rotation the alphabet spells has rational `tan(θ/2)`, the
group is closed under composition, and no irrational ever arises inside
the language. The wall is at perception: a sensor whose symmetries include
the eighth turn (`tan(π/8) = √2 − 1`, diagonal lattices), the sixth
(`tan(π/6) = 1/√3`) or twelfth (`tan(π/12) = 2 − √3`, hexagonal
lattices), or any `n`-th turn with `n ∉ {1, 2, 4}` (`tan(π/n)` algebraic of
degree above 1) produces a plane block with irrational entries; `spell`
refuses it and the remainder carries the whole body. On ARC's ℤ² grids this
never happens: `D4 ⋊ ℤ²` and rational dilations close every grid symmetry.
The field wall is the wall of the next sensors, specified now so the
carriers are not rebuilt then.

### 36.2 The projection wall

Links are `(r, c, before, after)`; a body is a set of plane laminae; a bundle
is pairs each perceived on its own plane. A third spatial axis (stacking,
occlusion, volumetric corpora), the frame index as a coordinate the
geometry can act on, and transformations that move structure across frames
have no coordinate on the base and land only as remainder or fibre tag.
The alphabet already acts on four axes and six planes; three of the six
touch the fourth axis and are unused by perception. The upgrade is to let
perception write on them.

### 36.3 The prime wall (ruled 2026-09-10)

The rational points of the unit circle are a group: the units `±1, ±i`
times a free abelian group with one generator per prime `p ≡ 1 (mod 4)`,
the Gaussian prime `π_p = a + bi` with `a² + b² = p` (Fermat; the
decomposition is unique under `a > b > 0`). A plane rotation over ℚ is a
product of powers of these generators, and the alphabet's prime letters
are the generators at `5` (`2 + i`) and `13` (`3 + 2i`) alone. A rotation
whose weight carries `17`, `29`, `37`, `41`, … is exact over ℚ, is a rotor
of `Spin(4,0)(ℚ)`, and spells in no word: the peel of `spell` stops at a
remainder after the `5` and `13` shells, and `factor_rotor` names it
`Demand::RotorPrime(plane, prime)` (50.4). This wall is inside ℚ. No
cyclotomic arithmetic crosses it, no conductor rises, and nothing of
37.1–37.4 is needed: what is missing is one letter, and the letter is the
witness rotor's own Gaussian factor (37.7).

On the sensor's ℤ² a rotation carries laminae onto laminae only in `D4`, so
the prime wall, like the field wall, does not bite on ARC. It is
specified because a demand without a consumer is a sensor without an
effector: since chapter 50 a voice names the prime it cannot spell, and
until 37.7 nothing in the running engine could answer it but a commit.

## 37. Upgrade F — the field tower

### 37.1 F1 Exact cyclotomic arithmetic

A `cyclo` module in `core`, **not built** — 36.3 rules that the prime wall
needs none of 37.1–37.4, so this is the specification of the module a
remainder would demand, and no path in the tree carries it:

```rust
pub struct Cyclo { m: u32, c: Vec<Q> }          // element of ℚ(ζ_m): polynomial in ζ of degree < φ(m), reduced mod Φ_m; c.len() == phi(m)
pub fn phi(m: u32) -> usize;                       // Euler's totient
pub fn cyclotomic_poly(m: u32) -> Vec<Q>;          // Φ_m by exact division: (x^m − 1) / ∏_{d|m, d<m} Φ_d
impl Cyclo {
    pub fn rational(m: u32, q: Q) -> Cyclo;        // the constant q at conductor m
    pub fn zeta(m: u32) -> Cyclo;                  // ζ_m
    pub fn add / sub / mul(&self, o: &Cyclo) -> Cyclo;   // polynomial arithmetic reduced mod Φ_m
    pub fn inverse(&self) -> Option<Cyclo>;        // extended Euclid in ℚ[x] against Φ_m; None iff zero
    pub fn conj(&self) -> Cyclo;                   // ζ ↦ ζ^{m−1}
    pub fn is_real(&self) -> bool;                 // self == conj(self)
    pub fn norm(&self) -> Q;                       // ∏_{k coprime to m} σ_k(self), σ_k: ζ ↦ ζ^k
    pub fn lift(&self, m2: u32) -> Option<Cyclo>;  // ℚ(ζ_m) → ℚ(ζ_{m2}) when m | m2: ζ ↦ ζ^{m2/m}, reduced
    pub fn is_zero / is_one(&self) -> bool;
}
pub enum Scalar { Rat(Q), Cyc(Cyclo) }             // a scalar module in core, not built
```

`Φ_m` is the minimal polynomial of `ζ_m`, so the reduced coefficient vector
is unique and equality is coefficientwise. No ordering of the field is
defined or needed: A1's sign step becomes, at conductor `m > 1`, "the pivot
coefficient's first nonzero rational coordinate is `+1`", canonical without
positivity; projective equality is already either-sign. Mixed operations
lift both operands to `lcm(m₁, m₂)`. `Scalar` arithmetic stays in `Rat`
while both operands are rational and promotes otherwise; `Rotor`, `Mv`,
`PlaneForm`'s block, `spell`'s input block, and the frame rationals accept
`Scalar`; a `Rat` equals a `Cyc` that is a rational constant. Every
existing test runs unchanged with all scalars in `Rat`. Multiplication is
`O(φ(m)²)` rational products, which is why the conductor is a cost.

### 37.2 F2 The conductor is a grade

The **conductor** of a word is the least `m` with every rotor coefficient in
`ℚ(ζ_m)`: `1` for every word of Parts I–V; computed as the lcm of its
letters' conductors. It enters the S lane's cost as a factor `φ(m)`, never
a fifth lane; among two descriptions closing the same remainder the one
the other derives retires it (27), and nothing prefers by conductor. The
tower is climbed only when ℚ cannot close, and a word ℚ can close is never
spoken at a higher conductor.

### 37.3 F3 Extension letters

For each `n ∈ {3, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, …}` that a demand opens (37.5) and each
of the six planes, the letter

```
τ_{n,ij} = 1 − tan(π/n) · e_ij        projective, coefficients in ℚ(ζ_{4n})
```

is the `n`-th turn, conductor `4n` (the least `m` with `tan(π/n) ∈ ℚ(ζ_m)`
divides `4n`; `4n` uniformly is canonical). `n = 4` is the base quarter
turn; `n ∈ {1, 2}` add nothing. Relators appended to `relators()` at open
time and never edited afterwards: `τ_{n,ij}^n = 1` projectively;
complementary planes commute; a sheet letter conjugates `τ` to its inverse;
`τ_{n,ij}^{n/4} = q_ij` when `4 | n` (`q` stays the geodesic for multiples
of `n/4`, `τ` is used for the rest).

The letters live in the **extension stratum**: `Alphabet { base: [Letter;
17], ext: Vec<ExtLetter> }`, `ExtLetter::Turn { n: u32, plane: (u8, u8),
conductor: u32 }` beside `ExtLetter::Prime` of 37.7 (Specified; not in the tree). An extension letter
is named on the tape by its content under the escape byte `0x7f` — the
kind, the plane and `n` (or `p`) as A21 coordinates — never by an id
assigned in open order (law 6 as ruled 2026-09-10; 37.7 P4 says why), and
the genome's syllabus section `SYL1` lists the opened letters by the same
content, so two nodes that learned a letter hold one name for it without
agreeing on an order; a node that has not learned it refuses the tape with
`REFUSE_LETTER_UNTAUGHT` (`"letter not in syllabus"`) and asks for the
syllabus by the existing teach path.

### 37.4 F4 Spelling in the tower

The plane form gains, per plane, a torsion coordinate in `Z/N`, `N =
lcm(4, n_1, n_2, …)` over the opened `n` on that plane, replacing the unit
exponent in `Z/4`; free coordinates unchanged. `spell` over a block with
`Scalar` entries:

1. Weight `w = ρ²` of the block (real). Free exponents `v_5(norm(w)) /
   (2·φ(m))` and `v_13(norm(w)) / (2·φ(m))`, the field norm dividing out the
   degree exactly as the ℚ peel reads `v_5(w)/2`; refuse if not exact.
2. Divide the free part out.
3. The remainder is a torsion rotor of order dividing `N`: match it by A1
   equality against the `N` candidates `τ^k`, `k ∈ Z/N`, on that plane (a
   finite list, computed once per `N`, memoised). No match: refuse; the
   block is not in the language at this tower level and the remainder
   stands.
4. Sheet parity as before.

`PlaneForm::to_word` writes the torsion coordinate as the shortest tape in
the letters available on the plane, a fixed rule per `N`. `conjugacy_key`
is unchanged in form with the torsion coordinate in `Z/N`.

### 37.5 F5 Opening a letter by demand

A letter is never added by configuration. The germination path
(`germination_demand`, chapter 25) sees, for a body pair whose carriage
exists in `SO(2)(ℚ(ζ))` but not in the current language, a plane block that
`spell` refuses at step 3 with a torsion remainder `T`. The demand is `T` itself. The court replays `T`: if `T^n =
1` projectively for the least `n ≤ N_max` (a physics bound, the largest
torsion order the sensor's resolution can distinguish, computed from the
frame, never a constant), the court opens `τ_{n,ij}`, appends its relators,
assigns its id, and speaks the syllabus with the new letter. Two organs
replay the opening as they replay any sentence.

### 37.6 F6 Binding and tests

**Specified.** `core::cyclo` and `core::scalar`, new (not built); `alphabet/`: `Rotor<Scalar>`,
`Alphabet { base, ext }`, `ExtLetter`, `relators()` appending, `spell`
steps 1–4, `PlaneForm` torsion in `Z/N`; `element/letters.rs`: `Letters` carries
the conductor; `economy/settle.rs`: conductor factor in the S-lane cost; genome
section `SYL1` `(n, plane, id)*`. Tests and traces: chapters 39–40.

### 37.7 THE ADJUNCTION — the court adjoins a remainder as a generator (ruled 2026-09-10)

**Amended 2026-10-09 (U14; recorded verbatim in §0.1).** The
adjunction below assumed a fixed base of seventeen that every remainder is
measured against (the primality trigger's "meets none of the six
coordinate planes", P1's "after the `5` and `13` shells", P6's "the
seventeen and the relators among them" unchanged, the adjoined count's "outside
the span of the seventeen"). U14 reseeds the alphabet EMPTY: every letter
is coined, the first ones included, where a mind composes two reflections
its probes perceived and the Cayley rotor of the product steps the rank of
its algebra (`Δrank(𝔥) > 0`, 78.68's rank-step act). So:
- the seventeen as a base is SUPERSEDED here (1.1 as amended); P6's "What
  does not change. The seventeen and the relators among them" and the references
  above to the seventeen's planes and shells read against the letters a
  mind holds, never against a given seed;
- the remainder-as-generator move, adjunction by closure (2026-09-12), the
  levels table and P2's witness-read factor are unchanged: they are how a
  coined letter is judged where it is offered to a court;
- U14's coining is by a Rank Step in the mind and stands in its dialect
  (78.109 K1); the road into the genome stays this chapter's: the client
  sends the constructor steps, the court checks them and opens the letter
  (review ruling 3, S2, §0.1, answering open (i)), and the
  court never proposes a generator; with no RNG in the path (the
  clarification), two courts reading one probe adjoin one letter;
- U15 widens what is adjoined: a letter is the triad
  `(g_core, ∇B, ΔB)` (78.68 as amended), so an incongruent remainder — a
  creation, source or deformation demand, which 70.5 measured as the 189
  demands this organ could never open — is a candidate letter at the
  constructor complex, not only a rotor at a ring level.

**There is one move, not one per wall.** A demand is the canonical
remainder a factorisation through the presentation left (A12 step 5,
50.2 step 2), and the generator the presentation lacks **is that
remainder**. It is already exact, already measured, already canonical,
and it carries itself as its own witness; nothing is searched for and
nothing is constructed. The court adjoins it when two independent courts
re-derive the same remainder from the same witness, rules it with a
receipt, and the syllabus teaches it before any voice speaks it. That is
the whole of how the language grows a generator, and 1.8 already said so:
"a residue that no generator reduces is adjoined as a new generator once
the court has replayed it and independent lineages have reached the same
conclusion".

**Adjunction by closure, never by agreement on the remainder (ruled
2026-09-12).** The paragraph above says the court adjoins when two courts
re-derive the same remainder from one witness. That is a congruence
reading over what failed: it certifies that two organs read one
obstruction exactly, and it says nothing about whether the language can
now say anything it could not. The document's own words keep the two
apart — congruence is agreement on an overlap (11.2, 24.4), coherence is
a form whose orbits close (2.2, 11.2) — and a language is formed on what
closes. A presentation grown by agreement alone grows by nothing but names
for what it could not spell.

So the adjunction is the closure. A candidate generator — the canonical
remainder at whatever level the factorisation stopped — is docketed as a
provisional form on two courts' re-derivation of the witness (P3 below),
and docketing adjoins nothing. It enters the presentation when a sentence
that composes through it **closes on its family** (23.1 step 7: every
remainder empty, every loop identity or filed) and two courts replay that
closure (47.3). The install of the closing sentence is the adjunction:
the candidate enters with it as a generator the closing derivation cites,
its discoverers paid as a use (26), the syllabus teaching it from that
install. A candidate no closure ever composes through stays a listed
demand and is never a generator, however many courts agree it exists,
and it lapses as a docket lapses (47.5). A generator adjoined this way
has, by construction, closed at least one sentence; that is the whole of
what it means for a generator to work, and it is why the count of such
generators is a reading of the engine and the count of agreed remainders
was not. What is adjoined at the deeper nodes of 1.9 — a relator, a
rewrite, a procedure — enters by the same condition: a closure two courts
replayed composes through it. The refusals of chapter 44 stand.

**The rotor level is a level (ruled 2026-09-17).** An orbit whose class has
a free part — a prime exponent, or an off-plane class of infinite order —
is a remainder at the rotor's own level: its canonical holonomy rotor is
the candidate, carrying itself as witness, and `3 + e₀₁ + e₀₂` (weight 11,
held by no coordinate plane) is the shape of one. It is docketed and
adjoined exactly as the others: by closure, never by agreement.

**The trigger and the primality proof (ruled 2026-09-18).** The residue of a
vortex whose every candidate has died on a measured monodromy is prime relative
to the alphabet when its bivector plane meets none of the six coordinate planes
(`src/transducer/alphabet/factor.rs`, `factor_rotor`), replacing any search or quantifier over the group. It is
presented to the court as the witness N4 already defined, docketed on two
courts' re-derivation, and adjoined when a closure composes through it.

**The kind is a level, never a dispatch.** A remainder lives at the level
its factorisation stopped at, and the level is a coordinate read off the
remainder — for the log line and for the route — never a key into a table
of closers. Its canonical form at that level is the one the tree already
computes:

| level | the factorisation that stopped | the remainder's canonical form | already in the tree |
|---|---|---|---|
| the ring | A22's peel over one plane block | the Gaussian factor, `a + b·e_ij` with `a² + b² = p`, `a > b > 0` | A1 (16.1) and `core::gaussian` |
| the presentation | A12 over the stratum's generators | the HNF residue, unique under the row order | A12 step 5 |
| the cover | the pieces' nerve does not glue | the filled simplex over the meet's orbit, `Fill::Class(ℓ)` | `cech::extend` (50.8) |
| the relations | two proofs of one vertex do not commute | the composite holonomy `g⁻¹ ∘ f` around the proofs, keyed by 15.4 | `cech::holonomy`, the membrane of 23.9 |

The last row adjoins a **relation**, not a generator: two proofs of one
vertex whose composite holonomy is non-trivial are a relator the
presentation lacks, and 1.8's "relations are sentences" is what reaches
the table here. Trivial holonomy is one proof seen from several frames —
the conjugate level — and E2 pays the closure once (23.9). The adjunction
is otherwise unchanged: the same witness, the same two-court consilience,
the same receipt and syllabus.

None of these is a closer written for a kind; each is the canonical form
of an exact object, and it exists because the object does. A dispatch
table over the five demand kinds of 50.5 would be a dictionary of
closers — the cipher's fault at the level of the effector — and it is
refused for the same reason (1.7).

**The adjoined generator's carrier, parties and act** (ruled
2026-09-10, L11 (2/2)). The remainder is docketed as a provisional form
with one word vertex whose citation list is empty, whose residue is the
identity, and whose canonical rotor is the remainder itself: named by
its content on every tape (law 6) with no escape byte, because a
vertex's identity is its rotor (1.5, L14). Its **discoverers** are the
voices whose demands carried the witness, parties as a consilience
award is split; a court is never a discoverer, because a court does
not speak (law 8). The install on the second court's re-derivation is
the second-vantage install every ruled word takes (47.3), under
`ActKind::Ruling` with the generator's address — a new act byte would
be a breaking layout change — and the syllabus teaches it as any ruled form. The
adjoined count (45.9) is read from content, never from a counter: the
ruled forms whose vertex cites nothing and carries a rotor outside the
span of the seventeen. The first opening was in process: two voices, two
courts of distinct identity, one address, the count 1 on each, no
corpus, no new act byte, no per-kind closer. Two facts the
landing found and ruled in place: a letterless word does not survive
`Word::to_bytes`, so an adjoined generator carries its rotor in the
derivation's rotor field under a presence byte, and "no citations" no
longer means "the residue is the action"; and a letter's vertex has no
star face, because the face from the Frame would be the letter's own
action, which is what the seventeen cannot spell — Frame plus vertex,
no faces, closed and coherent vacuously, as a generator should be.

**Depth 4 and depth 5 use carriers the tree already has** (ruled
2026-09-10, L17). At depth 4 the object is the holonomy of an orbit two
derivations of one vertex make through the derivations' two frames, read in the
stabilizer with rotor coefficients (23.9, `cech::holonomy`); trivial,
it is one proof in two frames and the closure is paid once; non-trivial
and of finite order, it is the torsion class chapter 25 already files
(`FiledLoop`, `Closure::Class`, `Fill::Class(ℓ)`), and the adjunction
is that class ruled on two courts' re-derivation of the same A1
canonical rotor and order, under `ActKind::Ruling`, taught by the
syllabus, and cited by any later form whose orbit carries it; of
infinite order it is not a relator but a generator, and it takes the
ring level's path. At depth 5 the object is a rewrite between two
derivations of one vertex, and the kinds are the ones `rewrite.rs`
carries: a generator **retires** (3.8, 27) when it derives through the
others — decided by factorisation, A12 or the ring division, never by
a length or any scalar (rule 4) — and the rewrite is the substitution of
its derivation into every citer, minted by `mint_rewrite` as
`Retire` with the citers re-docketed (`redocket_citers_of`), ruled on
two courts' re-derivation of the derivability, paid as E2 pays a
rewrite. No carrier is invented for either depth, and **no act byte is
spent for either** (ruled 2026-09-11): a relator and a rewrite are
attested by `ActKind::Ruling` with the object's address, as a letter is;
the depth reader of L15 counts them as it counts any ruling.

**What follows for the walls.** The prime wall (36.3) is the ring level
of the adjunction and needs no tower: the letter is rational, the field
is ℚ, and 37.1–37.4 stay closed. The deformation wall (50.8) is the cover
level of the same adjunction. P1–P7 below bind the ring level in full and
are read as the instance, not as the procedure; 50.8 binds the cover
level the same way. What varies between them is the canonical form in the
table above and nothing else: the witness, the two-court consilience, the
receipt, the syllabus, the content name and the epoch are one procedure.

**P1 The letter.** For a prime `p ≡ 1 (mod 4)` and a pair plane `(i, j)`
the letter is

```
Λ_{p,ij} = a + b·e_ij,   a² + b² = p,   a > b > 0
```

with the carried inverse `a − b·e_ij` (weight `p`), rational, conductor
`1`. Fermat's decomposition is unique under `a > b > 0`, so the letter is
a function of `p` and the plane and of nothing else: two nodes cannot open
two letters for one prime. Its order is infinite (15.3, Niven) and its
relators are the (3,4,5) letter's (1.2): infinite order, complementary
planes commute, a sheet letter conjugates it to its inverse.
`Rotor::order`, `class_key`, A1 and A21 need no change; the tape gains the
content name of 37.3; `factor_rotor`'s lattice per plane becomes
`ℤ^{1+k} ⊕ ℤ/4` with one `ℤ` per prime letter the syllabus holds; `spell`'s
peel gains one shell per opened prime after the `5` and `13` shells, the
primes in increasing order — an order by content, never by the order they
were opened.

**P2 The witness.** `Demand::RotorPrime(plane, prime)` carries beside the
prime the **witness rotor** `R = s + t·e_ij`: the plane block left after
the base shells, in A1 canonical form (50.4). The block the shells are
peeled from is the **residue** of 50.2 step 2 — what remained after `F`
factored the measured versor through the generators the mind holds — so
the witness is a coordinate of the demand's carrier and not a quantity
the court recomputes from a spelling. The Gaussian factor is read off the
witness, never searched for:

```
π_p = gcd_{ℤ[i]}(s + t·i, p)      Euclid over ℤ[i]; exact; bounded by the norm (rule 10)
```

normalised by a unit to `a > b > 0`. A witness whose gcd with `p` is a
unit names a prime it does not carry and is refused
`REFUSE_LETTER_WITNESS`. The two-squares problem is never solved from `p`
alone: the transducer measured the rotor, so the transducer already holds
the letter, and 36.3 is exactly the statement that the effector was
missing, not the object.

**P3 Consilience at arity two.** The court dockets `Λ_{p,ij}` as a
candidate when a `RotorPrime` demand vertex with its witness rotor stands
on a chart and two independent courts — the home and a witness hypha
outside its delegation closure (47.3) — each re-derive `π_p` from that
witness by P2 in its own replay and reach the same factor: equality of
content (law 2), never "the same minimal polynomial", which is the class
invariant of 15.3 alone and forgets the plane. Since 2026-09-12 this
consilience is the precondition of the docket and not the opening: the
letter is opened by the closure it enables, as the ruling above says, and
P4 and P5 read from that install. A voice's demand is listed, priced and
relayed as 50.5 says and opens nothing; a second voice speaking the same
demand is a use, never a judicial gate — a letter is no exception to 47.3
(ruled 2026-09-10, correcting this section's first text, which read the
second organ as a second voice). The opening is a ruling: a receipt of its
own act kind (`ACT_LETTER`) carrying the letter's content, the demand
address and the two courts; a court that re-reads a different factor from
the witness refuses the ruling (13.9 step 8). `court letter opened {plane}
{p} by {vk} {vk}` is the line, the two keys the two courts.

**P4 Teaching and the epoch.** The opened letter enters `SYL1` and the
syllabus page (A19) teaches it to every voice as it teaches a word; a
voice logs `letter learned {plane} {p}`. The alphabet epoch is the
syllabus page's height (45): a tape naming a letter above a receiver's
page is `REFUSE_LETTER_UNTAUGHT`, and the receiver asks for the page. No
voice speaks an opened letter before the page that teaches it; a word
spelled in an untaught letter is not a word on that node; and that is the
whole of intelligibility — the floor every voice speaks is the syllabus,
not a constant. An index assigned in open order would need every node to
agree on an order of openings, which is the totalisation law 9 refuses;
the content name needs no agreement.

**P5 The demand closes without re-perception.** A sentence stood withheld
with a `RotorPrime` vertex (50.5) re-spells that vertex on the first stroke
after the page arrives: `factor_rotor` over the syllabus's letters now
peels the witness to a word, the demand vertex becomes a `Word` vertex with
the same carriage and gauge, and the sentence is uttered whole (24.3). The
percept is not re-read; the witness rotor was the measurement.

**P6 What does not change.** *(The seventeen clause SUPERSEDED
2026-10-09 by U14; see this chapter's amendment.)* The seventeen and the relators among them; exact ℚ;
the T lane as extent; the cost of a word on the S lane, letters counted
as now with no conductor factor; the court's two-organ replay. A voice
holds no letter it was not taught, and no letter is ever opened for a
prime no witness carried.

**P7 Binding.** `alphabet/letters.rs`: `Letter::{Base(u8), Prime { plane,
p }, Turn { plane, n }}` in place of `LetterId`, `Alphabet { base, ext }`,
`letter`/`letter_inverse` over both, the relators appended per opened
letter; `alphabet/spelling.rs`: the peel over the syllabus's primes;
`alphabet/factor.rs`: the per-plane lattice over the held primes;
`sentence/demand.rs`: the witness rotor on `RotorPrime`;
`core/gaussian.rs` NEW: `gcd` over ℤ[i] with its unit normalisation;
the court's opening, P2–P3; `SYL1` in the genome;
`ACT_LETTER`; `REFUSE_LETTER_WITNESS`, `REFUSE_LETTER_UNTAUGHT` in 34.1;
the two log lines in 34.2/34.3. The tape's escape byte is a breaking layout change.
Tests: a test that a prime letter is read off the witness and never
searched; a test that one voice opens no letter; a test that two witnesses
of one prime open one letter; `prime_factor_refuses_witness_without_prime`;
a test that a tape naming an untaught letter is refused; a test that an
opened letter spells the demand that opened it; a test that opened primes
peel in increasing order. Traces: `court letter opened`
once per `(plane, p)` on the mesh, `letter learned` on every voice after
the page, and the sentence that carried the demand uttered without it on
the next stroke.

## 38. Upgrade B — the base promotion

### 38.1 B1 Sites with four base coordinates

A site of the base gains `z` beside `k` (51.1): `z` is the third spatial
axis (layer from stacking or occlusion order in plane corpora; depth in
volumetric ones); `t` is the frame coordinate, which chapter 51 places on
`e₃` as `k`. Neither is the T lane of μ⃗, which remains temporal extent.
A link stays `(r, c, before, after)` (16.5 as ruled 2026-09-17): the
further coordinates ride on the pose and on the blade exactly as the frame
does, and a support is sites of four coordinates. A5 is unchanged, the
chain bytes of M2 and `GEN3` are unchanged, and no plane address moves; a
section's pose carries `z` as it carries `k`. No migration.

### 38.2 B2 Harmonics in dimension up to four

`Harmonics::of` generalises to the cubical complex of the support in `d ∈
{2, 3, 4}`: components, holes and cavities (Betti numbers by exact integer
linear algebra over ℤ), turns (boundary faces of each dimension), and the
moment invariants (isoperimetric, anisotropy, spread, quartic) from exact
moment tensors up to fourth order normalised by lamina count, each a rational
through A6. The axes vector is prefixed by `d`, so plane and volumetric
charts never share a stratum. `peel_body_scaled` generalises shells to
faces, edges, and corners of the `d`-cube complex.

### 38.3 B3 The alphabet already acts on the fourth axis

The six planes are `(0,1)` the sensor plane, `(0,2)`, `(1,2)` the sheet
planes to the third axis, `(0,3)`, `(1,3)`, `(2,3)` to the fourth. Under B1
the third axis is `z` and the fourth `t`. A rotor on a `(·,3)` plane mixes
a spatial axis with the frame coordinate: "what is at `(r, c)` in frame `t`
is at `(r', c')` in frame `t+1`". The prime letters on those planes are the
rational shears and scalings across frames. No letter is added; perception
writes laminae with `t ≠ 0` and `spell` receives 4×4 blocks closed on the
`(·,3)` planes.

### 38.4 B4 The sentence across frames

A bundle's pairs become one chain with `t` running over the examples
(inputs at even `t`, outputs at `t+1`, or a sequence's steps in order). The
carriage between a body and its image is a rotor whose `(·,3)` components
carry the frame step; faces are relative words as now; orbits now run in the
frame direction too, and the orbits' identity holonomy is the statement that the
rule is the same rule at every frame. Nothing in `Form`, `coheres`,
`close`, `replay_form`, or the court changes.

### 38.5 B5 The conformal model climbs with the base

`cga/` is `Cl(4,1)` (51.2, ruled 2026-09-17): the conformal model of
the three-coordinate base `(r, c, k)`, the frame `k` on `e₃`. `Cl(5,1)`
is not derived — `e₂` is the orientation character and not a point
coordinate — and `z` waits for a corpus that carries one (51.11).
The same exact multivector algebra over a larger mask: `Mv` becomes
dimension-generic, the blade masks widen, `projective_ratio`, `conj`,
`norm2`, `to_bytes`, `canonical` unchanged in form; A4 unchanged. Brick 2
(`Cl(4,1)`) lands first. Chapter 51 (ruled 2026-09-17) places the frame
`k` on `e₃` and derives `Cl(4,1)` for it; `z` waits for a corpus that
carries one (51.11), and `Cl(5,1)` is not derived.

### 38.6 B6 Binding

`element/{carrier,residual}.rs`: the link unchanged, the pose carrying `z`
as it carries `k` (38.1); `blade/`,
`blade/harmonics.rs`: `d`-dimensional moments and Betti numbers, axes
prefixed by `d`; `peel.rs`:
`d`-cube shells; `family/perceive.rs`: `perceive` over frames writes `t`;
`stalk/chart.rs`: `invariant` on `d`-sites; `cga/multivector.rs`: dimension-generic `Mv`.
Tests and traces: chapters 39–40.

What does not change under either upgrade: the 17 letters and the
relators among them; exact ℚ for every ARC word (the tower is never climbed unless a
remainder demands it); the T lane as extent; the court's two-organ replay,
which replays field elements and four-coordinate laminae with the same code
paths; the bans of the laws. The walls come down by adding coordinates the
geometry already acts on, not by changing what a word is.
