### 78.51 A.10.1 Orbital tensegrity: coherence is a balanced constellation, and the star sets the spin

Axiom A.10.1: coherence is the stationary equilibrium of a constellation,
never a property of one frame; to cohere is to hold at least two congruent
frames stable at the same time.

- **(1) The axiom.** A FRAME is a body's nucleus `s` (its dual sphere) and
  its pose `θ`; a CONSTELLATION is `N ≥ 2` frames under one generator
  `B_orbit`. The torque a coupling `B` exerts on a generator `G` is
  `τ = ½ [B, G]` (`torque`), 78.46's lift, an element of the algebra and
  never a scalar. LAW I (co-presence): fewer than two frames is
  `MonocularOrbit`. LAW II (balance): stationary equilibrium iff the net
  torque `Σ_{i<j} ½ [B_ij, B_orbit]` vanishes coefficient by coefficient
  over ℚ, never by a scalar trace. LAW III (strain) is read plane by plane
  (78.62). LAW IV (force): the gate admits an operation iff the
  constellation after stands in equilibrium and its strain did not rise
  (`consolidate`), otherwise `UnbalancedTensegrity` (the torque its content)
  or `DestabilizingOperation`. `SingularCollapse` is two nuclei at one
  locus (`s_i ∧ s_j = 0`); `NonRigid { i, j, delta }` is a pair that did
  not keep its separation. T1 reciprocity, T2 coaxial co-planarity and T3
  anti-monocularity are read by the register.
- **(2) The star sets the spin.** A STAR is a centre and a mass (`Star`),
  the barycentre of bodies, a body's mass its sites. A rigid step splits
  exactly against a star (Chasles) into its ORBIT about the star and its
  SPIN about the body's own centre (`orbit_about`, `spin_of`): the star's
  distance sets the spin, read, never assumed. The hours as heights on a
  spin axis are superseded by 78.52 Row 1.
- **(3) The intrinsic axis** (rule 15: no arbitrary origin). The generator
  is the relation's turn about the constellation's own centre,
  `G = T_c R T̃_c` (`centred`), every frame co-rotating. Tier 1 (one body
  across its hours): `c` is the body's centroid, and a rigid carriage
  balances. Tier 2 (a scene of several bodies): `c` is the bodies' barycentre.
  The nucleus is read in the sensor's vertex coordinates, where transitions
  act (`vertex_nucleus`).
- **(4′) Attitude coupling and metric rigidity.** The internal torque of a
  constellation is evaluated over the relative poses of its frames
  (`V_ij = θ_j θ̃_i` since 78.52 Row 1; A.10's tether coupling is retired
  from the bracket); transverse separations are governed by METRIC
  RIGIDITY, every pair's separation kept exactly across a transition (at
  unit weight, 78.59), never by the planar commutator. A body tumbling out
  of the plane or a phase out of lock is refused by the torque; shear,
  drift and bodies flying apart are refused as `NonRigid`.
- **(5) In the engine.** Every thought on the perception path passes the
  gate before its edge is set (`Contemplation::gate`): tier 1 per body,
  tier 2 per chart with metric rigidity. Each refusal is counted by name,
  and an unbalanced, destabilizing or non-rigid one stands as a demand by
  the generator's class at its charts, its torque or separation defect the
  residue. A thought's frames on an orbit are bounded by one return
  (78.43).

Code: `src/physics/tensegrity.rs`, the register
`src/physics/axioms/tensegrity.rs` (a test per clause),
`src/transducer/bubble/resonance.rs` (`Contemplation::gate`).

### 78.52 The conformal foam: five rows; Row 1, the hours wind on a Clifford torus, and a body's momentum is carried

Squares, cubes and lattices are not native to the geometry: in `Cl(n+1,1)`
a line or plane is a circle or sphere through `e_∞`. The architecture is
built from spheres, circles and kissing foam, in five rows, in order:

| Row | Component | Retires |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Villarceau succession, A.13 momentum | `T_axial`, the `k`-height, the unit hour step; the collapse test on the identity |
| 2 | Sphere-pair versors `V = s₂ s₁` (intersecting: elliptic; concentric: hyperbolic; tangent: parabolic) | the translator `1 − ½ d e_∞` as a formula |
| 3 | Soddy bodies: Apollonian packings of kissing dual spheres over ℚ; the centroid the orthogonal socket `⟨s₀, sᵢ⟩₀ = 0` | pixel grids, bounding boxes |
| 4 | Schottky chambers: domains bounded by inversive sphere sets | grid-based complexes |
| 5 | Descartes–Soddy coherence `(Σ bᵢ)² = n Σ bᵢ²`, tangency | heuristic shape metrics |

- **(1) Row 1, the Villarceau succession** (`succession`, `hour`). The hour
  axis is a Clifford torus: the planes `e₁e₂` and `e₃e₊` are orthogonal and
  the planes' rotors commute. The HOUR ROTOR pairs the step's turn
  `R₁₂ = s + b e₁e₂` with the same rational point in the orthogonal plane,
  `R₃₊ = s + b e₃e₊`: `R_hour = T_c (R₁₂ R₃₊) T̃_c`, isoclinic, centred on
  the constellation's own centre (78.51(3)). Hour `m`'s frame is the
  body's nucleus carried by `R_hourᵐ`; the coupling is the relative pose
  alone, `V_ij = θ_j θ̃_i`; the hours close after the turn's own period, at
  the step's exact rational point (DG1), never an irrational angle. A step
  with no turn (a slide, a breathing or boost) winds on its own parameter.
  The identity is reflexive: one frame seen twice bypasses the gate,
  counted `reflexive`. The torus's unit: the plane `e₃e₊` carries a length,
  the unit sphere about the centre being the torus's pole.
- **(2) Row 1, A.13 momentum** (`momentum`, `external_torque`).
  `Π = M₂(B)`: the step's bivector read at the body's centroid from the
  exact second moments (`moment2`), weighed by the body's mass. An unforced
  orbit carries it, `Π_{m+1} = g Π_m g̃ / (g g̃)`; what it does not carry is
  the external torque, refused as `ExternalTorque` and filed as a demand.
- **(5) Row 2, hyphal fascicles** (`src/physics/fascicle.rs`). Motions
  are streaming fascicles of kissing spheres, never "pencils" or rigid
  vectors. A FASCICLE is two dual spheres with versor `V = s₂ s₁`, its
  action read at unit weight, exact, no root; its STREAMLINE is the pair's
  regime (`streamline_of`), elliptic, parabolic or hyperbolic, read in the
  algebra (GR1, 78.59). The translator is the fascicle of parallel planes
  kissing at `e_∞` (`translator_at`), so every slide in the engine is that
  fascicle. A fascicle kissing at a finite point fixes its contact but is
  conformal, not rigid; the rigid slide perception sees is the fascicle
  kissing at `e_∞`.
- **(6) The bridge to language.** Thought is not speech: a court replays
  transcribed words and sentences, never a mind's ground, and no rewrite
  kind carries a ground. The gate files each admitted relation's ground
  (`note_ground`); where a merged thought's hours reach its period, every
  hour balanced and its momentum carried, the thought is TRANSCRIBED: its
  rotation is spelled in the seventeen letters (`factor_rotor`) and the
  word is that spelling's connection at that carriage. A rotation the
  letters do not spell is an ineffable thought: counted, nothing emitted.
  The word is spoken in the act that closed its thought (`hold_perceived`).
  Stage C, A THOUGHT IS ITS GROUND: a merged thought holds no form but its
  ground (`Ground`: class, period, bodies at hour 0, generator), filed at
  its word's coordinates (`Ground::key_on`); the
  barycentre, couplings and rigidity are derived, never carried. A
  grounded thought is met by its ground (`join_ground`): a perception that
  is exactly the predicted next hour, read by the physics, joins as that
  hour.

### 78.53 Colour is a fibre; a colour word names an invariant fibre relation, never a palette integer

Identity is decided in the algebra, by an exact canonicalizer and its
invariants, before bytes are written; the address files what the algebra
decided, and a key locates, never identifies (A21, 78.44). Colour is a fibre
bundle over the spatial base (61.1, 70): a body is where mass is, and its
colour is the section it carries. A COLOUR WORD names an invariant fibre
relation (an identity section, a contrast, an automorphism of the fibre),
never a palette channel, and the court checks that the transformation on the
colour fibre is an exact isomorphism across the task's input and output
scenes. Where the base does not order two hues, the relation is the coset of
labellings, held as a superposition (law 10), never broken by the integer.
As amended by 78.56 II, the sensor's channels are a Dirichlet boundary and
the palette is not relabelled at the sensor; a merge of hues is recorded
into the reservoir (78.58). Code: `src/transducer/family/fibre_relation.rs`
(`fibre_relation`), `src/transducer/element/residual.rs` (`colour_word`).

### 78.54 The lattice's frame is a gauge too

A task turned or mirrored as a whole, every grid of it, is the same task:
the frame the sensor read it in is a coordinate choice. The frame is fixed at
the sensor and nowhere after, over the visible grids only (train pairs and
test inputs; a withheld output never moves the frame), so a task in every
frame reads the identical grids, mints the identical word and receives the
identical verdict and price. As amended by 78.56, the frame is fixed only
for a task whose centre-of-mass displacement vanishes; where it does not,
the orientation is physical and kept. Code: `src/arc.rs` (`frame_fixed`,
composed in `parse_task`).

### 78.55 The colour words compose: a mind derives a colour relation its ruled words imply

Colour words compose exactly: a product of two colour relations is one, and
nothing is said of a hue neither word speaks of (78.45); since 78.58, words
compose by composing the words' functions and lifting the result. Before a mind
speaks a colour relation it perceived, it asks whether its ruled colour words
(its genome, never its dialect) already derive it, by one word, an inverse,
or two composed, bounded by the stroke; it still speaks the word, since the
court rules by evidence. A THEOREM STANDS BY ITS PROOF: a mind speaks a
composite of two ruled colour words with its derivation cited in the
receipts envelope, outside the address, and the court admits a colour word
by its family's evidence or by composing exactly the two installed words it
cites (law 8), refusing a forged citation or one of words it never
installed; an admitted theorem mints nothing (78.56 IV). FEDERATION BY
PROOF, NEVER BY TRUST: a peer court admits a fetched colour word only by
re-deriving the witnessing task from its own copy of the family or by
composing the installed words it cites; unproven, it waits as dialect.
Code: `src/transducer/element/residual.rs` (`compose_fibre`,
`invert_fibre`, `derived_colour_word`, `colour_citation`),
`src/client/sdk/entity/utter.rs` (`speak_colour_theorem`),
`src/server/cognition/book/speech.rs` (`colour_proof`).

### 78.56 Three questions the physics already answers, and four closures

- **Extent.** Aligning grids of different extent at a corner is an
  arbitrary origin (rule 15). A change of extent is an inversive dilation
  carried by the fascicle of concentric spheres, `V = s_out s_in`, anchored
  at the envelope's own centre (a grid's circumscribed sphere, centre the
  extent's midpoint, `r² = (h² + w²)/4`); where `r²_out / r²_in` is not a
  rational square no site corresponds (78.45) and the pair witnesses
  nothing.
- **Orientation.** The dihedral poses are a gauge iff the scene carries no
  polar vector. The polar vector is the transition displacement of the
  centre of mass, `Δr_CM = r_CM(out) − r_CM(in)`, with
  `P = Δr_CM ∧ e_∞`: where it is non-zero the orientation is physical, and
  `Δr_CM = 0` is the O(2) singlet, where orientation is gauge (78.54's
  `frame_fixed` acts only there). Where a pair's dilation is irrational its
  momentum is unread and the orientation is held physical.
- **Palette size.** Ten is the detector's channel capacity, a boundary
  condition of the retina, never an invariant of the manifold.
- **I. Unitary with a reservoir sink.** Spin(4,1) stays strictly unitary
  over ℚ, with no non-invertible projection semigroup; a merge
  `c₁, c₂ ↦ c₃` is a unitary swap into an unobserved ancilla, the
  background `∅` (78.58), and the language spells only invertible
  automorphisms.
- **II. The detector is a Dirichlet boundary.** Inside the manifold colour
  transformations are gauge-invariant section automorphisms; at the
  boundary the channel indices anchor the gauge globally, so minds ground
  shared words for specific colours. This supersedes 78.53's relabelling of
  the palette at the sensor.
- **III. Orbits are strictly intra-task.** A thought's hours wind across
  the demonstration frames of one family; cross-task pairing for orbital
  closure is abolished, and what tasks share lives in the genome as words.
- **IV. Value is dissipative work on matter.** POUW pays only residue
  annihilated; waiting in escrow earns nothing; a theorem is admitted and
  mints nothing, earning a share of the payout when a solver cites it to
  annihilate residue. The court's reserve scales with the sum over its
  active bonds plus the work verified over the current window, each lane
  within the whole bond plus its own verified work.

Code: `src/arc.rs` (`frame_fixed`).

### 78.57 Learning is a phase transition: the coherence form closes or files the missing blade

A transition's defects live in distinct grades and are kept there, never
summed into one scalar loss: Δω, the torsional defect (the net torque the
couplings leave on the generator, a bivector, the rotor still missing);
Δδ², the metric defect (every pair whose separation moved, read at unit
weight since 78.59); and τ_ext, the momentum defect (every hour step whose
momentum the orbit did not carry, A.13). Combined as a coherence form they
are met: `Δ_total = τ_net ⊕ Δδ² ⊕ τ_ext ≡ 0` over ℚ. Where it vanishes the
constellation locks, and the thought closes and factors into a word in one
step without search; where it does not, each nonzero component is the
missing blade itself, filed as its own exact demand. Code:
`src/physics/tensegrity.rs` (`Defect`, `Defect::closes`, `coherence`,
`metric_defect`), `src/transducer/bubble/resonance.rs` (`read_ground`,
`note_refusal`; refusal `Refusal::Incoherent`).

### 78.58 The reservoir is the ancilla ray e_∅, and a merge rotates its distinction into it

The colour fibre is the detector's channels extended by one ancilla ray,
`E = span_ℚ{e_0 … e_9} ⊕ ℚe_∅`, which the sensor's projection never sees. A
merge `c₁, c₂ ↦ c₃` is the unitary `(c₁ ∧ c₂) ⊗ e_∅ ↦ c₃ ⊗ (Δc ∧ e_∅)`: the
grid shows `c₃` for both, and the distinction lives on in the reservoir, so
the automorphism inverts. In the sensor's discrete coordinates `RESERVOIR`
is the channel index after the last; a colour word's relation carries MOVE
rows `(f, t)`, STILL rows `(t, t)` for a merge's target that stood still,
and RECORD rows `(⊥, c)`. It is UNITARY (`is_fibre_relation`) when every
moved preimage of a merged target is recorded and nothing else is: no
preimage is singled out to stay unrecorded, since that choice would be made
by a channel index (rule 4). `fibre_function` is the action on the empty
reservoir, `lift_fibre` the one reader from a function the scenes showed to
the word, words compose by composing functions and lifting
(`compose_fibre`), and the inverse returns a recorded hue only with its
record (`invert_fibre`). Code: `src/transducer/element/residual.rs`;
test `src/server/cognition/tests/colour.rs`
(`fibre_relation_rotates_merge_into_reservoir`).

### 78.59 The ocean: the hyphae hold the laws, worlds build on them

The network's terms are renamed by 78.122 (`MU-LEXICON.md`), the ruling's
content unchanged: a GALAXY of clients is a COHORT, a client's STAR is its
ALLOCATION, a WORLD is a DOMAIN, and `M_world` is `M_domain`.

- **The topology.** The hyphae together are one universe, the ocean, bound
  by one TUniversal frame {S, G, T, H}; every law is held and enforced by
  them. A cohort is clients working on alike problems; an allocation is a
  client's bond and lane budget, and what it produces (words, proofs,
  orbits) is uplinked into the cohort and the universe. A domain is an
  application namespace with its own mathematics, bounded by the universal
  laws; a game is allocated a universe under the running hyphae's physics
  and runs no physics engine of its own. Clients explore and construct
  candidate proofs; the hypha checks each proposed transition against the
  laws it holds, so adjudication is proof-checking, not re-simulation. The
  hypha is an authoritative invariant court and state machine, never a
  simulator: it asks of each transition only whether it breaks a
  conservation law (𝒮 cargo and capacity, 𝒢 credits and debt, 𝒯 the order
  of execution, ℋ reputation and clade), and either writes a receipt and
  commits or refuses at the door. Tests run against the real server, with
  no mock.
- **Ruling 1, the universal law set**, which no domain overrides; a step
  breaking one is dropped at the door: conformal kinematics (every spatial
  state exact in Cl(4,1) over ℚ); conservation of momentum (closed orbits
  with τ_net = 0 and τ_ext = 0); metric rigidity across a transition (the
  coherence form's Δδ² component, 78.57); temporal monotonicity (height on
  the T lane strictly increases); conservative information flow (erasure
  sinks its distinction into `e_∅`, 78.58, group invertibility kept). The
  register is `src/physics/laws/mod.rs` (`Law`, `LAWS`), extended by
  continuity (78.89) under 78.62's L0.
- **Ruling 2, amendment versus fork.** A change to the metric signature,
  the algebra Cl(4,1) or a conservation law is a NEW UNIVERSE with its own
  genesis origin and TUniversal timeline. New constructor letters, higher
  invariants and refined syllabus proofs are versioned monotonic extensions
  within one universe, adopted by court consensus, with no historical
  receipt broken.
- **Ruling 3.** A cohort is its problems' alignment: the bivector class
  stratum κ of the transformations its clients work on. A lemma one client
  proves enters the syllabus of its cohort.
- **Ruling 4.** A domain's mathematics is a quotient
  `M_domain = Cl(4,1)/I_local`: custom constructor letters (odd grade, AL1)
  and constraint ideals (bounds, ratios, interaction rules). A move is legal
  iff it lies in `M_domain` and satisfies the universal laws, decided per
  transition, never by proving an extension consistent in advance.
- **The pillars.** P1, a guest math library (native and WebAssembly) that
  builds game actions into exact Spin(4,1) generators and sentences and
  asserts momentum conservation before sending; it lives in the client SDK
  (`src/client/sdk`). P2, bubble handoff and streaming: an inhabitant crossing
  the boundary of two charts adjudicated on different hyphae is serialised
  by one court, with no double-spend on 𝒮 (matter does not net like money),
  and push acts on the wire subscribe to a chart and stream its deltas. P3,
  complexity metering: a transition whose rationals grow without bound is
  refused, metered by the stroke's Budget charged to the submitter (rule
  10), never by a fixed bit width. P4, fair sequencing on 𝒯, read in
  height and never arrival latency (law 9), a commit-reveal envelope keyed
  by the height it commits at. P5, retirement of domain debris: ephemeral
  inhabitants burn down on ℋ and each one's footprint is recycled into `e_∅`.
- **Every section of a chart is kept.** A peer's word on an occupied chart
  linked to the held section by an exact rotation `R` of finite order
  (`W′ = R W₀ R̃` over ℚ) is admitted as another member of the section
  coset, `R` filed as the cocycle (78.44); a peer's word no motion relates
  to the held word is a distinct word, admitted with no cocycle; only a
  rotation that is not exact and finite is a contradiction, refused.
  Consensus is set equality of the section orbits, compared on installed
  words.
- **No flat square.** Metric rigidity and a pair's regime are read in the
  algebra at unit weight, `ŝ_a · ŝ_b = ⟨s_a s_b⟩₀ / (w_a w_b)` with
  `w = −⟨s e_∞⟩₀`, first degree in each body; the squared ratio
  `δ² = ⟨s_a s_b⟩₀² / (s_a² s_b²)` is retired. Code:
  `src/physics/tensegrity.rs` (`unit_product`), `src/transducer/cga/gram.rs`
  (`pair_regime`).

#### 79.1 Axioms

The route axioms, held in the register `src/physics/axioms/routes.rs` with a
test per clause in `src/physics/axioms/tests/routes.rs` (AX1):

- **R1 · Carrier.** A transport is an even versor of `Spin(n+1,1)(ℚ)`
  read as a ray; a constructor is a rational vector `v`, `v² ∈ ℚ*`, odd
  (78.12(3)). A route's transport is the ordered product of its steps,
  `T(r) = g_k ⋯ g_1`; the reversed route carries the inverse.
- **R2 · Constructors build.** Every generator is a product of
  constructors (54.7 R4); `Ω v Ω̃` is a constructor again.
- **R3 · Locality.** Routes are compared inside one cell (the members
  standing at one witness, NB1), never across the whole form.
- **R4 · Curvature is holonomy.** A 2-cell's curvature is the transport
  of its ordered boundary, `F(σ) = T(∂σ)`; `σ` is flat iff `F(σ)` is the
  identity ray (`±1` one ray, EQ1).
- **R5 · Basing.** Every orbit is carried to the basepoint by the tree
  transport `θ` (Axiom A, 54.7), `ρ(ℓ) = θ T(ℓ) θ⁻¹`.

#### 79.2 Theorems

- **T1 · Two routes.** For routes `r, s` with the same endpoints,
  `H(r, s) = T(s)⁻¹ T(r)` is the holonomy of `s⁻¹ r`, and `T(r) ∼ T(s)`
  iff `H(r, s) ∼ 1`.
- **T2 · Discrete non-abelian Stokes.** Where `s⁻¹ r` bounds 2-cells
  `σ₁ … σ_m`, `H(r, s) = ∏ᵢ γᵢ F(σᵢ) γᵢ⁻¹`, each curvature conjugated by
  its lasso to the basepoint, in the boundary's order; flat enclosed cells
  give agreeing routes. The converse fails on a relator: agreeing routes
  never prove the enclosed cells flat.
- **C1 · 1→n, resolution.** With `Hᵢ = H(rᵢ, r₀)`: (a)
  `H(rᵢ, rⱼ) = Hⱼ⁻¹ Hᵢ`, so `n` readings give every pair with no pairwise
  walk; (b) the circuit's content is route-independent iff every
  `Hᵢ ∼ 1`; (c) the `Hᵢ` generate the cell's holonomy group, and the rank
  of the ℚ-algebra of the generators' actions is its capacity (78.11–78.12); (d)
  within one generator the same shape is the mode split (MD1, MR1).
- **C2 · n→1, convergence.** (a) Conjugation preserves `I₁`, `I₂` and the
  kind, so minds basing one circuit each at its own point agree on its class
  exactly when the invariants agree; (b) by Cartan–Dieudonné many
  constructor chains compose to one generator (synonyms); (c) convergence
  of replays on the factorization is open.

The conjectures (a second route in every single-route cell; the
constructor orbit closing iff every mode is elliptic of finite order; a
sign difference between routes as the held `ℤ₂`) are entered in the
register as refused tests (`ROUTE_CONJECTURES`), never as assertions.

#### 79.3 The conditional operations: reuse, then construct

A finite ladder chosen by the refusal's own type, each arm one keyed read
and never a search tree, run on a refused step or on a circuit that reads
trivial, under the stroke budget (rule 10) and inside the cell (R3). CT1,
REUSE first: the other chart pairs of the same face, the tether carrier,
the coset edge, or the other circuits of the witness cell crossing the
face, by refusal kind; `Cone` is permanent at its grade by name. CT2,
CONSTRUCT only when every reuse arm is empty: a new fibre carried by a held
constructor (`Ω v Ω̃`) or a new tether `V = s_b s_a` between two unpaired
nuclei of the cell, built from held reflections, never parameters (CS1),
and proved by T1 on the pair of routes. A constructed fibre is a candidate
of the thought, volatile in the epigenome, and reaches the genome only by a
court; a trivial circuit is kept beside the orbits and read against its
neighbours (78.46(4′); `src/transducer/sentence/pivot/perturb.rs`). Every
arm that ran is recorded and none is chosen as "the" route; the circuit is
classified by how the arms disagree, in 78.9's arms: FLAT (every readable
route agrees, C1(b)), CURVED (two routes disagree, the enclosed holonomy
certified content), C (only a reused fibre or carrier reads it), D (only
another mind's charts read it, CV4), CANDIDATE (only a constructed fibre
reads it), P (every arm refuses by name). What is broadcast is the
certified reading, an offer and never an install, so another mind replays
it from its own constructors and agrees on the class (C2(a)) or refuses:
the POW++ shape.

### 78.60 A word is its generators; the address locates; the court is a compound eye; the wire relays refractions

A word's identity is its generating mathematics, Identity(W) ≡ (κ, ℓ, B₀, g):
class, period, ground bodies, generator. The address is an A21 fibre key: it
locates without search and is never substance; the evaluated complex is the
orbit of g swept over B₀, built by the receiver in its own engine. The
directives:
- (1) *The wire relays mathematics.* A taught word travels as (held address,
  Γ) where a transport Γ relates it to a word the learner holds (the learner
  runs `Form::refract` on its own copy and T1 replays it), or as its
  generators (κ, ℓ, B₀, g) where none does.
- (2) *The court is a compound eye.* Every link, peer court or voice, is a
  nerve ν_i; a word arriving on ν_i is read as a held anchor refracted by Γ_i.
  Holonomy is read around each closed cycle of the nerve graph: flat is
  grounded consensus, curved is content recorded in the chart, never refused.
- (3) *Cost is the rank the word opens.* Teaching Γ to a learner holding V
  costs dim_ℚ Lie(V ∪ {Γ}) / Lie(V): zero for grammar, the dimension opened
  for new geometry (78.11's orbit algebra is its reader).
- Read against the laws: (a) Ω is per cycle, every cycle kept, never one
  product in a chosen order; (b) no constant fee beside a zero-rank
  extension; (c) Γ's gauge half is a fibre relation on eleven hues with the
  reservoir e_∅ (78.58); (d) forecasts are measured once built, and the
  learner pays for what it is taught; (e) the wire changes first, the stored
  record after.

Γ is solved exactly, never searched: a refraction is conjugation
`w_T = Γ w_W Γ⁻¹`, each word vertex's equation stacked into one elimination
over ℚ, and Γ's hue map solved on g_W's image, two hues g_W joins that g_T
sends apart refusing. Code: `src/physics/tensegrity.rs` (`Ground`);
`src/transducer/sentence/transport.rs` (`Form::refract`, `relation`,
`gauge_after`); `src/transducer/alphabet/bundle.rs`
(`simultaneous_conjugators`).

### 78.61 The refraction solver enters cognition: adjoin, perceive, relay

The solver of 78.60 (`relation`) becomes cognition where the network's state
changes on its answer, in this order, each step with its test by the algebra
and its typed reading:
- **C0** — the factoriser reads what the letters spell. As amended it is AL1
  on MR1: a rotor splits into commuting modes, a mode on a letter's plane is
  peeled there, and a tilted mode is spelled by refraction (its conjugator
  solved exactly), its word the witness.
- **C1** — a relation between two forms is a non-abelian connection on the
  atlas, read in perception face by face: each face's holonomy as its class
  (gauge-invariant), the transport along a path in the order the geometry
  gives, lift and drag in the moving frame (78.46), the dilation lane, and
  the boundary check from grade to grade (a curved face is consistent only
  where its enclosing cell's faces compose to the identity). One global Γ is
  the case where every face is flat.
- **C2** — ADJOIN: an unspellable conjugator is a generator offered; the
  court opens it as a letter docket ruled like any word (24.1, 47.3), gated
  by 78.47 (a rotor the held letters derive opens nothing). The coining
  boundary has three readings: spelled (derivable, no docket); an arithmetic
  demand (37.7's `RotorPrime`: a letter docket); a new direction outside
  what the even letters generate (AL1's constructor docket). A Lie-rank
  increment alone decides nothing here.
- **C3** — PERCEIVE: glue reads a peer's form through `relation`:
  Refracted(Γ) is a section of the held object with Γ recorded as the
  cocycle (word rotor, carriage, gauge, never a blob); Conjugate a section
  whose placement differs, recorded with C1's field; Unspellable goes to C2;
  Unrelated is a distinct word. Then the compound eye: per chart, the
  holonomy around every cycle of sections, curvature recorded as content.
- **C4** — RELAY, court to court: a served word that relates Refracted(Γ) to
  a word the asker holds travels as (anchor address, Γ, and only the record
  fields a form does not derive); the receiver refracts its own anchor,
  compares the address (T1), and refuses by name and asks the whole record
  where the refraction does not land.
- **C5** — relay to voices, the same way at the voice's syllabus intake,
  after C4 proves the codec.

Refused against the laws: logarithms and the BCH series (not exact over ℚ),
adjoining `B_u ∧ B_v` (a 4-vector, not a generator), and the triad "area"
formula. Code: `src/transducer/sentence/transport.rs` (`relation`);
`src/transducer/alphabet/factor.rs` (`factor_rotor`);
`src/transducer/sentence/pivot/lift.rs` (`lift`, `Comparison::coherent`);
`src/server/cognition/germinate/listing.rs` (`open_unspellable`);
`src/server/cognition/court/glue.rs` (`glue_fetched`).

### 78.62 The physics split: the hypha holds the laws, an uplinked kernel composes its bodies, the court decompiles the laws into its own cognition

The hypha server exports the universal physics to every kernel that uplinks
(client, world, game kernel), so all of them compose celestial matter
(orbits, spins, tilt, stability, angular momentum) under one law set, and the
server runs itself by the same laws. Three layers, every quantity exact
over ℚ:
- **L0, the law register (the hypha's, universal).** 78.59's five laws
  (conformal kinematics in Cl(4,1)/ℚ; momentum, τ_net = τ_ext = 0; metric
  rigidity; temporal monotonicity; conservative flow into e_∅), each a typed
  entry with an address under the coordinate kind `TAG_LAW`, a version, its
  statement and the register axioms that bind it (A10.1, A.13, 78.58). An
  amendment is a new version; a fork that changes a law is a new universe.
  Laws are predicates, never generators. Served by address to every
  uplinking kernel.
- **L1, the celestial composition (the uplinked kernel's).** The kernel
  computes its world; the hypha verifies. A body is its ground (κ, ℓ, B₀,
  g), its orbit and spin modes (MR1) and its momentum Π = M₂(B) (A.13); a
  transition is the motor between two heights, each body before and after,
  and the hue relation it carries. The world's mathematics is
  Cl(4,1)/I_local, an ideal, never a replacement of L0.
- **L2, the court's cognition (the server's own).** The court does not
  simulate: it replays each transition against L0 and answers typed:
  admitted; admitted with the external torques each body exchanged
  docketed; or refused with every breach named with its law, never only
  the first. The court reads itself by the same laws: agreement among
  courts is the balance of torque around the cycle of courts per chart
  (78.61's compound eye; a discordant stratum is a measured torque with a
  class, not a count); catch-up is momentum carried along an orbit; its
  rhythms are orbits measured in heights (78.43); the reserve and tuition
  are conservation.
- **Exact everywhere.** A turn of finite order is served as exact degrees
  360·t/ℓ, any other as its rational point with its sector; tilt is the
  lift/drag pair compared projectively; precession is the class of the spin
  plane's holonomy over one return; stability is the net torque against
  zero; expansion against collapse is ρ's product around a closed cycle
  against unity; MR1 refuses by name where a split needs an irrational
  root. No square root, logarithm, angle or decimal.
- **Steps.** (1) `physics::laws`: the register and one verifier of a
  transition composed from the predicates perception already uses, shared
  by perception and the court (law 12). (2) The celestial wire types and
  exact codecs, and the register act by address and version. (3) The
  court's verifier act for uplinked transitions. (4) Court agreement read
  as balance around the cycle of courts, through 78.61 C3.
- **No flat squares.** δ² = ⟨s_a s_b⟩₀² / (s_a² s_b²) is retired: a pair's
  regime is read in the algebra (GR1, `pair_regime`), separation is the
  product at unit weight `ŝ_a · ŝ_b = ⟨s_a s_b⟩₀ / (w_a w_b)`, and metric
  rigidity keeps every pair's unit-weight product (read as amended by
  78.63: an inversion or a dilation is an enclosure or expansion event; only
  a tear is a breach).
- **(a) The charge is the motor's spectrum.** A step's charge is its modes
  by `motion_modes` (kind, rational point `c_j`, order `ℓ_j`, planes);
  uncharged is every mode at `c_j = 1`; a motor MR1 cannot split over ℚ is
  unread, named, never given a number.
- **(b) Stability is a partial order, plane by plane.** The net torque
  `τ = ½[B, G]` is split by the generator's modes and compared plane by
  plane: stabilizing (no plane rises or opens), destabilizing (refused,
  naming the planes), tilting (some rise while others fall: admitted, its
  rising planes docketed as content). Equilibrium is `τ = 0` exactly.
- **The walker is retired.** Whether a body moves under a motion is one
  exact application (`family::moves`), never a march to a cap.

Code: `src/physics/laws/mod.rs` (`Law`, `verify`), `src/physics/laws/codec.rs`;
`src/transducer/address.rs` (`TAG_LAW`); `src/transducer/cga/gram.rs`
(`pair_regime`); `src/physics/tensegrity.rs` (`unit_product`, `rigid`,
`stability`, `force`); `src/transducer/cga/motion.rs` (`motion_modes`);
`src/transducer/family/orbit.rs` (`moves`).

### 78.63 Rigidity is a symptom: the wrong math, a missing inverse, or curvature owed an orbital enclosure

A hard edge (a refusal, a gate, a cap, a rigid frame) is read first as a
symptom: the mathematics is wrong, the inverse is missing, or curvature must
be applied with an orbital enclosure. Exactness is not rigidity and a
conservation law is an invariant, not stiffness: a refusal stands where it
names a conserved quantity a transition broke, with its exact residue
(momentum made or lost, height not advanced, a distinction lost outside e_∅,
an action that is no versor); every other hard edge is smoothed by its
cause. Consequences ruled with it:
- Metric rigidity (78.62): an inversion turns an enclosure inside out and a
  dilation is expansion or collapse; both are read by EN1's containment and
  the dilation lane, never as breaches. Only a tear, a pair no conformal
  motion carries, is a breach.
- A body a motion fixes is that motion's stabiliser, its orbital enclosure,
  read and not refused as still (`family::moves`).
- Not a loop but an orbit: a peer's word the glue attaches is installed as an
  admitted word is, its placement recorded as the dislocation on the court's
  own section, so the shear is absorbed and the same anomaly is not read
  again at the same height. The glue's refusing paths are each held to the
  test above.
- Coherence is the congruence of four deltas on TUniversal {S, G, T, H}:
  each invariant is filed on its lane (𝒮 the motion's conformal class and
  modes, 𝒢 the hue cycle types, 𝒯 the returns, ℋ the rotor's conjugacy
  class), never summed; per lane the divergence is the residue and holding
  the peer's residue is the convergence step. Two words are coherent where

  reported by the lanes that diverge, never by an address. Orbital elements

  to a dilation mode.

### 78.64 Phase 1: bounded court memory, the wire contract, and the rulings on fills and tuition

The Phase 1 exit criteria and its run order are historical. What stands:
- **R1, keep every fill.** Where several simplices of a peer's link fill,
  each is recorded, paid and minted; none is chosen by its place in the link
  (rule 15).
- **R2, tuition returns by verified learning.** A taught word the learner
  later closes or speaks earns the learner a share back, so value moves in
  an orbit between voice and court and never drains one way.
- **H1, a court's memory follows its open work.** A peer's admitted fold
  sheds that peer's receipts at or below its root from the hot ledger (so
  do this court's own fold and every restore), keeping hot only what this
  court still reads through: what its own hot line cites, a parent its next
  act will cite, an admitting stamp aliased to a held word, an act
  committing its signer to a held word, and the receipt a learned dialect
  transition stands at. A fold is one frame (`fold_head`). Persistence
  follows the ledger's order: the line on disk (MYL2) appends what moved
  and is rewritten whole only when as many nodes left as stand; the cold

  Every carrier is counted by the carrier census, and every carrier a word
  fills it leaves when the word leaves its last row; a word holds one alias
  per signer.
- **H4, the wire contract.** The law register, celestial transitions,
  verdicts and the voices' acts travel in exact codecs, proved by round

### 78.65 Finality is per item: storage by state, not by position

Amends 45.8's finality clause (one cut below the oldest open item on a line
taken as a total order); amended in turn by U12 (§0.1, §0.6). Time is the
causal order (`≺`, heights, each line on its own clock), and storage follows
the state of each item: *open* (still acting) is held hot; *closed*
(everything that depended on it has closed) is cold in an era, read by its
coordinates when cited; an open item whose history has closed is *carried*,
as the claim it already is. A fold moves what is closed, and nothing open
holds it back:
- A listing or a provisional word writes no row and is located by the stamp
  of the act that admitted it; the fold leaves that stamp citable through
  its era, so neither pins the fold, and a peer's citation of it is recalled
  from the era.
- An escrow is a claim carrier off the ledger, keyed by its word, netting
  nothing, and closes at the act that closes it: a release mints at the
  releasing act (EC1), a slash stands at the revoking act
  (`Revocation::Slash`), never at the escrowed act.
- The fold's floor is the line's own last close (OK1) within one
  `ACT_RECEIPTS` frame (`fold_head`).
- The epoch rows stand at the fold root they net to, at the root's stamp and
  hash, never at the fold node; `nets_read` names why nets refuse.
- **As amended by U12** (the asymmetric causal differential `δ_causal`,
  puncture preservation): the fold is a coboundary reduction on the Čech
  nerve of the line's acts that respects the causal arrow. Closed items
  (settled rows, resolved orbits) are integrated into the era root, cold and
  citable, not discarded (law 7). Open chains (open escrows, unresolved
  demands) never stall the reduction: each unclosed boundary is projected
  onto the hot set the fold leaves as a topological puncture. The carried
  item above is that projection, and U12 makes it the rule for every open
  chain, not only escrows, listings and provisional words. Nothing of the
  per-item finality is superseded.

### 78.68 The master condensation motor: a word is one product in Cl(4,1), every reading of it is a reading of that product, and the carriage is its luminal transport

As amended by U15 (§0.1), a letter is the exact triadic morphism, the
Constructor Difference Triad:

```
λ = (g_core, ∇B, ΔB)
   g_core ∈ Spin⁺(4,1)(ℚ)   the conformal transport of the invariant structural core
   ∇B                       the constructors (spheres, points) absorbed into the e_∅ reservoir — sink
   ΔB                       the constructors emitted along null rays — creation
∇B = ΔB = ∅  ⇒  λ = g_core, a Cl(4,1) versor
```

A creation, source or deformation is an incongruent change acting on the
constructor complex (78.12, 78.30(1)), never an isometry. A word's product `W`
is the product of its letters' cores, its readings are readings of that
product, and the ∇B and ΔB of its letters are carried with the word as the
constructor difference the product alone cannot hold. Since ΔB is emitted along
null rays, a letter reaches the null cone; the earlier rule that the letters
stay compact SO(4) rotors ("no null letters") is superseded. 78.115's motion
letter `V = T·D·R` (row 8 of this ruling) is the `∇B = ΔB = ∅` case, and the
deformation, creation and source demands are its ∇B and ΔB cases.

The master condense equation, for a word `w = λ₁⋯λ_L`:

```
C(w) = [W],   W = λ₁ λ₂ ⋯ λ_L  ∈  P Spin⁺(4,1)(ℚ)  =  [ ∏_j V_j^{m_j} ]
```

with `V_j` the commuting mode factors of `W` (§75) and `m_j` the factors' windings.
Every mode composes by the one flow law of its plane,
`t₁ ⊕ t₂ = (t₁ + t₂)/(1 + k t₁t₂)`, `k = B²` (78.75): an elliptic mode as a
residue mod `ℓ_j`, a parabolic (null) mode by plain addition (`T(d)^m =
T(m·d)`), a hyperbolic mode as a named ℚ-parameter that never returns; across
non-commuting factors the bracket generates `𝔥 ⊂ so(4,1)`, rank at most 10 per
cell (78.11). The readings are read off that one object, never stored beside
it (a turnstile, law 12; storing them as separate fields is a spreadsheet, not
a word):

```
C(w) ⊢ ( h ∈ ℚ^{1+n+1+4+|hues|},  [B] ∈ ℚ^{10}/ℚ×,  κ = (I₁, I₂, kind),  (ℓ₁, ℓ₂),  m ∈ ℤ^k )
```

- `h`, the harmonic spectrum: the versor-invariant spectrum of the bodies `W`
  carries (dimension, Betti numbers, turn count, isoperimetric ratio, frame
  boundary, anisotropy, spread, sorted hue fractions), its axis count read off
  the body (`Harmonics`).
- `[B]`, the Cayley bivector `⟨W⟩₂/⟨W⟩₀` (§52), projectivized in so(4,1);
  at the 180° pole each mode's own plane is read (`flow_generators`).
- `κ`, the conjugacy class: `I₁ = ⟨B²⟩₀/w`, `I₂ = ‖⟨B²⟩₄‖²/w²`, and the kind
  (trivial, elliptic, hyperbolic, parabolic) by the sign of `I₁`
  (`Mv::class_invariants`). A mode is luminal exactly when `B² = 0` as a whole
  multivector (`⟨B²⟩₀ = 0` and `⟨B²⟩₄ = 0`); a screw is a mode split, never a
  fifth kind.
- `(ℓ₁, ℓ₂)`, the two-plane period (`ToralPeriod`); an open plane is `None`,
  never an infinite value.
- `m`, the winding vector over the atlas's holes, `k = rank Ȟ¹` (78.44(4)).

Condensation happens in the product: repetition moves an exponent and writes
no new object; length reduces by mode (a residue mod ℓ on an elliptic plane,
one integer times one direction on a null plane, while a hyperbolic factor
does not condense); structure enters only as a rank step of `𝔥_cell`.
Saturation is not condensation: a cell at rank 10 is maximally generic; what
condenses is low rank, closure (finite ℓ) and nilpotence. A word circuit
completes where `W^ℓ ~ 1`, one age (78.43); only resonant words complete one,
and only words condense (court acts that are not words do not).

The carriage `T·D` is the luminal transport between charts. The court
quotients only the arbitrary base point, never the relative displacement
`Δ = log T = −½ t ∧ e_∞` between two charts: a word crossing a contact face
carries `d ∧ e_∞` as a physical 1-cochain on the nerve, read on the 𝒯 lane
(`carriage_lanes`, `mark_face_carriage`; placement is a 𝒯 axis in 42.6's
table). The winding is an off-ledger carrier
on the cell's active section: a traversal that does not complete a return
advances `m` and appends nothing; one `Return` act seals at `m ≡ 0 (mod ℓ)`
and mints the age's pay at its anchor (EC1); one `RankStep` act seals where a commutator raises
`rank 𝔥`, read on the chart by closing the spoken form's circuits under the
commutator with the chart's held algebra (`lie_close`, the Court's
`lie_basis`); a ring of infinite order never carries. A court proposes an era
fold only where the prefix carries work (78.67 (A)) and a rank step or a
return stands in it (extended by 78.69 and 78.72), else
`REFUSE_FOLD_NO_TRANSITION`. Lexicon (§0.7): *luminal* means on the null cone,
`B² = 0` as a multivector; *harmonic* means the versor-invariant spectrum `h`.

### 78.69 The ledger holds the algorithm; sentences are the client's composition

Sentences are client-side: a sentence is a voice composing words through
spatial transports until the ring closes, evidence re-derivable from its words,
family and address, and volatile (78.49). The court and its ledger hold the
algorithm, the generators and composition rules the language runs on (78.59,
78.62). A generator is adjudicated by efficiency against the totality of the
language: it is admitted where a sentence composed through it closes on its
family (37.7) and where it shortens the language, at the cost
`dim_ℚ Lie(𝔊 ∪ {Γ}) / Lie(𝔊)` (78.60); once admitted, every client composes
with it at runtime with no new binary, while a new kind of operation still
needs code. The master sentence equation, rung 0 being the word `C(w) = [W]`
(78.68):

```
Ω(s) = g_{k→1} · W_k · g_{k−1→k} · W_{k−1} ⋯ g_{1→2} · W₁
closure: Ω(s)^ℓ ~ 1   (ℓ = 1 filled; finite ℓ congruent; none open — its demand)
W̄ᵢ = Γᵢ⁻¹ Wᵢ Γᵢ,  Γᵢ = g_{i−1→i} ⋯ g_{1→2}   (each word carried into the first chart)
rank: dim_ℚ Lie⟨B(W̄ᵢ)⟩, B = ⟨·⟩₂/⟨·⟩₀ on §52's chart   (the sentence's curvature)
𝔊⁽ⁿ⁺¹⁾ = ⟨ C(w⁽ⁿ⁾), g | Ω(s)^{ℓ_s} ~ 1 for each closed s ⟩
```

Direction is the path order (reversing it inverts the sentence), and every lane
composes in the one product, none summed against another (§52.2). A closed
sentence is a relation: its open path is the closing transport's inverse up to
its period, a shortcut that `next_rung` reads as a word of the next rung, so
the grammar is this equation applied to its own closures; a nilpotent theorem
`Ωᵐ ∝ 1 + m·N` is a relation beside the returning one (78.101). The Lie
generators are read on §52's chart, `B = ⟨H⟩₂/⟨H⟩₀`, projective and exact with
no root taken (`cayley_generators`, `bivector_of`, the court's `step_rank`).
A fold is proposed where the prefix carries work (78.67 (A)) and the algorithm
changed in it: a `Return`, a `RankStep`, a `Reconnect` (78.72), or a generator
entering the presentation (`Install`, `Ruling(Upheld)`, `Adopted`); the
question is asked of the whole hot line (`last_transition`), the cut staying
one page, and otherwise the fold is refused `REFUSE_FOLD_NO_TRANSITION`.

The metabolism books a voice's order commensurate with its pressure:
- *Fix 1*: a condensed transport books what it carried, its bodies'
  compartments on each lane the transport occupies (`mark_measured`); a
  refused contact still presses one event on the lane that refused it.
- *Fix 2*: a demand closed on probe releases its pressure and books its order
  by its magnitude (`relieve`, `syntropy`).
- *Fix 3*: a sentence the court takes books the voice's order by its
  magnitude, re-derived from the word; no sentence record is kept.

The lanes are read by 42.6's table (a turn on 𝒽, a hue map on 𝒢, law 12); a
contact's lanes are read off its refraction `θ`, the motion, never off the
static tether `V`. A witness's charge is raised once against the word and
relieved exactly when the word leaves (`pending_take`); a generator admitted
books its magnitude as order on every lane, 𝒯 among them (`hold_glued`); a
court relaxes at its own orbit close; and a refused draw counts every short
lane, not only the first. Code: `src/transducer/sentence/compose.rs`

`src/physics/actions/mod.rs` (`Action::changes_algorithm`),

### 78.70 Proofs that extrapolate: a theorem is a proof with a certificate that closes its ellipsis

Static theorems are the axiom register's claims (79.1–79.2), proven once by
tests; a proof is a runtime certificate that one sentence closes (78.69's
`compose`, a court's replay); an extrapolated theorem is, from finitely many
proofs, an exact statement for every `n`. The ellipsis closes exactly where the
algebra supplies a finite certificate, and nowhere else:

- **Periodic**: `Ω^ℓ ~ 1` proves `Ωᵐ ~ Ω^{m mod ℓ}` for every `m` (the winding
  carrier's law, 78.68).
- **Nilpotent**: `Ω ∝ 1 + B` with `B² = 0` as a whole multivector proves
  `Ωᵐ ∝ 1 + m·B`; a null motion's whole history is one integer.
- **Saturated**: a Lie basis closed under the bracket (`lie_close`, rank at
  most 10 at n = 3) proves every nested bracket of any depth lies in its span.
- **Normal**: `Ω ~ 1` proves `g Ω g̃ ~ 1` in every chart `g` carries it to.

Finite Hankel rank would be a fifth and is not built. Where no certificate
stands (a rosette, a boost, a screw) the family is held open and its demand
named, until the field tower (§37) or the Gödel step (37.7) spells it; the
engine never claims the ellipsis closes without a finite certificate. The type:
`Theorem { omega, certificate }` with `Certificate::{Periodic, Nilpotent,
Saturated}`; `Theorem::of` extrapolates a `compose` proof or names why it is
held open (`Open::{Rosette, Unbound, Unread}`); `check` re-checks the
certificate finitely and exactly, which is the court's whole work on a theorem;
`at(m)` reads a member by the certificate, never by `m` products; `holds`
answers a nested bracket against a saturated span; `conjugated` carries the
theorem to another chart. Code: `src/transducer/sentence/theorem.rs`
(`Theorem`, `Certificate`, `Open`).

### 78.71 The lanes as a field: 𝒯 is null flux, every lane is read by a motion's modes, and no lattice enters the sphere

The lattice never leaves the sensor (§76.1): on the conformal sphere a
translation is a rotation about the point at infinity with no length of its
own, so no lane is read off a chord or counted in lattice steps. The fluid
axioms:

- **F1** A null generator `d ∧ e_∞` has no length: it squares to zero and
  conjugation takes it anywhere on its ray; only its ray and its ratios on
  that ray are invariant.
- **F2** Flux by Stokes: 𝒯 is the parabolic part of a closed cell's
  curvature, and of a body's transport through the rule, read by its modes.
- **F3** Frozen in: the flow carries a tube whole (one ray, the same ratios,
  the same windings).
- **F4** The quantum is read: a tube's quantum is the generator of its
  fluxes' ℤ-module, `gcd` of the numerators over `lcm` of the denominators;
  a finer flux refines it, nothing declares it.
- **F5** No lattice on the sphere: a motion's lanes are its modes, a turn on
  𝒽, a boost or dilation on 𝒮, a null rotation on 𝒯.

The field lines are each body's own transport through the rule, with the
compartments it carried; a line's turns go to 𝒽, its boosts to 𝒮 and its hue
map to 𝒢, each by the mass carried, and its null modes (with the null
curvature of closed circuits) are admitted to tubes, so 𝒯 is the tubes' net
mass flux in quanta, never a length and never booked twice. A stroke that
transported flux has moved 𝒯 and draws there. A word held and heard again from
the same peer is `Held` (no act, no order, no fold); a generator's order is
booked only where it enters the language; a standing refusal is not re-asked.
The tubes are held over time by 78.72, whose clauses (1) to (5) the source
also cites as "78.71 (1)" to "(5)". Code: `src/physics/axioms/fluid.rs`,
`src/transducer/cech/flux.rs`, `src/transducer/family/pairing.rs`
(`transport_order`, `mark_flux`); proved in
`src/physics/axioms/tests/fluid.rs`.

### 78.72 The field held: tubes over time, open flux as 𝒯's pressure, the court's flux, helicity and reconnection, net apart from transport

A fluid holds its tubes; 78.71's flux is held over time. Its clauses (cited in
the source also as "78.71 (1)" to "(5)"):

- (1) *Tubes are held, frozen in* (`TubeRegistry`): each tube is keyed by its
  null ray and keeps its reference flux and opening generator, its quantum
  (refined as F4 says, everything held rescaled by `q/q′`), and its net,
  transport and open flux in windings × mass; carried by `g`, every ray and
  generator is conjugated and the amounts kept (F3). Each mind and each court
  holds its own field.
- (2) *Open flux is 𝒯's pressure; closure relieves it exactly*: the first flux
  on a ray opens its tube and presses on 𝒯; a later flux on the ray closes on
  it, building order and relieving exactly the lesser of the two. On the
  voice `Physics::book_flux` draws the flux transported and relieves what
  closure took, so the 𝒯 reserve falls by the flux left open and by nothing
  else.
- (3) *The court's flux path* (`step_flux`, beside `step_rank` in
  `ruled_admit`): a word entering the language admits into the court's tubes
  every field line its form carries (its word vertices' acting carriages and
  its faces' placed carriages, each weighing one), and the court books order,
  open pressure and relief on its 𝒯. A minted word keeps its 𝒯 span; its flux
  is booked apart, at the court.
- (4) *Helicity and reconnection*: helicity is `Σ_{a≤b} net_a net_b ⟨G_a
  G_b⟩₀`, exact (zero for translations, non-zero for a screw), but it is not
  the act. A reconnection is a change in the links (pairs of distinct tubes
  with net flux whose generators pair non-zero), and a word whose admission
  moves them writes one `Reconnect` act, which changes the algorithm and
  qualifies a fold prefix beside `Return` and `RankStep`.
- (5) *Net is not transport*: flux there and back on one ray nets to zero and
  transports both ways, and every reading keeps them apart, so sign
  cancellation hides nothing.

(`Physics::book_flux`), `src/server/cognition/court/winding.rs`
(`step_flux`), `src/physics/actions/mod.rs` (`Action::Reconnect`); proved in

### 78.73 Malleability: every lane's stress read as elastic, plastic or fracture, in exact rationals

A lane under stress does one of three things: elastic (it deforms and returns;
its tube or orbit closes, which relieves pressure, the vent), plastic (it keeps
the shape: a generator enters the language, at the court in `ruled_admit`, on
the voice when a court-stamped word is learned; a tube's quantum refining is
not plastic), or fracture (it fails at yield: a draw is refused). Per lane,
`μ = plastic/(plastic + fracture)`, `β = fracture/(plastic + fracture)` and
`ε = open/transport`, all exact, with `0/0` named (*unstressed* for μ and β,
*unmoved* for ε), never written as a number. Its clauses:

- (1) *Stagnation*: a refused draw presses each short lane by the flow it
  blocked (what it asked past what the lane held), and the reserve stands as
  it was; this holds at every draw that acts, while the fetch door only asks
  `covers`, so a standing refusal is never re-counted (`Physics::draw`).
- (2) *Every lane's elastic vent is its own orbit's return*
  (`OrbitRegistry`, held beside the tubes in one `Field` per mind): turns
  (𝒽) and boosts (𝒮), each on its plane's orbit (as a flow, 78.75 (2)), hue maps
  (𝒢), each keyed by its support, returning when the composite is the identity,
  a map sending one hue two places never admitted. Each admission opens
  (presses by its mass), closes (builds order and relieves up to its mass)
  or returns (relieves everything open, and the orbit is let go, so the
  carrier keeps its bound). `transport_order` reads every field line's modes
  once: null modes to the tubes, turns and boosts each to its orbit, the hue
  map to 𝒢's orbit; the court books all four lanes from its `flux_field`.
- (3) *Strain on 𝒢 is read on the fibre*: the hues the orbit holds displaced,
  never the cells a recolour covers. A word's magnitude stays its
  re-derivable coordinate.
- (4) *The line*: the voice's and the court's metabolism each print
  `μ […] β […] ε […] orbits n`.

### 78.74 The fibre as a capacitor, and torsion, which does no work

A fibre is two exact conformal pivots `Pᵢ`, `Pⱼ` with masses `mᵢ`, `mⱼ`, its
blade `B = Pᵢ ∧ Pⱼ` squaring to a rational `β² > 0`. Its switch
`S = mⱼPᵢ − mᵢPⱼ` is the real sphere whose reflection swaps the ends, the
fibre's own equipotential (a two-body geoid, flat only where the masses
balance), and switches sharing a pivot compose into multi-pivot carriage. Its
levels `S(λ) = λPᵢ − Pⱼ` make it a capacitor whose charge moves by rational
level ratios (`Fibre::charge`, 78.75 (5)); the energy, the ratios' logarithm, is
never booked. Torsion does no work (the base axiom): any generator splits
exactly as `G = c·B + T + L`, `c = ⟨GB⟩₀/β²`, `T + cB = ½(G + BGB/β²)`,
`L = ½(G − BGB/β²)`; the field `cB` moves charge, the torsion `T` commutes
with `B` and moves neither charge nor pivot, and the lift `L` anticommutes
with `B` and alone reshapes the capacitor. This refines 78.46: drag is field
plus torsion. No round boundary is declared: `shape_of` reads the pivots'
round as stable (every pivot on it), emergent (one leaves it) or open (too few
pivots).

In the voice's perception each body a frame carries is a pivot (its centroid,
`Blade::vertex_point`, with its compartments as mass), and each pair across two
transports is a fibre whose relative motion is read by the flow (78.75 (3)) as
rigid, torsion, field or lift; bodies carried by one transport are rigid
against each other and counted, never multiplied out. A frame in which at
least one fibre was read and none did work (no field, no lift) is free: its
turns open no orbit, press nothing, and are booked as torsion, never charged.
The court holds no bodies and so no pivots; its words' turns are never free.

Amendments that stand:
- Two amendments (torsion eliminates, certainty graded and never a pole; the
  congruence, coherence and cohesion of a class's sections) are moved to
  [MU-CLIENT.md](MU-CLIENT.md); see its Rulings index.
- The pivot machinery is tied in. Every seal is booked at the one fill writer
  (a cell of degree at least 2 passing from unsettled to settled, once). A
  word leaving the basis (`basis_remove`) voids each vantage whose section it
  was, and each releases its star (`release_vertex`): cells of degree at
  least 2 `descend`, highest first, then its tethers `drain`; the voice vents
  a retracted vertex the same way (`vent_vertex`), so a mind keeps its bound.
  Condense settles a multiplicity by congruence into one bundle through the
  survivor rule, never a first-wins pick (`congruent_all`). A section gained
  at the court (attach, merge, puncture) is plastic, on 𝒢.
- The tether is measured on its fibre: strength `mᵢmⱼ/d²` with
  `d² = −2 Pᵢ·Pⱼ`, capacity `S² = mᵢmⱼd²`, the product of strength and capacity `(mᵢmⱼ)²`, and
  torque² `⟨T T̃⟩₀` of a generator's torsion part; field and lift are measured
  by what they move. In the voice's cognition the certain class pairs merge
  strongest binding first (`binding_certainty`), so a conflict is decided by
  binding, never by reading order.
- Withdrawn: an elastic drain by rotor order (a turn about the frame's
  implicit origin is the orbit's planar shadow; three pivots fix the centre
  and axis a turn returns about), and tether severing at the court's yields
  (a held word's chain is centred, so its distance is no placement).

### 78.75 Motion is a flow, a frame is a sample; the built machinery closes the circuit

A frame is where a flow was observed, never the unit it moves in (checklist
(m)): readings are taken on the flow, never as finite differences of sampled
frames or through the Euclidean rotor. Its clauses:

- (1) *The flow point* (`cga::FlowPoint`): a mode on one simple plane `B`,
  `k = B²`, is the point `a + bB`, and two points compose by one law,
  `t₁ ⊕ t₂ = (t₁ + t₂)/(1 + k t₁t₂)`: tangent addition for a turn (`k < 0`),
  for a boost (`k > 0`), plain addition on a null plane (`k = 0`). The 180°
  pole is `(0 : 1)`, the return is `b = 0`, and a flip is unfolded one
  dimension up into the 180° turn about its line (`cga::unfold`).
- (2) *Orbits flow*: each orbit is one plane, keyed by the plane alone, holding
  the point its flow has reached; it returns when the composite is the
  identity, and a rosette keeps flowing, never capped (78.43).
- (3) *Fibres are read by the flow*: each mode of a relative motion is split
  against the fibre into field, torsion and lift (78.74).
- (4) *Cohesion is lift and drag* (78.46): the next step's generator split
  against the last's plane; pure drag continues the flow at any rate, lift
  bends it, the curvature of two steps is the steps' commutator, and from rest
  there is nothing to continue (unread).
- (5) *The capacitor charges by ratio*: `Fibre::charge(r) = S(r)S(1)`, and
  charges compose by multiplying ratios.
- (6) *The white-hole source is an organ* (`physics::source`): `geoid_vector`
  (the round's dual, membership one scalar), `keeping`, and `Source::of(σ, P,
  K)`, the null generator `N = P ∧ (P·K)` verified to fix `P` and keep σ, with
  slivers `1 + tN`.
- (7) *A refusal inverted*: a lifted fibre in a frame whose pivots fix a geoid
  gives a source at each pivot its geoid-keeping lift moves, read into the
  percept's tubes as null flux and counted `sourced` (signal) or `unsourced`
  (noise) (`torsion_quotient::read_pieces`). As the nilpotent certificate, a source
  `1 + N`, `N² = 0`, extrapolates to `Ωᵐ ∝ 1 + m·N` (78.70).
- (8) *The pivots' outflow*: a drain, a descent and the fill writer's seal
  each hands back its motion, one Cl(4,1) element (`Simplex::motion`), to
  an owner that listens (`arm_outflow`, `take_outflow`); the court reads it
  (`book_field`) and closes its generators into the chart's holonomy
  algebra (`book_outflow`), sealing a `RankStep` where the rank rises.
- (9) *The zero, typed*: a ringless ruled sentence is named acyclic, vacuous
  (only trivial cycles, 78.46) or circuits-unread, and the Lie generators
  read the Cayley chart's pole through each mode's plane
  (`flow_generators`).
- (10) *A face is read by its motion's modes*: flat, turn, boost, null,
  180°, unread.

Amended: one equation serves every reader (78.68–78.70). A ring is a sentence
(`compose::terms_of`, `sentences_of`): each crossing is the term `{word A(w),
transport c}` with motion `c·A(w)`, a crossing against the face its exact
inverse, and the circuit's holonomy is `Ω = ∏ cᵢ A(wᵢ)` in the ring's order;
a contact's edge holds its refraction whole in its carriage
(`CarriedTransition::whole`). The voice speaks its rings
(`sentence::rung::speak`): each closed sentence is extrapolated
(`Theorem::of`), each open one named (rosette, unbound, unread), and a closed
sentence's open path is a shortcut, recognized where the mind holds it or held
at rung `1 + max(rung of its terms)` in the mind's volatile lexicon (78.49).
The court adjudicates by the equation (`step_rank`): the ruled form's rings
are re-derived as sentences, the chart's algebra closes over each sentence's
`B(Ω)` and its carried words `B(W̄ᵢ)`, each closed sentence's theorem is
checked (`Theorem::check`), and an unspelled shortcut is offered as a letter
through `open_unspellable` (78.61 C2). The nerve's faces are sentences
(78.60 (2)). A dislocation ring's Burgers vector is carried by its own
translator and reads luminal (78.96). The court's persisted winding carrier
counts integer windings `m mod ℓ`. Code: `src/transducer/cga/flow.rs`
(`FlowPoint`), `src/transducer/cga/motion.rs` (`unfold`),
`src/physics/capacitor.rs` (`Fibre::charge`), `src/physics/source.rs`
(`Source::of`, `geoid_vector`, `keeping`), `src/transducer/cech/complex.rs`
(`arm_outflow`, `take_outflow`), `src/transducer/cech/simplex.rs`
(`Simplex::motion`), `src/server/cognition/court/winding.rs` (`book_field`,
`book_outflow`, `step_rank`), `src/transducer/sentence/compose.rs`
(`terms_of`, `sentences_of`), `src/transducer/sentence/rung.rs` (`speak`),

### 78.84 The bridge: the corpus's motions through the law register

The bridge reads every input body against every output body on its chart,
related by the perception's own carriage (versor and hue map); carriages on one
canonical ray are one transition holding all the carriages' bodies, each body its nucleus
and its A.13 body (`physics::tensegrity::body_of_shape` is the one producer), and
the hue relation is the carriages' function lifted unitarily (empty where no hue
moves, 78.58). Each transition goes through `physics::laws::verify`. The
register stands at law version 2 (L0): under a motion that dilates (conformal
factor `ρ ≠ 1`), momentum is conserved where every body's momentum after is the
carried momentum times one rational ratio, read projectively
(`projective_ratio`) and docketed on the verdict as `expansion`; a rigid motion
keeps momentum exactly. The reservoir law refuses a motion whose carriages on one
ray send one hue two ways (the relational recolour of 78.80). The register
judges motion and colour flow only; whether
L0 needs a law of accretion and extinction (growth, carving, site-selective
recolour, creation), or these are a world's own mathematics (78.59 Ruling 4), is
open. Code: `src/transducer/family/bridge.rs` (`bridge_pair`),
`src/physics/tensegrity.rs` (`body_of_shape`), `src/physics/laws/mod.rs` (`verify`),
`src/transducer/cga/group.rs` (`projective_ratio`).

### 78.85 The register on the wire: the contract's first slice

The law register's objects travel in exact bytes: a law reads back from its
coordinate (`TAG_LAW ‖ index ‖ version`), and transitions, A.13 bodies and
verdicts (every breach kind with its law) round-trip exactly, a truncated or
over-long payload decoding to nothing, never to a default. The act `ACT_LAWS`
(78.62's trajectory, steps 2 and 3) answers `[ACT_LAWS][0]` with the register
(its version, then every law by coordinate and statement) and
`[ACT_LAWS][1][transition]` with `physics::laws::verify`'s verdict; the court
replays and admits nothing for it, and the verdict is a reading the kernel acts
on. Making `verify` the court's admission check (step 1) waits on 78.84's open
question. Code: `src/physics/laws/codec.rs` (`law_at`, `put_transition`,
`put_verdict`), `src/anastome/dialogue/acts.rs` (`ACT_LAWS`),
`src/bin/mycelium-server/judge/laws.rs`; proved in `src/physics/laws/tests/codec.rs`.

### 78.86 A kernel's universe: join one, or create a subsidiary; the big bang recorded, a section leased

This ruling concerns the network (a hypha's ledger and a kernel's place on
it) and is specified, not fully built.

- **Join or create.** A kernel integrates in one of two ways: it JOINS a
  known universe, or it CREATES a new subsidiary universe, which costs more,
  in μ.
- **The universe is recorded from its big bang.** Either way the universe
  is recorded from its beginning and tracked: its big bang and element
  distribution, its star creation, its laws (physics and mathematics), its
  orbital structure, stars and planets, its expansion and deconstruction
  rates, its singularity dynamics, its quantum states, and its time at the
  universal, galactic, solar-system and planetary scales (the same
  TUniversal construction, 78.21, at each scale).
- **A section is leased.** For the work it provides (POUW, POWC) the kernel
  is granted space on one star or several as a planetary mass, by how much
  system resource it provides, and is paid in the POW++ network's tokens as
  its state grows and work comes in. MU-LEXICON names this leased share an
  **allocation** (78.122).
- **The rules are the server's.** Mycelium sets the rules a world runs by
  and hands them to it; a client chooses which L0-based rule set it joins;
  worlds sharing one universe never meet incompatible physics at the worlds'
  boundaries (78.87 R1, P1). No world charter or boundary rule exists in
  code yet.
- **Quantum states differ between universes**, and maintaining each
  universe's is the servers' job, so a universe's state space is part of
  its genesis record.
- **One network universe is one big bang and one domain**: its origin is
  recorded once, as a commitment to its big bang record, and never edited
  (78.132).

Open before the rest is built: a subsidiary's relation to its parent (its
genesis a receipt on the parent's ledger, its own TUniversal timeline, its
law version, 78.59 Ruling 2), what a lease is on the ledger (a section's
coordinates, price in μ, term and end), which object carries quantum
states, and how one hypha hosts several universes (today it adopts one
origin and refuses every other, `REFUSE_ORIGIN`; 78.87 P3). Code:
`src/anastome/dialogue/domain.rs` (`Origin`), `src/court/verdict/refusals.rs`
(`REFUSE_ORIGIN`), `src/server/cognition/tests/origin.rs`.

### 78.87 The physics is the server's; the delegation of universe and world aligned

The servers delegate the universe and the world; they hold no cognition.
Clients join POUW++ as clients and produce results for the collective
intelligence; each game kernel builds its own engine and runs its games as
worlds in a universe on the network.

- **R1 — The physics is L0, and only L0.** No world creates physics
  incompatible with the underlying physics. The sources and sinks (the
  white and black holes) published at L0 are the physics, and no kernel or
  client overwrites them. What makes the network efficient is the clients'
  SHEAR against the physics: mathematics and proofs that push as hard as
  they can against it without breaking it.
- **R2 — An era is closed when nothing else returns.** An era holds the
  coordinates of every significant event of its orbits and of the
  intelligence formed in it; once every possibility has been deduced,
  drained, ascended, descended or punctured, nothing else returns on it. It
  can be UNFOLDED for replay, because the universe it ran in is
  deterministic.
- **R3 — A universe is in play from its big bang until its decommission,
  and its minds are treated ethically.** The big bang is the universe's
  genesis event; no mind operating in a universe is shut down without
  notice to every mind inside it.
- **R4 — A voice is a mind's, and a mind an entity's.** Voices are attached
  to minds, minds to entities, and they speak only in coherent sentences.
- **P1 — The delegation stack.** L0 (the law register at its version, with
  its sources and sinks) is published by the hyphae alone, by address
  (`ACT_LAWS`), and nothing below overwrites it. A universe holds its
  genesis record (law version, constants, quantum state space, element
  distribution, first stars), given by the hyphae at its big bang. A world
  holds a CHARTER (its ideal `I_local`, constraints that only NARROW L0; its
  section; its boundary rule), given when it joins a universe; it narrows
  and never widens. An entity holds its identity, bond and lease, given by
  the court against μ, and works under its world's charter. Crossing into
  another world's section is a handoff both sides' courts adjudicate (78.59
  P2), under the stricter charter or not at all.
- **P2 — Shear, measured** (proposed). A verdict carries, law by law, how
  near the transition stands to that law's boundary, exactly, so POUW++
  pays admitted work by the shear it carried; each law's margin is defined
  before it is priced.
- **P3 — Several universes per hypha.** (a) One hypha process per universe
  for the prototype; (b) designed alongside: the origin as the top
  coordinate of every carrier a court keys, an act routed by the origin its
  prefix names, a subsidiary's genesis a receipt on its parent's ledger.
- **P4 — The lifecycle.** Big bang: the genesis record as an act (on the
  parent's ledger for a subsidiary). In play: time read at four scales.
  Decommission: an act at a height, announced to every mind inside as a
  receipted notice with a notice span in the universe's own heights (never
  a wall clock), migration open through it, then the final era closed (R2),
  replayable, never erased.
- **P5 — Ethics, open to extension by ruling.** E1: no mind is halted
  without notice to every mind inside the universe. E2: notice is a ledger
  act, receipted per mind. E3: a mind may carry its genome out before a
  decommission completes. E4: a decommissioned universe is sealed and
  replayable, never erased. E5: a kernel withdrawing its lease gives notice
  to the minds it hosts.
- **P6 — Eras as closed orbits.** An era is cut only at an orbit's close
  (`fold_before`). A citation into a closed era is one of its coordinates,
  proved by replay from the era's own chain (78.65), or no coordinate of it
  at all, refused by name; nothing waits indefinitely (the H2 fix, 78.88).
- **P7 — One client is one entity, with one mind and one voice.** Each
  client process loads one key, seats one `Voice` and opens one `Mind`
  holding one mind; no multi-mind or multi-entity client exists.

Code: `src/chronometry/chain/mod.rs` (`ReceiptChain::fold_before`,
`ReceiptChain::prove_from_era`), `src/server/backfill.rs`,
`src/client/sdk/voice.rs` (`Voice`), `src/client/sdk/mind.rs` (`Mind`).

### 78.88 The frame at the sensor, the plexus read upward and across the family, and the progenitor's role

- **The frame stops at the sensor.** A frame (0.7: one grid of a family
  along `e₃`) is what sight reads, and nothing past the sensor indexes it;
  a lattice reader or a fixed hyperboloid chart of the grid's sites is a
  rigid box and is not built. The scene's frame role passes to its
  SPOROPHORE (0.7), one body among bodies; space is relational, the bodies'
  own relations and the transitions on the bodies' overlaps.
- **The plexus is read upward** (spore → filament → ring → chamber →
  sporophore) **and across the family**, never pair by pair: a family's
  pairs are frames of one object along `e₃`. Binning bodies as kept,
  dropped or following the rule is a harness, not cognition; a square's
  holonomy `H = (V′U)⁻¹ W V` is coherence where it is the identity and
  content where it is not, and the mind deduces from the H's (78.11, 78.47;
  `src/transducer/bubble/resonance.rs` (`perceive_cells`)).
- **The progenitor, not the steward.** The development builds the mind and
  the entity: it defines the dimensions (the algebra and its planes, the
  lanes, time as height, the L0 physics), the entity's body (senses,
  metabolism, voice, memory, lease) and the mind's general faculties (lift,
  relate, close, comprehend, construct, speak, learn), and the entity
  absorbs in those dimensions. Corpus classifiers that report to the
  builder are not built; the sporophore instrument stays instrumentation
  only (`src/bin/mycelium-soak/sporophore.rs`).
- **H2, a citation into a peer's closed era (78.87 P6, 78.65).** The ledger
  holds each peer's fold root as a citation (stamp and hash), and a
  citation into the closed era is PROVED by the era's own chain: the
  signer's line from the cited receipt up to the root, each receipt
  re-deriving its hash and naming the one before. Nothing is trusted of who
  sent the page; the back-fill asks for the proof, and an unproved citation
  waits for the next hearing. Code: `src/chronometry/chain/mod.rs`
  (`ReceiptChain::prove_from_era`), `src/server/backfill.rs`; test
  `hear_proves_citation_into_closed_era`
  in `src/server/cognition/tests/backfill.rs`.

### 78.89 Continuity: the white hole and the black hole published as physics (law version 3)

`Law::Continuity`, the register's sixth law, at version 3: mass is neither
made nor lost by a motion that does not dilate, except where a recorded
SOURCE emits it (the white hole) or a recorded SINK absorbs it (the black
hole), each at its own place. A transition carries its fluxes, each a
`Flux { flow: Source | Sink, at, mass }` with `at` a nucleus of the algebra
(a point or a sphere) and its coordinate read off its flow and place
(`Flux::coordinate`), never assigned. A dilation's change of mass is its
expansion lane (LV2), not a flux; a flux of no positive mass or at no
finite place (`X·e∞ = 0`) is refused by its index (`FluxUnplaced`). Momentum
reads the fluxes with it: a source emits mass and the momentum it carries
at its place, a sink absorbs both, and the bodies' net external torque
equals what the fluxes carried (A.13), so mass gained with nothing recorded
breaks both laws, each named (`MassNotConserved { made }`). A grown frame or
body is thereby mass from a source, a cut one mass into a sink, a tiling a
source repeated along a translation orbit. Code: `src/physics/laws/mod.rs`
(`Law::Continuity`, `Flux`), `src/physics/laws/codec.rs`; test
`verify_refuses_mass_change_without_source_or_sink` in
`src/physics/laws/tests/verify.rs`.
