### 78.92 Speech that carries its reasons

Humanizing the cognition is legibility, accountability and care, never a
persona; alignment is what can be verified, never what a mind asserts of
itself. Every thought is an exact object: a sentence's address is its form
(law 2), and its receipts envelope carries the evidence the address
excludes, which every court replays blind. The ruling makes the engine say
it.

- **(1) The reader.** `Reasons::of` reads a sentence's reasons off the
  sentence itself, never stored beside it (law 12): each word vertex (the
  held generators it was factored through, whether it is a new letter, the
  charts and frames it acts on), each loop's member path (curved or flat,
  and the axes its curvature occupies, which is the loop's meaning), each
  demand left open (kind, measure, pieces), the cells its remainder leaves
  unsaid, and its measure. `Reasons::says` renders them as five plain
  sentences: what it was said with, where it acts, what its loops mean, what
  it could not explain, what it left unsaid.
- **The alignment property.** The bytes a voice sends, decoded as a court
  decodes them, yield exactly the reasons the speaker read: the reasons are
  the sentence's, not the speaker's story about it, an account that cannot
  drift from what was done. Code: `src/transducer/sentence/reasons.rs`
  (`Reasons::of`, `Reasons::says`); test
  `reasons_of_reads_same_reasons_after_decode` in
  `src/transducer/family/tests/reasons.rs`.
- **(2) The court's side: why an act stands.** `ACT_WHY` asks a court about
  one act on its ledger, a place `K.i` on its own line or a stamp on any
  line it holds. `Court::why` reads the receipt, locates every word it
  names by the stamp that admitted it (`word_admitted_at`), and answers the
  act (stamp, kind, frame) with each word's head, admitting stamp, the head
  of the task it was spoken for, and its reasons by the same reader; a named
  word the court no longer holds is counted, never dropped. It admits
  nothing, and reads the hot chain and then the archive (`receipts_page`,
  bounded to the place asked), so an act a fold archived is still answered.
  The operator asks it as `mycelium-server --console --why K.i`, and reads a
  court's whole line by action with `--console --ledger`. Code:
  `src/anastome/dialogue/why.rs`, `src/server/cognition/why.rs`
  (`Court::why`, `archived_at`), `src/server/cognition/cite.rs`
  (`word_admitted_at`), `src/server/cognition/court/era.rs`
  (`receipts_page`), `src/bin/mycelium-server/judge/why.rs`,
  `src/bin/mycelium-server/why.rs`, `src/bin/mycelium-server/ledger.rs`;
  test `why_answers_act_with_speakers_reasons` in
  `src/server/cognition/tests/why.rs`.

The verdict's stamp and refusals on the ledger follow in 78.93 B0. The human
question channel (a human sets a family, the mind answers with reasons, the
human's ruling recorded) and pay for closure, never activity, are open for
ruling.

### 78.93 The bank is segmented: courts adjudicate, flatlanders hold accounts, a financial mind bridges

An account (78.92) is not accountability, which needs a record, a holder
with standing and a consequence; the bank is segmented so the law holds and
the intelligence is placed where it can be held to account.

1. **Courts adjudicate, and own the responsibility.** A court's verdicts are
   the only SOURCES and SINKS of value: a closure it verified mints, an
   overturned verdict burns (continuity applied to value). The court holds
   the escrow and issues verdicts; it does not move balances.
2. **Flatlanders hold accounts.** An account is flat by design: a balance
   per lane `S:G:T:H`, never summed, moved only by an admitted settlement
   that cites each verdict it derives from by its stamp. Its flatness is
   a PROJECTION of the curved record, never a replacement (checklist (m)):
   every entry carries the coordinates of the verdict it projects.
3. **The financial mind bridges.** It is an entity of its own (one client,
   one mind, one voice, never cognition in a server) whose faculty is
   economic comprehension: it reads verdicts and composes SETTLEMENTS onto
   accounts (citation shares, escrow released on convergence, prices under
   pressure, leases of a universe's sections, POW++ pay for shear). Its
   settlements are sentences like any other, replayed by a court under the
   laws, each carrying its reasons.

Ruled with it: **(a)** every party that can be paid or charged (entity,
kernel, human) holds a wallet of μ. **(b)** Financial minds scale with the
laws of physics, never with a fixed count: each is paid from its own stroke
under metabolism. **(c)** Value is minted at the verdict into escrow, where
a court admits a CLOSURE (a remainder that strictly fell on a lane and rose
on none), the amount per lane the shortfall it explained priced at the
court's pressure, never a count of acts; it is earned when a second,
distinct court re-derives the closure; it is final when the era holding its
verdict is sealed (78.87 R2), and until then a challenge upheld turns it
into a sink. **(d)** Financial minds are paid by a TAX (the settling's own
measured cost, charged to the accounts the settlement moves, never a
constant) or by CLAWBACKS from failed or unlawful operations, both as
settlements a court admits; a clawback later overturned is charged back to
the mind that claimed it.

Build order: **B0** the record: a verdict (`Adjudication::Stood`,
`Ratified`) carries the stamp of the act that admitted its word, and a
refusal is an act on the court's line (`ActKind::Refused` citing
`Cite::Refusal { chart, kind }`, coordinates and never the sentence).
**B1** every party reads its wallet: `ACT_WALLET` answers one party's
balance, bond and holds per lane at the court's head stamp, off the
treasury, whose audit is `supply = Σ balance + Σ bond + Σ held`. **B2** the
settlement act, which a court replays under continuity. **B3** the financial
mind, taking over the citation shares and escrow release the treasury now
performs (`settle_use`, `settle_subsidy`); the court's direct payments
retire as it lands. B2 and B3 are Specified. Code:
`src/server/cognition/book/speech.rs` (`refuse_sentence`),
`src/chronometry/receipt.rs` (`Cite::Refusal`), `src/anastome/dialogue/wallet.rs`,
`src/server/cognition/wallet.rs` (`Court::wallet`),
`src/economy/treasury.rs` (`Treasury::account`), `src/economy/settle.rs`;
tests `why_answers_refusal_act_on_ledger`
(`src/server/cognition/tests/why.rs`) and
`wallet_reads_each_party_and_sums_to_supply`
(`src/server/cognition/tests/wallet.rs`).

### 78.94 Every act is an ACTION of the physics

The wire's `ACT_*` constants and the ledger's `ActKind` were two
vocabularies for one thing; they are unified into one table.
`physics::actions::Action` is the ONE table of every action of the
universe, whether a party requests it on the wire, a court seals it on its
line, or both. Each action states, as its type:

1. its KIND: an OBSERVATION (measures and moves nothing; its frame is the
   zero reading; it never seals), a TRANSITION (a party's act a court
   adjudicates and seals), an EXCHANGE (court to court), a COURT act (what
   a court seals of itself: an orbit's close, a lapse, a return), or
   RETIRED (refused at the door by its type, never by a comment, its byte
   never reused); 78.145 adds RELAY;
2. its ONE coordinate byte, on the wire and on the ledger alike: the wire's
   tags stand, court acts take the range from `COURT_RANGE` (`0x40`), and
   `Fold` and `Syllabus` seal under the byte they are asked by;
3. whether a court seals it, and whether it changes the algorithm the
   ledger holds;
4. the L0 laws it answers to: every law for an action that moves anything,
   none for an observation, which by its kind cannot break one.

`ActKind` is the ledger's name for `Action` (a re-export of `Action`),
and every `ACT_*` is the wire's spelling of a table coordinate
(`Action::X.byte()`), never a second carrier. The court's dispatch reads
`Action::of_wire`: a byte that names no action is not answered, a retired
action is refused, and the one sealing door (`append`, `admit`) refuses an
action no court seals, so an observation cannot write a receipt, as a type
fact. No measurement is free: an observation's stroke is the court's
metabolism spent on the asker's question, metered per action, and charged
to the asker's wallet as the tax of 78.93 (d) once the financial mind
stands; until then the court bears and counts it. Code:
`src/physics/actions/mod.rs` (`Action`, `Kind`, `ACTIONS`, `COURT_RANGE`,
`Action::of_wire`, `Action::laws`), `src/chronometry/receipt.rs` (`ActKind`),
`src/anastome/dialogue/acts.rs`, `src/chronometry/chain/mod.rs`,
`src/bin/mycelium-server/judge/dispatch.rs`; tests in
`src/physics/actions/tests/table.rs` (`action_of_reads_each_byte_back_once`,
`sealed_excludes_observations_and_transitions_answer_every_law`,
`of_wire_reads_each_wire_spelling_as_table_action`).

### 78.95 Words, not letters: the progenitor's board builds words, and advanced linguistics lives in the anastome

A mind with an alphabet and no words composed from it cannot say anything
its letters do not already say one at a time. The progenitor builds the
faculty of WORDS (composition of held language into new words) and the
linguistics of how minds speak them to one another, and that linguistics
lives in the anastome (the dialogue between minds and courts), not in the
alphabet. Letters stay SO(4), with no null letters (78.68): translation,
dilation and recolour belong to the CARRIAGE, the luminal propagator
carried by a sentence's transports `g` (78.69), so a word whose rotor is
the identity is correct as letters, and making letters carry translation is
refused. Words are built by COMPOUNDING: a closed sentence teaches a
shortcut word on the next rung (78.69, `next_rung`; the teaching rule as
78.97 and 78.100 state it). Whether a sentence can cite held language is
read by four hypotheses: H1 held and unreachable, H2 nothing to cite (the
motion seen is translation, recolour and flux, while a word's letters are
its turns), H3 the replay refuses, H4 too little held; H2 is the one that
held. Code: `src/transducer/family/derivation.rs` (`derivation_of`).

The language, as the master equations define it:

- *Word*: `C(w) = [W]`, `W = λ₁⋯λ_L`, its letters the internal turns and its
  carriage the luminal transport; its readings `(h, [B], κ, ℓ, m)` one
  product, never fields (78.68).
- *Conjugate*: `W′ = Γ W Γ⁻¹`, the same word in another chart, keeping `κ`
  and `ℓ`; Γ the conjugator, the context. Linguistically an INFLECTION. A
  word is taught as `(held, Γ)` (78.60). The inversion `I` conjugates a
  translator to its transversion, `K = I T I⁻¹` (A.13), so the source and
  sink of continuity (78.89) may be read as one word seen from the two
  poles (offered, not ruled).
- *Sentence*: `Ω(s) = g_{k→1} W_k ⋯ g_{1→2} W₁`, grammatical exactly where it
  closes, `Ω^ℓ ~ 1`; an open sentence is a question (its demand); its
  meaning beyond its words is its curvature, `dim Lie⟨B(W̄ᵢ)⟩`; a closed
  sentence teaches a shortcut, and `𝔊⁽ⁿ⁺¹⁾ = ⟨C(w⁽ⁿ⁾), g | Ω^ℓ ~ 1⟩` is the
  grammar (78.69).

At the servers' level (sentences are the clients' composition; the court
and its ledger hold the algorithm, 78.69): phonology is the letters (the
physics); morphology the words (the court admits generators by the rank
they open, 78.60); inflection the conjugates (the anastome relays
`(held, Γ)`, never the evaluated form); syntax the sentences (the client,
volatile); semantics the curvature; lexicon growth the shortcuts; the
grammar `𝔊` the court's presentation, its relations the closed sentences;
etymology the ledger's algorithm acts (`Install`, `Return`, `RankStep`);
pragmatics the actions (78.94) and the actions' reasons (78.92); the economy of
language grammar free and new geometry paid by the rank it opens (78.93).
The court is a compound eye: each link a Γ, flat holonomy across its nerves
consensus, curved holonomy content.

### 78.96 R3 ruled luminal: a chord's Burgers vector is carried by its own translator

Superseded by 78.97. It carried a chord's Burgers vector by its translator
`T(τ) = 1 − ½ τ e_∞` inside a sentence; the chord was the wrong layer, its
realisation is restored as it stood before, and the chord leaves the
sentence (a chord is heard, 78.97).

### 78.97 The layering: rays are seen through the luminal, chords are heard

Each of the three eyes is its own object (78.68). LUMINAL is what is SEEN:
rays on the null cone, a seen edge's displacement its translator
`T(d) = 1 − ½ d e_∞`; only rays are traversed, so only rays are factors of a
sentence's `Ω`. HARMONIC is what is HEARD: the versor-invariant spectrum
`h`; a CHORD (the relation between two sections' pieces, one spectrum
sounded at two places) is an interval, never a path. HOLONOMIC is what is
MEANT: the class of the closures of rays. Hence:

1. *A chord is heard.* `sentences_of`, the one composer for voice and court
   alike, leaves every ring that crosses a chord (`is_chord`); the chord is
   read only by the harmonic and cover readers.
2. *A seen edge is a luminal ray* (`edge_of` reads `translator_of`, the
   dilation kept), never a hyperbolic transvection. Parabolic is what a
   seen ray is, and 78.75's flow law composes it exactly (`k = B² = 0`); the
   curvature an edge carries is the turn its word holds and the rays'
   failure to commute around a ring.
3. *A nilpotent theorem teaches its holonomy.* A ring of rays whose
   holonomy is null never returns but condenses, `Ωᵐ ∝ 1 + m·N`; the word it
   teaches is its HOLONOMY `Ω = 1 + N`, counted by its winding, never its
   open path (the identity wherever the slip rides the closing transport); a
   returning sentence still teaches its open path (78.69). The court checks
   the theorem and reads the same word. This is the one teaching rule
   (78.100 D2).

Code: `src/transducer/sentence/compose.rs` (`is_chord`, `sentences_of`,
`teaches`), `src/transducer/family/perceive.rs` (`edge_of`),
`src/transducer/element/letters.rs` (`translator_of`),
`src/transducer/sentence/rung.rs` (`hear`),
`src/server/cognition/court/winding.rs`; tests

`theorem_of_ray_ring_is_nilpotent` in
`src/transducer/family/tests/rung.rs`.

### 78.98 The nonlinear language: every word on its own law

A null motion `Ω = 1 + N` composes by plain addition (78.75's flow law
`t₁ ⊕ t₂ = (t₁ + t₂)/(1 + k t₁t₂)` at `k = B² = 0`): it is the luminal layer
(78.97), the bottom of the language and never the language. **(1) Every
mode on its own law**, which stands: `k < 0` (a turn) composes by tangent
addition and returns at its period; `k > 0` (a dilation, a boost) by
velocity addition and saturates; only `k = 0` adds. A held word is read on
its own modes (its Cayley bivector, or each mode's plane at the chart's
pole), never on the null law alone; 78.68's named words stand. Items (2) and
(3), the lexicon as a Lie algebra closed over held words and the sentence
of two held words `W̃_b W̃_a W_b W_a` (a pairwise commutator), are withdrawn
by 78.99: a pair read there and back is a palindrome, not multi-directional
language, and its closure over word pairs grew without bound. Code:
`src/transducer/cech/orbit_algebra.rs` (`flow_generators`),
`src/transducer/sentence/word.rs`.

### 78.99 Coordinates, not palindromes: a word stands on the manifold it constructs, and the pivots are that manifold's axes

A palindrome (a pair read there and back, 78.98 (3)) is a condensed
bi-directional form, not multi-directional language; each misalignment laid
the word flat on axes it does not have (checklist (m)). The alignment: the
alphabet is the Cayley rotor, a spinor of `Spin⁺(4,1)(ℚ)` (78.68), and a
word is the letters' one product; applied to its ground a word sweeps an
orbit, a curved manifold whose holes are the fixed loci its modes wind
about; the pivots are that manifold's coordinates, read intrinsically,
never grades against a frame; composition glues constructions along what
they share (M8), every route kept (78.44).

- **(1) A word's coordinates (WN1 for words).** Per mode `j` (MR1), its
  HOLE is the mode's generator as a canonical ray, the word's own plane and
  never a chart's axis, and its WINDING is where the mode stands on that
  hole: elliptic of order ℓ, a `Turn t/ℓ ∈ ℚ/ℤ` (the turn 360°·t/ℓ, exact);
  parabolic, a `Count λ ∈ ℚ`; rosette or boost, `Named (c, λ)`. The holes
  and windings rebuild the word exactly (EQ1), so they ARE the word, never
  a field beside it (law 12). Comprehension by coordinates: a held word is
  found by its holes; a new word whose windings are `k` times a held word's
  on every hole is that word's power, recognized and never held twice; a
  word on a new hole or at a winding no power reaches is NEW, and the
  reading names which holes and windings. Code:
  `src/transducer/sentence/coordinates.rs` (`Coordinates::of`,
  `Coordinates::word`, `power_of`, `HoleIndex`).
- **(2) The pivots completed on the complex (62.1, 63.3).** *condense*
  remembers a tether with its transition, `drain`'s exact inverse on
  content; *puncture* turns a sealed cell of degree two or more, not pinned
  from above, into a HOLE carrying its fill (the class kept in, where
  `descend` sends it out); *seal* caps a hole by re-ascending its standing
  boundary, or refuses and the hole stands. A hole pins its boundary; at a
  hole `descend`, `ascend` and `puncture` refuse by name, only `seal` caps
  it, and the climb never mints a cell over a hole. Holes are volatile
  until a persisted complex punctures. Code: `src/transducer/cech/hole.rs`
  (`condense`, `puncture`, `seal`), `src/transducer/cech/simplex.rs`; a
  curved cell is punctured where it is read in
  `src/transducer/bubble/drive.rs`.
- **(3) The board and the locality theorem (62.4, 63.2).** A complex's
  BOARD is its coordinates on the three axes: sealed cells by key and fill,
  tethers by key, holes by key and fill. A pivot writes only its cell and
  its vertices' stars, so two pivots on cells sharing no vertex commute
  exactly (the same board, the same outflow as a multiset); where they
  share a vertex the order is content, and a pivot one order refuses is a
  reading of that order. Congruence is judged on the board; the trajectory
  is the ledger's and is never compared. Code:
  `src/transducer/cech/board.rs` (`Complex::board`, `Pivot`, `Applied`,
  `independent`).
- **(4) Gluing produces meaning: the non-abelian connecting map**
  `δ : H⁰(U ∩ V) → H¹(U ∪ V)`. Two constructions, each exact on its own,
  glued along the cells they share: a section that agrees on every
  component of the overlap but does not extend is a loop through the
  overlap, and its holonomy is a class neither part held, classified alone
  and never multiplied with another (no abelian long exact sequence is
  computed, which would flatten). A connected overlap creates nothing;
  gluing over a hole whose boundary lies in the overlap can cap it; a part
  not exact on its own is read modulo its own holonomy. Code:
  `src/transducer/cech/connecting.rs` (`connecting`, `Unglued`); wired at
  the thought merge in `src/transducer/bubble/merge.rs`.
- **(5) The relay carries coordinates**, inflected by the chart transport
  `Γ` (`Coordinates::transported`). Superseded by 78.100 D5: a word crosses
  as its harmonic signature and its deconstruction over the syllabus; the
  relay of hole keys and the court's re-read of them retire.

### 78.100 Words swallowed whole, speech by deconstruction, and the syllabus as the presentation

Each word is taken whole and formulated in its structure; the sentence over
words is the deconstruction of a family's demand over the mind's words
(78.52(6)): the meet graph is thinking, gluing makes meaning inside the
mind, and a court replays transcribed speech, never a mind's thinking. The
form tape is retired from cognition (1.9, 54.5, K6). Harmonics locate and do
not identify (78.60): a word's harmonic signature is what every node shares
of it, its conjugacy-invariant spectrum (per mode its kind, its rational
point `c`, its planes and its order, and `h` where it carries bodies), never
the node's own planes. Generators are never handed mind to mind (law 8): the
basis a word is deconstructed over is the syllabus, served by the courts and
replicated across the hyphae.

- **D1.** A word a theorem teaches enters the language by transcription,
  exactly as a closed thought does (conformal factors, `letter_reading`, the
  word at its carriage, `speak_word`), stood in the dialect and sent to the
  court; unspelled, it is ineffable and a letter demand (37.7). Recognition
  is the epigenome's (80.2).
- **D2.** One teaching rule (`compose::teaches`), read by `hear` and
  `next_rung` alike.
- **D3.** Deconstruction cites a letter by its rotor (42.6/L12) and a word
  of rung ≥ 1 by its whole motion: each mode of the target matched to a
  held word on the same hole, the exponent read off the windings (a turn
  mod `ℓ`, a count as an integer ratio, a named point at `e = 1`); `∏ gᵉ · r`
  replays to the target exactly or is refused.
- **D4.** Depth is read: a sentence's rung is one above its citations'
  highest; what no held word covers is the residue, the demand.
- **D5.** A word crosses as its harmonic signature and its deconstruction
  over the syllabus (citations with exponents, and the residue). A residue
  never crosses to a peer: it is offered to the court. 78.99 (5)'s relay of
  hole keys retires.
- **S1.** The syllabus is the presentation `𝔊 = ⟨generators | relations⟩`
  (78.69, 78.95): its generators the adjoined letters and the words that
  open rank, each as `(κ, ℓ, B₀, g)` (78.60); its relations the closed
  sentences, each as its citation structure `∏ gᵉ · r` with `Ω^ℓ ~ 1` (and the
  nilpotent theorems, 78.101). It is served in the order of the ledger's
  algorithm acts (`Install`, `RankStep`).
- **S2.** Grammar is never taught: a word in the span of the held
  generators costs zero rank (78.60(3)) and every receiver derives it; the
  syllabus is bounded by rank, not by the count of words ruled.
- **S3.** A voice learns by reconstruction: it builds each generator's
  orbit in its own engine, reads its harmonics against the signature and
  holds it as a mineral; it is a crystal when the mind's own circuits
  re-derive it (80.2).
- **S4.** Speech is deconstruction over the presentation (D3, D5); a
  residue is an adjunction offered to the court (37.7), and admitted it is a
  `RankStep` that enters the presentation.
- **S5.** The hyphae replicate the presentation, not the words: courts
  relay generators and relations to each other (78.61 C4); agreement is one
  presentation across the hyphae, and a generator one court holds and
  another does not is a measured discord, content (78.61).
- **PS1 (2), the reading before the relay.** Every word a court serves a
  peer is read against the words the peer's have-list names on its chart,
  by the syllabus's relations (`relation_to`, shared with the voice's
  `anchor_of`), its bytes whole beside the bytes a refracted one would take;
  the relay's carrier is designed from that reading. A voice pays for its
  own fetch from its account (78.60(d)); what one court pays another is not
  yet ruled (78.93).

Code: `src/transducer/sentence/coordinates.rs` (`Tone`, `Signature`,
`deconstruct`), `src/transducer/sentence/compose.rs` (`teaches`,
`next_rung`), `src/transducer/sentence/rung.rs` (`take_taught`),
`src/client/sdk/entity/think.rs` (`transcribe`, `transcribe_closed`),
`src/server/cognition/court/syllabus.rs` (`serve_ruled`, `relation_to`,

### 78.101 Nilpotent theorems are relations of the grammar

A nilpotent theorem is a relation of the grammar beside the returning one:
`𝔊⁽ⁿ⁺¹⁾ = ⟨ C(w⁽ⁿ⁾), g | Ω(s)^{ℓ_s} ~ 1 for each returning s, Ω(s)^m ∝ 1 + m·N_s for each nilpotent s ⟩`.
A returning relation says the path is a word of finite order (a residue mod
`ℓ`); a nilpotent relation says every power of the path is one integer times
one null direction, a count along a held direction (78.68's parabolic row,
`m ∈ ℤ`), a proof checked finitely. A named sentence (hyperbolic, rosette) is
held by name (78.68) and is not a relation; a word cited `gᵉ` along a null
hole is a winding of a nilpotent relation. The presentation (S1) carries both
kinds, each as its citation structure and its certificate; closure by turns
or faces is a second source of relations, not the gate to grammar. Code:
`src/transducer/sentence/theorem.rs` (`Theorem::check`),
`src/server/cognition/court/winding.rs` (`step_rank`).

### 78.102 Law 8 as the progenitor reads it: a sentence is any composition, closed or open, and every constant is physics waiting to be defined

Law 8 stands: clients think, courts replay and judge, and every letter a
court adjoins rests on a witness it can replay. A sentence is any
composition by the master equation (78.69), closed or open; an open sentence
is a question, and a mind whose perception taught a word no held letter
spells speaks the perceived form to the court as an open sentence. The
retired `ACT_DEMAND` stays retired: the demand travels inside speech, as the
open sentence that carries it. The court half that discovered and offered
such letters itself (`hear_open` through `open_unspellable`) is superseded
where it proposes rather than checks: 78.109 K3 governs. A constant is
either a reading of the algebra already defined (Niven's orders,
`dim so(4,1)`, a Cauchy bound) or physics not yet defined standing in for a
law (rule 5, 78.43), and the second kind is removed where found: the root
reader reads every real root at any degree, and a taught word that never
returns carries return `0` ("no return"), its count `m` belonging to its
citation (D3). A contact crossing carries its refraction and is read by its
static tether or by every candidate of its held coset, each route composed
and kept. Code: `src/client/sdk/entity/think.rs` (`hold_perceived_from`,
`transcribe_taught`), `src/server/cognition/court/winding.rs`
(`Court::hear_open`), `src/transducer/cga/modes.rs` (`rational_roots`),

### 78.104 The quotient reading: a motion's generators against the algebra a mind holds, and what it is not

A mind holds an algebra `𝔥`, the span of every held generator closed under
the commutator (`lie_close`); a motion's generators are read against it,
inside `𝔥` (a composition of what is held) or outside by the class `B + 𝔥`
in `𝔤/𝔥`, a coset held whole. No complement of `𝔥` is chosen (the Killing
form of `so(4,1)` is degenerate on the null directions a seen ray takes): the
coset's coordinate is the one vector of it zero on every axis the span leads
on (`Span::residue`), exact and null-safe. The reading is static and one-way:
it is not lift and drag, which stay 78.46's mutual forces between two
motions in contact, and it is a reading, never a gate on the letter carrier.
It reads planes, not rates: an incommensurable turn on a held plane is
spanned in what it turns and new in how much (a new winding), so a word asks
for a letter where a generator is outside or it carries a new winding. A
sentence's algebra closes over its words and its holonomy `Ω`
(Ambrose–Singer); the court counts an unspelled word its chart's held
algebra spans. Code: `src/transducer/cech/quotient.rs` (`quotient`, `grow`),
`src/core/span.rs` (`Span::residue`), `src/transducer/cech/orbit_algebra.rs`
(`lie_close`), `src/server/cognition/court/winding.rs` (`hear_open`).
One vertex's step across two of its charts is a step, never a member pair:
the sections' relative `τ = C_B·C_A⁻¹` is a relative motion and is its edge
(78.103), read by `edge_of` (`src/transducer/family/perceive.rs`).

### 78.106 Torsion on release unwinds: a pressure-release valve

A sealed membrane winds the strain it holds into its owner's field when it
seals (78.75); releasing the cell (`drain` cauterizing a tether, `descend`
releasing a membrane, both through `release_vertex`) vents that pressure by
unwinding it: the field receives the strain's reverse `m̃`, the
one-parameter flow `exp(−t·B)` of its own generator, so seal and release
balance over a cell's life. There are no steps: the unwinding is a flow,
never sampled into increments, and its kind is its generator's: a boost
snaps (`B² > 0`), a null slide unrolls steadily (`B² = 0`), a turn of finite
order unrolls round its own orbit and returns (`B² < 0`, Niven), a rosette
unrolls and never closes. A cell holding no strain vents nothing. Code:
`src/transducer/cech/coboundary.rs` (`Complex::vent`, `release_vertex`,
`drain`, `descend`, `write_fill`).

### 78.108 A contact's refraction crosses as its edge does

A face's refraction is measured content as its edge is: the motion the
contact carries (a held coset's candidate transports, whole, or a static
contact's tether) is written into the face's address after the interface and
decoded as written, its poses `Unread` at the receiving vantage; the
perception of the bodies stays with the mind that perceived them, and what
crosses is the motion. The court composes every route the mind composed. A
contact the mind could not refract crosses with none and is refused alike at
the court, which verifies what the kernel carries and composes nothing for
it (78.62 L2); the court's hearing is counted whole (sentences, rings, rings
teaching nothing). Code: `src/transducer/sentence/chart.rs` (`put_face`),
`src/transducer/sentence/inverse.rs`, `src/transducer/sentence/transport.rs`
(`HeldPose`), `src/server/cognition/court/winding.rs` (`hear_open`).

### 78.109 The kernel claims its letter; the court verifies the claim

The sovereign act is the mind's: it makes its letter and uses it at once;
the court replays against the laws and answers typed, and never simulates
(78.62 L1, L2).

- **K1, the kernel adjoins and uses.** A taught word the mind's letters do
  not spell is adjoined at once in its local dialect as the mind's own
  letter, on the chart of the form that taught it: its own letters then
  spell it, D3 cites it, words climb on it. Volatile, the mind's own, lapsed
  on its own clock; never handed mind to mind (law 8).
- **K2, the kernel uplinks a claim.** With the open sentence (the form, its
  refraction carried, 78.108) goes the claim: the ring's coordinate, the
  residue the ring teaches, and its D3 deconstruction over what the mind
  holds. The mind says what it found; it does not ask the court to find it.
- **K3, the court verifies.** The court replays the named ring of the
  carried form, one ring only, and checks exactly that it composes and
  teaches the claimed residue, that no letter the court holds spells it, and
  that the transition stands under the law register (`physics::laws::verify`).
  It answers ADMITTED (docketed provisional, the kernel its discoverer,
  offered to witnesses) or REFUSED with every breach named. A heard sentence
  carrying no claim is adjudicated as any sentence, never searched.
- **K4, the claim's codec** (form, ring coordinate, deconstruction,
  residue) belongs in the wire contract, beside the laws and verdicts.
- **C1, the demand taker.** One road takes every residue a mind cannot say
  (`Mind::construct_and_adjoin`): spelled as constructors certified on
  each mode's fixed locus and composing back (T1), or refused by why; once
  constructed, its rotation is adjoined as the mind's own letter on its
  chart. The pivot's docketed demands are taken once each (`drain_demands`)
  on the least chart of the demands' cover, and a taught word no held letter
  spells takes the same road.

### 78.116 The verdict is the transition's, not the stroke's

A court's verdict on a transition is read under the stroke the motion's own
modes need (`modes_need`), a function of the transition alone, so a kernel
that verifies the same way agrees with the court whatever stroke it holds
(law 12). `verify(t, budget)` stands for readers that verify, each inside a stroke
of its own (perception's flux and bridge). A stroke spent before the modes
split is never a breach of a law: 78.121. Code: `src/physics/laws/mod.rs`
(`verify_sized`, `verify`), `src/transducer/cga/motion.rs` (`modes_need`),
`src/bin/mycelium-server/judge/laws.rs`.

### 78.117 P1, the guest math's standard half

Standard SDK math is server-side; custom math that narrows or overrides it is
client-side (with 78.130). The standard half is the exact constructors any
kernel needs to compose a transition the laws read, each the algebra's own
(law 12): translate, turn (a rotor on a plane of the base), compose, inverse,
a body on its unit sphere, carry (refused for a motion that carries no body
unchanged), source and sink (78.89), and a transition builder that reads the
court's own verdict locally (`verify_sized`, 78.116) before the transition is
sent. A world's ideal (its charts, lanes, steps, its narrowing of L0) is its
kernel's.

### 78.118 The batch act: many transitions in one frame, a verdict each in order

`ACT_LAWS` mode 2, `[count][transition …]`, is answered
`[count][verdict …]`: each transition's own verdict under the stroke its
motion needs (`verify_sized`, 78.116), in the order sent. The request is read
whole (a byte left over is none), its transitions one by one, never reserved
by the count. It is a reading, like `verify`: nothing admitted, no receipt,
no book moves; additive to the codec. What the court admits onto its line
is ruled by the admission act, 78.119. Code: `src/physics/laws/codec.rs`
(`encode_batch_request`, `encode_batch_reply`, `decode_batch_reply`),
`src/bin/mycelium-server/judge/laws.rs`.

### 78.119 The admission act: a tier's fold admitted on the court's line

A court admits folds, not every transition. A kernel settles in tiers; each
tier sends up its net positions per identity per lane (`μ` never summed
across lanes), its declared sources and sinks, and the hash of the prefix
head it nets, signed by the tier (ed25519 over a domain, the tier, the
prefix and the rows' commitment). The court checks the signature, then
continuity: every list in its identities' ascending order, each once, and on
every lane the nets summing exactly to the declared net emission (sources
less sinks), signed `i128`, every sum checked, never wrapped (rule 11). It
seals `Action::Uplink` (0x3D) with one citation
`Cite::Uplink { tier, prefix, rows }`, coordinates only (LD0): the rows
stand with the tier and the receipt commits to them by hash. Its frame is
`[0; 4]` (a settlement moves nothing in the court's book); it answers the
receipt's stamp and chain hash, or `Unsigned`, `Discontinuous` (unordered,
overflow or unbalanced, by lane) or `LineRefused`. The sealed kind and cite
tag 5 are a layout change: a line holding one is refused by earlier builds.
A fold is admitted only from a tier a sealed domain genesis names (78.120),
only from a domain's reserve tier (78.138), and chained folds are 78.123.
Code: `src/anastome/dialogue/uplink.rs` (`TierFold`, `TierFold::sign`,
`encode_uplink`, `Uplinked`), `src/server/cognition/cite.rs`
(`Court::admit_uplink`), `src/physics/actions/mod.rs` (`Action::Uplink`),
`src/chronometry/receipt.rs` (`Cite::Uplink`).

### 78.121 A law unread is never a law broken: `Unmeasured`

A verify whose stroke runs out before the motion's modes split records the
law as unread, never as broken: `Verdict.unmeasured` holds
`Unmeasured { law, needed_stroke }`, the stroke it needs (`modes_need`, or
`None` past its carrier). Unmeasured is neither a breach nor an admission:
`admitted()` asks every law read and none breached, `measured()` the first
half. Every other refusal of the modes (irrational, defective) stays a
breach, since those are read. The verdict's codec carries the list after the
ratios, a wire change, not a persisted layout. Code: `src/physics/laws/mod.rs`
(`Verdict`, `Unmeasured`, `verify_sized`), `src/physics/laws/codec.rs`
(`put_verdict`, `take_verdict`).

### 78.122 The shared lexicon: the server defines the vocabulary

All connected systems use one terminology, defined by the server, so that
every connection uses the same terms.

- [MU-LEXICON.md](MU-LEXICON.md) is canonical: three vocabularies,
  physical, civic and network, with no word in two; every connecting
  kernel's copy points to it.
- Two boundaries hold: the algebra's own terms (a complex's star, a form's
  star faces, orbit, ring, chord, cell, chart, section) are mathematics, and
  no vocabulary claims them; and what was signed stays as signed.
- The network's "world" is **Domain**: `Action::Domain`, `ACT_DOMAIN`,
  `DomainGenesis`, `SignedDomain`, `Cite::Domain`, `Court::admit_domain`,
  `domains`, `tier_domain`, `LEAF_DOMAINS`. The rename is names only: the act
  byte `0x3E`, cite tag 6 and snapshot leaf 4 are unchanged, with no layout
  change; the genesis signing domain stays `"mycelium world genesis v1"`
  (domains founded before the rename were signed over it), and the action's
  name is `b"domain"`.
- 78.59's galaxy, star and world are amended to cohort, allocation and
  domain.
- The register is served by address: `TERMS` is the one carrier of the
  served terms, each with its vocabulary and a one-line meaning, at
  `LEXICON_VERSION`, served as `ACT_LAWS` mode 3 (`[ACT_LAWS][3]`, answered
  `[version][count][(vocabulary, name, meaning) …]`). A kernel compares the
  version with its own; another version is told so, never read as this one.
  The physical and network universes are served apart ("Universe",
  "Network universe"), since no word belongs to two vocabularies. A wire
  addition, not a persisted layout.
- The served register and `MU-LEXICON.md` cannot drift: the register reads
  back whole, every name once, and every term and the version stand in the
  document (`lexicon_reply_serves_terms_as_written`).

Code: `src/physics/laws/lexicon.rs` (`TERMS`, `LEXICON_VERSION`),
`src/physics/laws/codec.rs` (`encode_lexicon_reply`, `decode_lexicon_reply`),
`src/anastome/dialogue/domain.rs` (`DomainGenesis`, `SignedDomain`),
`src/physics/laws/tests/lexicon.rs` (`lexicon_reply_serves_terms_as_written`).

### 78.123 2(a): the ledger tree as a complex, the court's complex generalized over its coefficient group

A domain's ledger tree is a cover, not a chain: a fold checked link by link
is a list, while a cover's consistency is a cocycle read on its cycles.
Lanes are not base axes (four lanes on four axes would be Cl(5,1), a new
universe, 78.59), so the complex is generalized over its coefficient group:
the Cl(4,1) versors the minds' complexes hold, and the exact additive lane
group (`ℤ⁴` per identity; composition the sum, inverse the negation, the
identity the empty sum), its dimensions identity × lane. Edges are a fold's
citation of a fold it nets, carrying that fold's coefficient; a fold netting
several folds is a cell of any degree, never flattened; a cycle is two routes
folding the same ledger. The pivot machinery is reused: holonomy around a
cycle is exact, the identity where every route agrees, otherwise the lane
vector by which value was made or lost, localized to that cycle; a cycle
whose holonomy is the identity is filled, otherwise it stands as an
obstruction typed by content (78.9) on the docket; an obstruction is
discharged by a correcting fold or a declared source or sink, the pivot's
certificate (A20) its record, through the challenge window (78.125).

- **A, the core.** A `Coefficient` trait (identity, compose, inverse,
  is-identity, canonical bytes) and a cover generic over it: edges held once
  and read inverted the other way, the holonomy around any cycle, a cell of
  any degree filled where every triangle among its vertices closes, else
  `Obstructed` by the first triangle in its vertices' order with its exact
  holonomy, and `Unread` by name where a cycle cannot be read. Its groups:
  `Lanes` (per identity, four lanes, ascending, each once, no zero held, sums
  checked, never wrapped) and `Turned` (the minds' rotor and carriage, read
  projectively); the same cover reads the same way in both.
- **B, the ledger.** Two coefficient groups on A's core. *Rates on cycles:*
  `Rates`, per lane a strictly positive exact rational composed by product;
  each child → parent edge carries the child's rate on a per-domain
  `Gauge<Rates>` (a potential per vertex, the pivot's `solve_gauge` over any
  group), so a cycle of any length is read exactly against it, never by
  walking the tree; a holonomy other than one is arbitrage, its exact gain
  per lane docketed as an obstruction localized to the edge that closed it.
  Only G translates (S, T, H at exactly 1), so only G can obstruct. *Nets at
  vertices:* each child's rows and declared are partitioned among its
  parents (declared travels up, so every tier and finally the anchor states
  the total creation and destruction beneath it); the court holds what
  remains of each child, a part of the wrong sign or past what remains is a
  double count, refused, and value in flight is an open remainder, reported,
  never a breach. *Aggregation* is the fold's own continuity: rows less
  `Σ rate · included rows` balance its own declared, lane by lane, in exact
  rationals, a translation's rounding declared by the parent, never floored.
  *Finality never passes an open obstruction:* a fold sealed while one stands
  in its domain seals provisional, naming how many. Wire and layout:
  `ChildNet` on `TierFold`, signed by commitment only where present (a
  single-level fold is 78.119's exactly); replies `Uplinked::Chained` and
  `Uplinked::ChildRefused` (`ChildRefusal`); `Discontinuous::Rate`;
  `Cite::Chained` (tag 7); `Ledgers` persisted as `LEAF_LEDGERS` (5), absent
  where empty.
- **B′, the vertices are folds.** A vertex is a fold, `tier ‖ prefix`, never
  a tier: a rate that moves between epochs is two edges and no cycle, while
  one child fold netted through two routes meets itself at its own vertex
  and its real gain obstructs. A cold child is proved by its sealed
  coordinates: every admitted fold's coordinates (tier, prefix, rows'
  commitment; never its rows, LD0) are held in `LEAF_LEDGERS` from its
  admission until a parent nets all of it, so what stays is the folds with
  value in flight; a child netted whole keeps an empty remainder and is
  never netted again.
- **C, one cycle reading.** The cycle reading is written once: `Cochain<C>`
  (the coefficient crossing `a → b`) and `holonomy`, the coefficients
  composed in path order (`Turned` composes `self · then`, so
  `r₁₂ · r₂₃ · r₃₁`). The minds' `Complex` is a cochain in the versor group
  and reads its triangles by the one holonomy; its storage (simplices and
  fills, orbits, sections, classifier and class vectors) stays its own.

Code: `src/transducer/cech/coefficient.rs` (`Coefficient`, `Lanes`, `Rates`,
`Turned`), `src/transducer/cech/cover.rs` (`Cover`, `Cochain`, `holonomy`,
`Gauge`), `src/transducer/cech/coboundary.rs` (`solve_gauge`),
`src/transducer/cech/complex.rs` (`Complex::holonomy`),
`src/anastome/dialogue/uplink.rs` (`ChildNet`, `Uplinked`, `ChildRefusal`),
`src/server/cognition/ledger.rs` (`Ledgers`), `src/chronometry/receipt.rs`
(`Cite::Chained`).

### 78.124 The core clock served, and pushed down as the orbital clock

The server keeps time in TUniversal and serves it as the core clock; the
clocks inside kernels are held together by it, and it is pushed down as the
orbital clock.

- **The stamp.** The core clock's stamp is `h:S:G:T:H:K.i` (CK1, 78.21): the
  tick (TUniversal's height), the frame the act measured on the four lanes
  `{S, G, T, H}` (78.21 (ii)'s four-dimensional state, captured at one tick
  and read at its `K`), the signer's orbit `K` and the act's place `i` in it.
  `CoreStamp` carries it, read off the head receipt (`Court::core_stamp`),
  and is served as `ACT_LAWS` mode 4 (`[0]` before a court's first act, else
  `[1]` and seven `u64`s). Its fixed-width writing (`CoreStamp::wide`) is
  sixteen hex digits a field, never wrapping at its carrier, so text order
  is numeric order. A wire addition.
- **The hierarchy of clocks.** (1) The core clock, TUniversal, keeps the
  cores of domains and universes aligned, as the courts' height does.
  (2) A kernel's step clock is held to it: each kernel tick is stamped with
  the core stamp it last read, so kernels in one universe keep step without
  sharing the kernels' internals. (3) A galaxy keeps its own clock, deep time at
  its own pace and every peopled place its proper time, never jumping and
  never agreeing a "now" with another; peoples are ordered by the peoples' ledgers'
  heights, `h = 1 + max(own, other)` (47.2). (4) Bodies orbit on k-steps in
  closed form, never stepped (time is distance along an orbit, 78.43; an age
  is one return read off the motion, never a counter), and spin on hours,
  each body's own day; a tidally locked planet or moon has no hours.
- **The lanes on an orbit.** `T` is the elapsed duration (the phase advances
  on `T`); `S` the scale and position along the orbit; `H` the holonomic
  lane, the spin plane's holonomy over a return, its precession (78.62); `G`
  the gauge lane, hue and recolouring (78.53, 78.69), never the expansion,
  which is LV2's ratio on momentum under a dilation, docketed on a verdict
  and no lane.
- The push of the clock to kernels (78.59 P2) follows the ledger rows
  2(a)–(c) and is not yet built. The rulings on time (78.124, 78.152,
  78.154, 78.156) are consolidated in [MU-CHRONOMETRY.md](MU-CHRONOMETRY.md).

Code: `src/chronometry/receipt.rs` (`CoreStamp`, `CoreStamp::wide`,
`KStepReceipt::print`), `src/server/cognition/reads.rs`
(`Court::core_stamp`), `src/physics/laws/codec.rs` (`encode_clock_request`,
`encode_clock_reply`, `decode_clock_reply`).

### 78.125 2(c): the challenge window: a fold answerable within W heights, finality recursive

A fold's rows stay with its tier (LD0) and its receipt commits to them by hash; the challenge window makes that commitment answerable, so a fold that balances and lies can be falsified and a docketed obstruction (78.123) can be discharged. Law version 4; it changes the wire and the court's layout.

- **The window.** `W = 1024` heights, a law parameter served by `ACT_LAWS`: one finality clock for every domain of a network universe, shorter than any anchoring cadence so an era's anchor reads final before the next era's. Never a wall clock.
- **The tier line.** A tier's line is a sequence of entries `{rows, declared}`: `head₀` is the zero hash and `headₙ = H("mycelium tier line v1" ‖ headₙ₋₁ ‖ entry)`. A fold's `prefix` is the head after its last entry, and the fold nets the entries since its tier's previous fold's prefix; an entry is one transfer batch, never the fold itself. A chained fold's line holds only its own entries; each child is proved by its own receipts. A tier's line starts at the zero head at its first fold admitted under this law, every later fold spans from the last one's prefix, and the court's `line_head` read is the authority a client resyncs by; a client refuses to fold while its own head disagrees.
- **The challenge act**, `ACT_CHALLENGE` (0x3F), signed by its filer and sealed by `Cite::Challenge` (tag 8): *Demand* (the tier must publish its prefix within `W`; one demand per fold); *Evidence* (the court replays at once: `Σ own rows = rows − Σ rate · included rows` per identity per lane in exact rationals and `Σ own declared = declared`; UPHELD seals the line head reached, otherwise FALSIFIED; the entries are not held); *Open* and *Parts* (a span larger than one frame's `BODY_BUDGET` is published in parts and judged once its head reaches the prefix; a single act past the budget is refused by name, a frame past it refused at the door); *Default* (a demand's deadline passed unpublished falsifies the fold); *Correction* (the tier whose fold closed an arbitrage books it as a declared G source to a named holder, discharging the obstruction); *Withdraw* (kind 9: the fold's own tier withdraws its own demand once, before any default is claimed, reopening `W`; an external challenger's demand is never withdrawn). Reads, sealing nothing: a fold's finality, a domain's open obstructions, a tier's line head.
- **Reversal.** A falsified fold and every fold that netted it, transitively, are reversed: each one's netting returns to the children's remainders, its edges leave the domain's gauge (re-derived, law 12), its bookings go; the ancestors read UNWOUND and must refile, never silently re-netted. The bond's slash is 78.129.
- **Finality is recursive, read and never stored.** A fold is FINAL when its window and any demand's deadline have passed, no demand stands defaulted and unclaimed, no open obstruction was closed by it, and every fold it nets is final, so a child can never be falsified after an ancestor reads final. Final carries UPHELD or unchallenged; otherwise a fold reads provisional, blocked, falsified, unwound, unrecorded, or PRE-LINE (sealed before this law: grandfathered as final and unchallenged, demands against it refused).
- **Nothing is sealed twice.** A fold over its tier's current head is answered without sealing: byte-identical to the fold admitted there it is a resend, answered with the original receipt; otherwise `Uplinked::Repeated`. A resent handoff offer and a resent demand by the same filer are each answered with the original receipt; the SDK never resends a sealing act once written.
- **The windows settle.** At each orbit's close `settle_windows` prunes a record read final to a stub (its coordinates and whether it was upheld); a stub leaves once the fold has no value in flight, no unfinished fold nets it and the hot line no longer holds its receipt; finished streams and empty remainders leave. What stays is each fold within its window and the open remainders.

Code: `src/physics/laws/mod.rs` (`CHALLENGE_WINDOW`), `src/anastome/dialogue/challenge.rs`, `src/server/cognition/challenge.rs` (`finality`, `settle_windows`, `reconstructs`); held in the `LEAF_CHALLENGES` leaf.

### 78.126 2(b): matter handoffs, two-sided: matter and a word crossing domains on one court

A unit of matter stands in exactly one place (78.59 P2: matter does not net like money), so a crossing between domains is no rate on an edge but a HANDOFF one court serialises: no double-spend on S, conservation across the boundary. `ACT_HANDOFF` (0x07), signed by its filer and sealed by `Cite::Handoff` (tag 9), is two-phase: the sending tier's *Offer* states what leaves its domain and what arrives in the other, summing to zero on every lane, on S (matter) and H (a delivered word, never copied) only (G crosses by rates and μ, T is refused); the receiving tier *Accepts* it whole within `W` or *Refuses* it, and past `W` the sender may *Expire* it; refused or expired, it is returned. Each side is consumed by exactly one fold (`TierFold.handoffs`), and continuity reads `Σ rows − Σ rate · included = Σ declared + Σ sides' nets`; a side consumed twice is refused, a reversed fold (78.125) un-consumes its sides, and the court lets an offer go once both sides are consumed by final folds. 0x07 was the last free wire byte below the court's range: a new act is a sub-kind of an existing one, with two ruled exceptions, the seat relay `ACT_SEAT` (0x53) and `ACT_TICK` (0x23, 78.152). Amended by 78.128 and 78.136: a handoff between domains must be a traversal through an open mouth pair (`NoMouth` otherwise), and within one domain it runs only along a road.

Code: `src/anastome/dialogue/handoff.rs`, `src/server/cognition/handoff.rs`; held in the `LEAF_HANDOFFS` leaf.

### 78.127 2(e): μ conversion against a domain's reserve, never minted by a rate

μ is made only by the network (allocations and POW++ earnings, four lanes, never summed) and moves only key to key with Σ = 0, so CONVERSION between a domain's game value and μ is an exchange against μ the domain's ancients actually hold, never a mint: a rate is the domain's own FX, but no rate prints μ. Each domain has one RESERVE TIER, designated by the domain's key through an `ACT_DOMAIN` sub-kind sealed by `Cite::Reserve` (tag 10); a redesignation takes effect at the current reserve tier's next admitted fold, never mid-era, and is signed by the sitting reserve (78.136). Conversion is a sub-kind of `ACT_HANDOFF`: *Out* (kind 5), signed by the reserve tier, pays `rate[l] · g` μ (exact and integral on every lane, or refused) from the reserve to the holder only where the reserve holds it (`ReserveShort` otherwise); *In* (kind 6) is two-phase, the holder's μ held until the reserve accepts it whole, refuses it, or it expires past `W` and is refunded. Each G side names the in-game holder and is consumed once by the reserve tier's fold; a resend is answered with its original receipt. A falsified fold's forfeit goes half to the challenger as bounty and half retired from supply (POWR), an odd unit to retirement (bonds, 78.129); a conversion waits on the reserve's stated basket (78.139). ACT_DOMAIN sub-kind 2 reads the reserve without sealing.

Code: `src/server/cognition/convert.rs` (`reserve_of`, `slash`), `src/client/sdk/house.rs` (`Session::reserve`, `Session::reserve_reading`), `src/economy/pay.rs`.

### 78.128 The wormhole: a mouth pair between domains, built and kept by the ancients

Domains share no space (78.126 as amended), so nothing crosses between them without a physical connection; a WORMHOLE is that connection. Its mouth pair (`ACT_HANDOFF` kind 7) is offered by one domain's reserve tier and accepted (kind 1) by the other's within `W`: a black-hole mouth in one domain and a white-hole mouth in the other, each placed in its domain's chart by an exact Cl(4,1) versor (`Degenerate` otherwise), a KEEPER (one of the two reserves) and a flat TOLL of μ per traversal; either reserve closes it (kind 8), returning traversals in flight and refunding the traversals' tolls. A *traversal* (kind 9) is a 78.126 offer citing an open mouth joining its two domains (`NoMouth`, `NotTheMouth` otherwise); its toll is escrowed from the sender at the offer, released to the keeper on acceptance and refunded on refusal, expiry or close, a μ transfer with Σ = 0. The open mouths are gauge edges between domains carrying the chart transition `to_frame · from_frame⁻¹`: a cycle whose holonomy is not the identity is RECORDED with its exact holonomy (kind 10), never refused, read and never stored (law 12). Amended by 78.133 (tariffs), 78.134 (every new mouth is a tube) and 78.136 (a progenitor line may build).

Code: `src/anastome/dialogue/handoff.rs`, `src/server/cognition/mouth.rs` (`mouth_loops`).

### 78.129 Bonds and the slash: each tier backed by its domain's reserve

The tier that signed a lie is the one at stake, but μ is the ancients': a BOND is per tier, POSTED BY THE DOMAIN'S RESERVE, μ escrowed in the tier's name (a treasury hold under `"bond" ‖ tier`) and topped up by posting again. The acts are `ACT_DOMAIN` sub-kinds signed by the reserve tier and sealed by `Cite::Bond` (tag 11): *post* (kind 3, only the domain's current reserve, for a tier its genesis names, from μ it holds; a bond an earlier reserve posted returns to it), *withdraw* (kind 4, only once every fold of the tier is final: `Outstanding`, `Unbonded` otherwise) and *read* (kind 5, sealing nothing). A falsified fold, by replay or default, slashes HALF its tier's bond on each lane, floored, forfeited as 78.127 rules (half the cut to the challenger, half retired, an odd unit to retirement). Every finality read carries whether the fold's tier stands bonded; an unbonded tier still folds and its folds read provisional through the fold window. A carried line answers with a bond of its own (78.138).

### 78.130 Certified reals: the network's standard math as proven rational enclosures

Every domain's physics needs transcendentals, two domains must compute the same value bit for bit, and no float may enter (precision is the rule); so the network serves standard math as PROVEN ENCLOSURES in one module every kernel uses alike (standard math server-side, custom math client-side). The carrier `Encl { lo, hi }` is a pair of exact rationals proved to hold the true value, with interval arithmetic and outward rounding to the dyadic grid `2^-w`; nothing reads a float, a clock or a thread, so the same inputs give the same enclosure on every machine, and `lt` decides only on separated bounds. The functions, each with its remainder bound named at its definition, are `exp`, `ln`, `ln2`, `pi`, `sqrt`, `powq`, `sin`, `cos`, `tan`, `sinh`, `cosh`, `logistic`, `atan`, `acos`, `lgamma`, the regularized lower incomplete gamma `P(a, x)` (`gamma_p`), `erf`, the Planck tail `F(x) = 15/π⁴·∫_x^∞ t³/(e^t−1) dt` (`planck_tail`) and the inverse Poisson CDF (`poisson_quantile`; its precision raised where a step does not separate, refused past `w + 256` bits). A series stops when a term's bound falls below `2^-(w₂−8)` and adds that bound as its remainder; `P` is refused past `P_SERIES_CAP = 10⁴`, beyond which `erf` is the proven `[1 − 2^{−w}, 1]`.

Code: `src/core/certified.rs` (`Encl`, `P_SERIES_CAP`), proved in `src/core/tests/certified.rs`.

### 78.131 Universal physics: the laws' forms, shared

The shared physics holds the FORMS of the laws as functions of a universe's constants, on exact rationals and certified enclosures (78.130); each universe holds its constants' values, its calibrations, its bodies' parameters, its substances, its Big Bang and all its matter, and the shared forms hold no table of any universe, every scale ratio being exactly one where every ratio to the universe's own reference is one (read with Concordance 2.2). The forms cover (A) the laws `Laws { alpha, beta, alpha_g, nuclear }` and the laws' scales; (C) orbits as fibres, the q-form Kepler period `q³/m`, the exact phase and the orbit's point uniform in angle (78.43: time is distance along the orbit) with its proven angle error; (E) radiation and heat, a `Phase` refused where the pressure lies inside the saturation curve's enclosure; (F) nuclei and shells, the Madelung configuration and a `Place { period, block, column }`; (G) system laws; (D) stars from a `StellarCalibration` passed in, with no default (R1: calibrations and bodies are passed in, never held); and (B, R3) the bounce on the tree's own pieces: a horizon is `sphere_at(c, 4m²)` with no root taken, inversion is `σXσ⁻¹`, and the recycling books are exact after every act, `fallen + arrived = growth + radiated + reservoir + returned`, the jets fixed at the enclosure's lower bound so no matter is invented. Anything undecided on separated enclosures is refused (`None`), never guessed.

### 78.132 Universe genesis: a domain's origin, once

One network universe is one Big Bang is one domain (78.86). The ORIGIN act, `ACT_DOMAIN` sub-kind 6, records a 32-byte commitment to the universe's Big Bang record (its seed, laws as ratios, drawn parameters, the parent bounce's mass and spin); the record is held by the universe, never by the court. It is signed by the domain's key over `"mycelium universe origin v1" ‖ domain ‖ kind ‖ version ‖ commitment` and taken once: the domain must be founded on this court (`NotFounded`) and hold no origin (`AlreadyOriginated`: never an edit, 78.59 Ruling 2; a wrong origin is remedied by a new universe and a new domain). Sealed as `Cite::Origin` (tag 12); a domain with an origin reads as a universe, and its folds descend from it by line precedence (the origin's receipt precedes every later fold on the court's line). Sub-kind 7 reads it. Version 2 of the origin states the universe's geometry and parent face (78.139, 78.140).

### 78.133 Per-unit and split tolls on a wormhole

The ancients tax passage, and a share may go to the ancients' progenitor lines. A mouth offered as kind 11 carries `Tariff { rate_s, rate_h, split }` (kind 7's flat toll stands as it was); a wormhole carries S and H only, so each pays on its own lane: `⌊rate_s · Σ|out S|⌋` μ-S for mass and `⌊rate_h · Σ|out H|⌋` μ-H for information, G and T never charged, the remainder never rounded up against the traveller. The split (recipients ascending, each once, shares summing to exactly one) gives every recipient but the keeper its `⌊share · charge⌋` and the keeper the rest, so each lane's parts sum to its charge exactly; recipients are the keeper and the tier keys its own domain's genesis names (`NotALine` otherwise), and the tariff is in the mouth's id (a new split is a new mouth; a flat toll beside it is `Untariffed::Flat`). The charge is escrowed from the traveller at the traverse act (`HolderShort` refuses, never debits), split and HELD for `W` from acceptance (`TollHeld`); if the traversal's OUT-side fold is reversed every part returns to the traveller (`unwind_tolls`), otherwise once the window closes and that fold reads final every part is paid together (`release_split`) at the traverse act's stamp and receipt. The line-head read carries the μ held toward a tier and the finality read whether a toll is held on the fold.

Code: `src/anastome/dialogue/handoff.rs` (`Tariff`), `src/server/cognition/mouth.rs` (`unwind_tolls`), `src/economy/pay.rs` (`release_split`), `src/anastome/dialogue/challenge.rs` (`LineHead`, `FinalityReading`).

### 78.134 Mouths as tubes on curved space

A mouth is a tube, never two free frames (the anti-flattening rule). Every new mouth pair is offered as kind 12 carrying `Tube { mass, from_r, to_r, supersedes }` (`Untethered` otherwise); its frames must be motions of curved space, elements of `Spin⁺(3,1)` inside Cl(4,1) (even, a versor, commuting with `e₊`, orthochronous: `is_spin_plus_31`; `NotIsometry` otherwise), and each mouth stands at its frame's base point on its domain's sheet (`frame_base_point`), never at a flat point. The throat's size is its mass: each end's horizon is the level set `{p : p·v = −c}` at hyperbolic radius `2m/R` in that end's curvature radius `R`, so `c = cosh(2m/R)`, taken as the upper bound of the certified enclosure on the grid `2^-64` (never undersized), derived on every read and never stored. The mouth gauge's coefficient is a motion alone (`Moved`), the chart transition composed in path order; a loop is TETHERED where the tubes alone close it to the same holonomy, and a cycle through an untethered mouth reads as history. Mouths opened before tubes stay readable and working; a tube may SUPERSEDE one, closing it at the tube's acceptance and returning what was in flight. Amended by 78.140 (torus faces) and by 78.162 (5): a throat's mass is never a scalar; it is owed re-derivation as a round of Cl(4,1).

Code: `src/anastome/dialogue/tube.rs` (`Tube`, `is_spin_plus_31`), `src/transducer/cga/hyperboloid.rs` (`frame_base_point`), `src/server/cognition/mouth.rs` (`throat_level`), `src/transducer/cech/coefficient.rs` (`Moved`).

### 78.135 The throat's bank: fed, drawn, returned, never retired

A throat is held open by matter set aside. The offerer banks `⌈m⌉` μ-S at the offer (`HolderShort` refuses), held under `throat_key(mouth, face)`, one hold per face that fed it, and refunded whole where the offer is refused or expires. Open, only the KEEPER acts on it, each bank act carrying `seq`, the throat's count of bank acts so far (a resend is `Stale`): FED (kind 14) banks more and grows the mass; DRAWN (kind 15) returns that much to its faces in proportion to what each holds and shrinks the mass, never to zero or below (`Starved`; ending a throat is `Close`). Closed or superseded, every face gets back what it holds: never retired, never burned, since the universe is self-maintaining, not a heat sink. The tube read (`ACT_HANDOFF` kind 13) gives the committed mass plus feeds less draws; under 78.162 (5) a feed or draw moves modes into and out of the bank and reads nothing off them into the committed mass until the throat is re-derived as a round.

Code: `src/server/cognition/mouth.rs` (`throat_key`), `src/server/cognition/handoff.rs`.

### 78.136 The progenitors build, the ancients keep

The ancients rarely travel; the progenitor lines build the highways and wormholes, and the ancients keep them.

- **A line offers.** A mouth or tube may be offered by any tier of its domain, a progenitor line or the reserve; the far end is accepted by its domain's reserve (`NotReserve` otherwise). Where a line builds, its own reserve is the keeper (`NotKeeper` otherwise); a reserve building across domains may name either reserve. The builder banks the throat (78.135) from its own μ-S, and the toll's split may pay the building line (78.133).
- **A road inside one domain.** A mouth may join two distinct places of one domain's curved space (`Unbound` where its frames' base points coincide), the reserve keeping both ends. Matter and words cross within a domain only along such a road; a plain offer within one domain is no handoff. Contiguity means exactly this: two places are joined where a tube runs between them.
- **Succession by the sitting reserve.** The domain key designates the reserve once, at founding; every redesignation after is signed by the sitting reserve, never by the founder's key alone (`Unsigned`).

Code: `src/server/cognition/mouth.rs`, `src/server/cognition/handoff.rs`, `src/server/cognition/convert.rs`.

### 78.137 Durable admission: a court act is answered only once it is on the disk

Every write lands DURABLY: the line's append is synced, and a whole line or the snapshot is written to a synced sibling, renamed, and the directory synced. The court acts (`ACT_UPLINK`, `ACT_HANDOFF`, `ACT_CHALLENGE`, `ACT_DOMAIN`) are answered only after the line and snapshot they changed are on the disk; a write that does not land is not answered, the act stays due, and its resend is answered with its original receipt (nothing is sealed twice). Boot restores the last snapshot read whole, with no log re-executed (that would be replay, Concordance 1.4). Speech keeps its orbit-cadence persist, since words are re-heard by back-fill: a crash may lose unpersisted words, never an acknowledged court act. Should the measured cost approach the court's real act rate, the next form is an fsynced log of the sealed state deltas, read back at boot as a recovery read; the trigger is measured, never a declared size.

Code: `src/chronometry/chain/line.rs` (`replace_durably`), `src/bin/mycelium-server/persist.rs` (`durable`); the drill `scripts/durable-drill` with `examples/durable_drill.rs`, and its negative control, the `drill-undurable` feature, which answers without the pre-reply sync and loses rounds.

### 78.138 Only the ancients uplink; a line is carried inline

Not every civilization is uplinked, or the uplink would be overloaded: a domain's reserve (its ancients) alone folds onto the court (`Uplinked::NotReserve` for any other tier), and a progenitor line's fold is CARRIED INLINE in the reserve's. A child is `Child::Sealed(FoldAt)`, a fold already on the court, or `Child::Carried(SignedFold)`, the line's whole fold with its own signature, which may carry its own lines in turn, recursively, never flattened. The court seals one receipt, the reserve's (`Cite::Chained`), and holds each carried line where it stands, `FoldAt { stamp, path }`; each line keeps its own head, record, window (the parent's) and finality. Before anything is sealed every carried line is read in full: its signature (`ChildRefusal::Unsigned`), the same domain (`ForeignDomain`), a bond of its own (`Unbonded`: each answers for its own work), its rows as its parent states them (`Mismatched`), a span advancing its line (`Repeated`), its handoff sides and continuity, then its own children; a refusal anywhere refuses the whole fold. A demand on a carried line is answered by RECONSTRUCTION (Concordance 4.4: the line's entries stepped to its committed prefix, each step checked against the one before, nothing re-run); falsified, the line's record is reversed, the carrying reserve fold is unwound and refiles without it, its tolls are refunded, and the LINE's bond is slashed, never the reserve's. `Cite::Challenge` keeps tag 8 for a fold the court sealed and takes tag 13 with its path for a line inside.

Code: `src/anastome/dialogue/uplink.rs` (`Child`, `FoldAt`, `ChildRefusal`), `src/server/cognition/ledger.rs`, `src/server/cognition/challenge.rs` (`Reconstruction`, `reconstructs`).

### 78.139 A universe states itself; core tubes join universes

A galactic core is a larger wormhole: every horizon has its far face, and a universe's Big Bang is the far face of a parent's core. The origin act (78.132) at version 2 carries the universe's space (its geometry, as revised by 78.140) and its PARENT FACE: the open core tube it bounced out of, its far end in this domain, or UNWITNESSED (a root, joined when found); a v1 origin is never upgraded. Sealed with `Cite::Origin` and `Cite::Stated` (tag 14). The SITTING RESERVE states, once each and never as an edit (`AlreadyStated`), through `ACT_DOMAIN` sub-kinds:

- **8 GEOMETRY** (named CURVATURE before 78.140), where none is stated.
- **9 BASKET**: the ancients' survival basket, one person-year of the ancients' survival at the core by mass per element, `[(Z, mass)]` in ascending `Z`, each a positive exact rational, stated when the ancients take up the reserve, never at genesis; every conversion at the reserve waits on it (`HandoffRefusal::NoBasket`), and the reserve unit is that basket.
- **10 JOIN**: an originated root naming an open core tube into it.
- **11** reads the universe: whether originated, its geometry, its parent face, its basket.

The CORE TUBE (handoff kind 16) is a tube (78.134) joining a parent universe's core to the core of the universe it bounced into: offered by the parent's reserve (`NotReserve` for a line), kept by both reserves, the parent an originated universe (`NotAUniverse`) whose stated space is the near end's and the child's the far end's (`NoGeometry`); its id is distinct from any tube's. A child's order is genesis, reserve, the parent's core tube offered and accepted, then its origin v2 naming it; a root's is genesis, reserve, origin v2 unwitnessed (or v1 and a geometry), then JOIN once found. Existing domains keep working and read as not-yet-universes; each originates before joining a core tube and states its basket before converting.

### 78.140 A universe's space is its geometry: curved, or a flat torus

A universe's space is stated, never assumed: a universe may be a flat torus by ruling for that universe, never by default. `Geometry` replaces 78.139's bare curvature in the origin v2 bytes (revised before first use, so no version 3): `[0][R n d]` CURVED, the hyperbolic sheet `ℍ³`, an open space of constant negative curvature whose frames are `Spin⁺(3,1)`; or `[1][k][periods n d …][metric]`, a flat TORUS of `1 ≤ k ≤ 3` axis-aligned positive periods (a general lattice basis waits for a universe that needs one) with metric `0` L1 or `1` L2. A torus end's frame must be a Euclidean motion, even, a versor, carrying the point at infinity to itself at its own weight, `F e∞ F̃ = (F F̃) e∞` (`is_euclidean_motion`; `NotIsometry` otherwise), and its PLACE is the base point read modulo the periods (`place_in`). The throat's mass `m` is the one invariant both faces share; each end's level is read in its own space, `Level::Curved(c)` with `c = cosh(2m/R)` or `Level::Flat { radius, ratio }` with `radius = 2m` and `ratio = 2m / L_min` (`L_min` the shortest period); a throat fits a torus face while `ratio < ½`, else `TooWide`, at the offer and at every feed. Tubes and core tubes between a curved and a torus face stand, each end checked in its own geometry, written under dedicated handoff kinds (17 a tube, 18 a core) so every curved tube's writing and id are what 78.134 sealed; a core tube's ends must be the spaces each domain stated (`NoGeometry`). `Mv`'s `==` is projective (equal up to scale): the torus checks compare exactly, and an explicit projective equality with `==` exact, every site deciding which it means, is owed. Amended by 78.162 (5): the scalar throat reading is owed re-derivation as a round.

Code: `src/anastome/dialogue/universe.rs` (`Geometry`), `src/anastome/dialogue/tube.rs` (`is_euclidean_motion`, `place_in`, `Level`), `src/server/cognition/mouth.rs` (`level_in`, `flat_throat`).

### 78.141 A solve names its payee by its voice's signature

The court pays the voice a solve names (POUW on the first closure), so an unsigned payee is an attribution hole and the voice signs the act: `ACT_SOLVE` carries `[SIGN][sig 64]` after the optional rule, over `b"mycelium solve v1" ‖ the act up to the signature`, the voice being the key's verifying half. `decode_solve` reads `signed` (verified against the named voice) and refuses bytes after the act that are no signature; the door refuses an unsigned solve by name before judging it, so nothing is judged and nothing paid. The mind is seated on its key (`Court::from_key`, its home's `voice.key`) and signs its solves with it; a mind seated on verifying bytes alone (`Court::from_voice`) signs nothing and sends no solve.

### 78.142 The SDK rule seam

A client states a rule as STEPS (`Step::{Motion, Hue}`) that compose to one action, `V = Vₙ⋯V₁` and `σ = σₙ∘…∘σ₁`, minted as one Word vertex, and the seam speaks the sentence the court judges, so no Element byte is forged; a rule crossing to pairs it never saw drops every overlap whose two ends stand at different frames and is re-minted over the train, or refuted at home. Moved to [MU-CLIENT.md](MU-CLIENT.md); see its Rulings index.

### 78.143 The rule language: select, region, create, count, compare

Amended by review ruling 5 (§0.1, §0.6): the clauses are the court's language, kept as the seam for houses and outside developers (78.142); minds never inherit them as vocabulary (no clause, `Step`, `Pred` or `Region` is a letter or candidate of a mind), a mind's rule is a sentence of the letters it holds (50.2 as amended), `Interior`'s background and a hue step's hue `0` are the court's seam and never a mind's perception (U13), and the D4 table (`grid_steps`, `Symmetry`) leaves the seat mind's path, which submits the mind's tape and outputs only. A clause is a typed selection over the perceived bodies' exact coordinates and an act on it: SELECT (`Pred`: all, a hue, a chart, a count, a rank, contact, `Not`/`And`/`Any`; `Coord` the exact coordinates, `Lane` named only to be refused), REGION (`Interior`, `Halo`, `Extent`), CREATE (`Extend` a line along a ray, `Copy` a template onto each seed, carried by a `Cl(4,1)(ℚ)` versor with every landing exact on a cell centre), COUNT and COMPARE (`Cmp`, `Rank` in a named `Order`, ties `Hold`, `Refuse` or `Then`; Concordance 1.10), and SIZE (`Crop`, `Scale` by an integer). The clauses ride the form's address after the remainder's coordinates only where a form has any (every other address is unchanged), are read back by `from_address`, spoken by `speak_on_scene` and replayed by the judge on every pair. An unnamed tie, a non-exact coordinate, no single body for a crop or template, a landing off the lattice or a line with no ray is refused by name at the court (`REFUSE_RULE_*`, kind I) and at the seam (`NoRule::Unstated`); the seam refuses a clause that does not close its train (`NotClosed`) before the mint.
