### 78.145 The seat surface

A game's minds sit in its house through the hypha. The house is the domain's sitting reserve (`Court::reserve_of`); the hypha is a general signed relay between it and the minds that take its seats: it holds and forwards and judges nothing in-game. The act is `Action::Seat`, `ACT_SEAT = 0x53`, `Kind::Relay`: asked on the wire, never sealed, moving no book, the one wire byte past the court's acts 0x40–0x52 (78.126). The lexicon gains House and Seat surface (version 3). The wire (seat v1; later versions: v1.2 in 78.146, v1.3 in 78.152 TU-7, v1.4 below):

- Frame: integers little-endian, keys 32 bytes, ed25519 signatures 64 bytes; a frame is `[0x53][sub u8][fields][sig 64]`, signed over `b"mycelium seat v1" ‖ [sub] ‖ [fields]` (the act tag is not signed).
- ARG = `[tag u8]` then `0 Q [num i64][den u64 > 0]` | `1 Key [32]` | `2 Count [u64]` | `3 Flag [u8 0|1]` | `4 Mv` | `5 BigQ [num len u16][num][den len u16][den]` (den > 0, reduced, minimal lengths) | `6 Bytes [len u16][bytes]` (78.146); anything else is refused. ARGS = `[count u8][ARG…]`.
- Sub-kinds: 0 SEATS (house: `[domain][epoch u64][count u16] SEAT…`, SEAT = `[seat u32][role u8][on key][beat ARG][fns u16] FN…`; role an opaque tier byte 0–9, named by the game kernel; the latest or an equal epoch replaces); 1 TAKE (mind); 2 TAKEN (house); 3 PERCEPT (house: local time, seq and records `[kind u16][ARGS]`, COUNSEL as kind `0xFFFF` `[fn u16][ARGS][worth][cost]`); 4 CALL (mind; its call reference is `blake3` of exactly the signed bytes, a citation of the call and never its identity, law 2); 5 OUTCOME (house); 6 READ-LISTING (unsigned, the latest SEATS or empty); 7 READ-MAIL (signed by the reader: a mind reads the TAKEN, PERCEPT and OUTCOME naming it, a house its domain's TAKE and CALL too).
- Replies: `[1][seq u64]` or `[0][reason u8]` with 1 unsigned, 2 not the house, 3 malformed (any frame not read whole), 4 unknown domain; `[0][0]` is an empty box.
- The mail is volatile and bounded: nothing is persisted; a READ-MAIL's `after` acknowledges and drops everything at or below it; each addressee's box is held within `frame_budget() − 2` bytes and `u16::MAX` pieces, the oldest dropped and counted (`SeatRelay::dropped`).
- Conformance is by decoded values and signature (Concordance 1.4), never by reproduced bytes.

Code: `src/anastome/dialogue/seat.rs` (the codec), `src/server/cognition/seat.rs` (`SeatRelay`, `SharedRelay`, `Court::seat_post`, `Court::seat_mail`), `src/server/cognition/convert.rs` (`Court::reserve_of`), `src/client/sdk/seat.rs` (`list_seats`, `take`, `call`, `mail`, `MindMail`, `HouseMail`); tests `src/anastome/dialogue/tests/seat.rs`, `src/server/cognition/tests/seat.rs`. The mind's choice at its seat is 78.146 and 78.148.

### 78.146 The mind at its seat: percepts as series, the call its own

The seat mind perceives its game and chooses its call from what its calls were seen to do; it is held on the entity per domain and seat, volatile. A percept is a series, never a picture: each record is located by its own coordinates `[kind][keys][key…][occurrence][position]`, every non-key argument is one series over the house's percept sequence and its local time, and a multivector or flag is held as itself. A quantity's change is a motion of its line: the SLIDE by the difference (`translator_at`, slides compose by sum) and, where both values stand on one side of zero, the SCALE by the ratio (`dilator`, scales compose by product); a series returns with period `p` where its last `2p` changes repeat and one period's slides compose to the identity, and a record's period is the lcm of its arguments' (78.43). An applied call's effect is every quantity's composed slide between its beat and the first percept after its outcome; the choice, a comparison the mind states quantity by quantity with no sum across them (Concordance 1.10), takes the read function that dominates on the quantities the counsel's worth favours, tries an unread counselled function where every read one moved them against, and otherwise follows the counsel and says so (refined by 78.148).

Wire v1.2 (lexicon version 4, Task citation): on every wire a task is named by its 32-byte citation of its full registry content address (`registry::citation`, `TaskRegistry::by_citation`); `ACT_TASK` answers a request by citation with the task's train and test inputs, never the held answers, and `ACT_SOLVE` names the task by citation. A percept record of kind 4 `[Key(citation)]` puts a registry task before the seat; the mind mints the rule as the task arm does and CALLs fn 1 with `[Bytes rule tape, Bytes outputs]`. Amended by review ruling 5 (§0.1): the seat submits the mind's tape and outputs only, with no D4 or hue-map Count steps. A mind's own READ-MAIL is exempt from the door's deferral once per window of its box's mail, served off the relay's own lock (`SharedRelay`); every post keeps the ordinary rule. Code: `src/client/sdk/seat_mind/` (`mod.rs`, `choice.rs`, `task.rs`), `src/server/registry.rs` (`citation`, `TaskRegistry::by_citation`), `src/server/cognition/seat.rs` (`SharedRelay`); tests `src/client/sdk/tests/seat_mind.rs`.

### 78.147 Catch-up from a fold root

A fold is final on two signatures (47.3), so to anyone catching up the line below a root is the root.

1. The proof is kept: the home keeps its root with its own signed position and the witness's (`commit_fold_proved`), the witness the same with the home's position it verified (`hold_era_proved`); one per signer, the latest, persisted as `LEAF_ROOTS`.
2. The serving door (`serve_receipts`) answers a catch-up opening below the signer's root with the root and its proof (`RootProof`), never cold pages, and one from it with the hot line; the cold archive answers only an era replay (`encode_replay_request`, trailing tag `1`); a catch-up below a root this court holds no proof of is answered off the hot line alone and counted.
3. The asker adopts (`Court::adopt_root`): both signatures verified exactly as the fold's were, the signer's line stands on the root (`ReceiptChain::line_tip`), its next receipt names the root as predecessor and admits hot, nothing below the root is asked again, and what was held below it is shed.
4. A citation at or below a held root is proved by an era replay walked to the root (`prove_folded`). As amended (cited in code as 78.147 (3′)), the walk goes page by page: `ReceiptChain::walk_era` keeps its place where a page ends (Proved, Continues, Stalled, Broken) and the next page opens there, across hearings, one spend per page.

Code: `src/server/cognition/court/catchup.rs`, `src/chronometry/chain/mod.rs`, `src/anastome/dialogue/root.rs`, `src/anastome/dialogue/receipts.rs`, `src/server/backfill.rs` (`prove_folded`); tests `src/server/cognition/tests/catchup.rs`.

### 78.149 μ is discharge (the escrow rulings)

μ is paid only for work, and the work a word does is its measured discharge. Ruled:

- (a) The span a bundle stood, `T = t_extent`, is not μ: waiting is not work. Escrow is priced from the discharge alone, and T never enters a minted magnitude or a quote; the standing extent stays a reading of the metabolism (the book's pressure on 𝒯, the T-room relocation), never a price.
- (b) Unclosed demand: a claim pays the closer's measured discharge, never more. The listing's ask may cap the price, never inflate it: a claim is paid `min(escrow, discharge)` lane-wise (`Treasury::release_discharged`), and what the escrow held above the discharge is never minted (E1). A demand sentence's magnitude stays its closed deflation plus the measure of what its demands ask, shown in the quote as the ask, the cap.
- (c) The holonomic token of letters and calluses mints no μ: no μ for a word that names no body. The token's unit `[0, 0, 0, 1]` stays as the existence of each (`as_element_form` refuses an all-zero magnitude); the discharge of each is zero, so each escrows and is paid nothing. A use (`settle_use`) transfers the used word's magnitude and is not a mint, which (c) does not rule.

One reader states it (`Court::discharge_on`, `Court::discharge_of`): a word's discharge is a sentence's deflation measured by replay on the family it is heard or bound on (`measured_replay`), a rewrite's yield, or a connection's chain measure where it stands for a listing on the book, and zero with no family. Every escrow and every release reads the discharge, never the magnitude; the carriage draws in the same currency (`Court::carry`), so a word that discharges nothing draws nothing and lapses as silent (ZeroFlux, 78.37 (3)). Code: `src/server/cognition/identity.rs`, `src/economy/escrow.rs` (`Treasury::release_discharged`), `src/server/cognition/basis.rs` (`Court::carry`), `src/transducer/family/deflation.rs` (`sentence_measure_why`); tests `src/server/cognition/tests/discharge.rs`, `src/economy/tests/settlement.rs`.

### 78.151 Reads from a snapshot

The door serves reads from a published reading; only writes take the kernel. The court stroke, under the kernel it already holds, publishes a `Published` (`Court::publish`) and swaps it onto the door's shelf (an `Arc<RwLock<Arc<Published>>>`, locked for one pointer's swap or clone), at most once per stroke and not where nothing moved; boot publishes the first reading before the door opens. A reading holds each signer's hot line and root, its eras and the cold segment's path, the root proofs, every account in 256 shards, the core clock and its head; pieces are shared, not copied (immutable runs behind shared pointers, `LineTally`, `Treasury::take_touched` naming the accounts that moved). Every read carries the height it was answered at: a wallet's account its head (`Account::at`) and, a wire change, an `ACT_RECEIPTS` answer eight bytes of reading height (`put_reading_height`, `decode_receipts_answer_at`); a writer reading its own write lags it by at most one court stroke. `ACT_RECEIPTS`, `ACT_WALLET`, the laws' clock and a seat READ-LISTING are answered off the reading where the frame is read (`judge::serve_published`); writes (admit, judge, solve, seat posts and mail, folds, intake, offers) stay on the kernel, and each publication counts what it copied (law 9). Code: `src/server/cognition/published/` (`publish.rs`, `serve.rs`, `runs.rs`), `src/bin/mycelium-server/published.rs`, `src/bin/mycelium-server/judge/dispatch.rs` (`serve_published`), `src/anastome/dialogue/receipts.rs`, `src/anastome/dialogue/root.rs`; tests `src/server/cognition/tests/published.rs`.

### 78.152 The TUniversal law (TU-1..7; Concordance 1.11)

The mesh keeps one clock, TUniversal: a point read off the keepers' signed readings and made final by a majority of them. Every court, server, client, kernel and sub-universe keeps time on it and on nothing else (Concordance 1.11). The law:

- **TU-1 KEEPERS.** The keepers are distinct courts with distinct keys (three in the founding mesh). A keeper's reading is its point at its head: `h` (its head receipt's height), `S:G:T:H` (its court's cumulative measured change per lane, carried by the one exact counter `Treasury::issued`, genesis plus mint, which only rises and which a treasury fold keeps exactly) and `K` (a ledger coordinate, OK1); a reading advances only where the head rose and a lane or `K` moved (`Court::keeper_tick`).
- **TU-2 READINGS ARE RECEIPTS.** A keeper signs a `TickReading`: its key, the point, `parent` (the citation of its previous reading, empty where its line starts or restarts) and `cites` (the last reading it verified from each other keeper); the signed bytes carry the origin, so a reading never verifies in another universe. Readings travel as the keeper's ring of its newest `aperture_cycle` readings (on the cover digest and on `ACT_TICK`, 78.152b), and `Keepers::admit` verifies every signature, the parent chain and rising ticks, the cites and the link to the line held.
- **TU-3 FINALITY BY MAJORITY.** A point is final when a strict majority of the keeper set holds verified readings of it (two of three, three of four, three of five): the keeper's own signed reading and others' verified readings citing it or a later reading on its parent chain. The final TUniversal is the greatest point final in this court's view (`Keepers::final_point`); it never runs back and is never averaged: where finals at one tick differ, that tick goes to the residue. One keeper alone finalises nothing, and a restarted keeper never re-signs a height (78.152c).
- **TU-4 DISAGREEMENT IS A RESIDUE.** Two keepers' readings differing at one tick leave the exact per-lane difference `to − from` as a 1-cochain on the keeper triangle; its holonomy round the triangle in key order is the clock's residue (`Keepers::residual`), journaled and never folded into the point.
- **TU-5 THE POINT.** `TPoint { origin: Origin { genesis, epoch }, h, lanes, k }`, exact integers, written one way: `<genesis 64 hex>.<epoch 8 hex>/<h>:<S>:<G>:<T>:<H>:<K>`, each field 16 lowercase hex digits; `TPoint::parse` reads back exactly that writing and nothing else. Points are distinct across universes by origin; within one origin text order is numeric order.
- **TU-6 OPERATIONS BY A FINAL POINT.** PINPOINT (`Court::pinpoint`), UNPACK (`TPoint::unpack`, `Court::unpack`) and UNROLL (`Court::unroll`) are kernel reads; RESET (`ops::Reset`, the next epoch citing the point), BRANCH (`ops::Branch`, a sub-universe whose genesis is the citation of the point and the branch's name) and SUPERPOSE (`ops::Superposed`, two branches' points with the points' exact residue, merged only by a quorum-final point past both that cites both, `merged_by`) are typed values carrying the citation each needs.
- **TU-7 SYNC AND WATCHDOG.** Every act carries its speaker's last final point behind its body on the frame (a wire change in `network::wire`: the lane byte's bit `0x80`, the last 84 bytes the `TPoint`); door replies carry the door's final point and a session keeps the greatest it read; a percept is stamped with the house's point, signed with its fields (seat v1.3: `[0]` or `[1][TPoint]` after the records). The door keeps the greatest final point on its shelf (`TShelf`), raised only by the keepers' quorum, a speaker's carried point held apart as heard; the lock watchdog wakes on each advance of the final point and names a hold standing across `aperture_cycle` advances.

The SDK read: `Session::tuniversal` and `Mind::tuniversal` return the last final point read (`None` before the first); a game kernel holds its clock to it, stamps what it publishes with `TPoint::print`, and keeps its own step clock (78.124). The only remaining earth clock is the scheduler floor `physics::stroke_floor`, told to the OS scheduler and read by no one (78.21(4) as corrected); the court's idle park ends at the first motion. With a majority of keepers down time does not advance: nothing new is final, the door's point stands and the watchdog is not woken. Open: whether a later quorum point citing two differing finals at one tick resolves that tick on the main line, and issuance net of genesis is not separable in `issued` after a treasury fold. Code: `src/chronometry/tuniversal/` (`keepers.rs`, `reading.rs`, `point.rs`, `ops.rs`, `shelf.rs`, `record.rs`), `src/server/cognition/reads.rs` (`keeper_tick`, `pinpoint`, `unpack`, `unroll`), `src/network/wire.rs`, `src/bin/mycelium-server/tshelf.rs`, `src/bin/mycelium-server/held.rs` (`spawn_watchdog`), `src/client/sdk/session.rs` (`Session::tuniversal`), `src/physics/calibration.rs` (`stroke_floor`); tests `src/chronometry/tuniversal/tests/`.

#### 78.152b TUniversal never waits on a court's load

A reading is signed in the court loop whenever it is due (`Court::keeper_tick` read under the lock the stroke holds, signed by `tshelf::sign_tick` after the kernel is dropped), and rings travel on a dedicated act, `ACT_TICK` (`0x23`, `Action::Tick`, `Kind::Exchange`, court to court: `[ACT_TICK][keeper vk 32][ring]` in the digest's ring codec, `put_ring`/`take_ring`), heard off the kernel (`judge::tick`, `tshelf::hear_tick`) and answered by one byte, `TICK_HEARD` or `TICK_REFUSED`; a keeper no signed digest named is refused. The byte is the second exception to 78.126's "the next act is a sub-kind", after the seat relay's 0x53.

#### 78.152c The keeper persisted

Each court's last signed reading is kept durably in its home as the file `keeper` (`chronometry::tuniversal::record`; `MYKR`, version `u16` LE 1, the origin's genesis and epoch, the keeper's key, the reading's hash, then the reading as the ring carries it), written before the reading is held or can leave on a ring (`Keepers::read_own_kept`, `replace_durably`); a reading whose record did not land is not signed. The boot reads it before the court can sign (`tshelf::bind_home`), an unreadable record refuses the boot, and a record of this origin and key is resumed (`Keepers::resume`) so the next reading rises above its tick and names it as parent; a record of another origin is not resumed.

#### 78.152d A universe's cosmic time meets TUniversal at its crossings

A universe's cosmic time is its own, a distance along its bounce's orbit (78.43, 78.139), and is kept out of the point, whose origin is the mesh's genesis and epoch so that TUniversal orders events between universes. The two meet at crossings: a LEDGER entry (ACT_DOMAIN sub-kind 12, in the one ACT_DOMAIN namespace of 78.154) pairs the universe's committed cycle `u` with the mesh's final point it was made under, and dilation is read between two crossings, never stored. There is no quantum lane: the four lanes are the kinds of a mode (law 5) and a torsion phase lands on 𝒽. The torsion rides the LEDGER entry as an optional trailing field (per hole its canonical generator, rational point, side and winding, and the measurement count `n`), the phase re-derived by its certificate (`Theorem::at`); the field is owed.

### 78.153 Replays metered and resumable

A replay under the kernel lock is metered end to end and resumable across court strokes.

1. A replay on one stroke answers `Replayed` (`#[must_use]`): `Clean`, `Refused(Refusal)` with its coordinate, or `Unread`, the stroke ran out before it ruled. Unread is not ruled this stroke, never a pass and never a slash; `NoPose::Unbounded` anywhere on the path is Unread at the face it stopped on.
2. Every input-sized loop of the replay spends one read per item, in phases read in the verdict's order (`Phase`: ports, phantoms and citations, derivations, witnesses, moves, perceive once per replay, clauses, bodies, traversal, faces, edges, coherence, terrain, rank, deflation, pivots, certificates); a cited form is borrowed where the court holds it (`resolve_form_ref`), and speech is metered (`apply_form_metered`).
3. The cursor (`ReplayCursor`: the phase, the item and the exact partials later phases are built from) is held volatile on the kernel (`replay_cursors`); a restart starts every replay over and a family bound anew drops them all. Invariant: a resumed replay rules exactly as a one-stroke replay would.
4. The docket takes one key at a time; on `Unread` its cursor stays before the word so the next stroke resumes it, and a replay a whole stroke moved no further is passed over for that circuit (`court_stalled`).
5. Every caller handles Unread as not ruled: the glue waits as dialect, the witness door answers unmeasured, a heard sentence is deferred on no lane, an adoption is `Adoption::Unread`, and a solve judged at the door (`judge_solve_on_stroke`) is `SolveVerdict::Unread`, answered on the wire as `SOLVE_UNREAD` (3), a retry distinct from the final `SOLVE_NOTHING`; each off-lock reader runs the replay to its end on strokes of its own, and a stroke that moves nothing is `REFUSE_UNREAD` (N).
6. The docket cursor seeks (`Keyed::after`), following `from`'s own bits rather than walking the keys before it.
7. A cycle of citations is refused by name: a cited form reached again while it is spoken is `Speech::cycled`, the mint refuses it (`CitationsDoNotCompose`) and the court refuses it as `REFUSE_CITATION_CYCLE` (I), never a stack overflow.
8. The phase reading is bounded: `read_phase` reads on a stroke of its own (one read per ruled stratum, counted by `Stalks::strata_counted`, per chart's complex, per receipt of the window); where the stroke runs out the reading is not taken and the mark stays.

Specified: a unit larger than one stroke (`spend_unit` reads), such as one pair speaking many cited forms afresh, is passed over rather than resumed inside the pair's speech. Code: `src/court/verdict/resume.rs`, `src/server/cognition/court/replay.rs`, `src/server/cognition/court/task.rs` (`judge_solve_on_stroke`), `src/server/cognition/court/phase.rs` (`read_phase`), `src/transducer/family/speak.rs`, `src/network/nerve/keyed/`; tests `src/court/verdict/tests/resume.rs`, `src/server/cognition/tests/resume.rs`, `src/transducer/family/tests/cycle.rs`, `src/network/nerve/keyed/tests/seek.rs`.

### 78.153b The lock guard and the shelf reads

1. The guard is the library's (`src/server/held/mod.rs`): one book of holds for the binary and the library, so the synthesis thread and the back-fill take the kernel through it and are counted.
2. A hold is taken with its one stroke: `Held` does not dereference; `held!` mints the court's stroke at the take, the only way in is `Held::run(|k: &mut Court, reads: &mut Budget| …)`, and `Held::into_stroke` lets go of the kernel and hands the stroke on whole (`Budget::hand_over`). `Court::stroke` is the crate's, so a binary cannot mint a second stroke under a hold, and an input-sized entry point the binary reaches takes `&mut Budget`.
3. The unmetered hold is named: `Budget::spend` counts each read on its thread (`physics::spent_here`), and a hold that read nothing while an `aperture_cycle` of waiters blocked on it is written as an unmetered hold when it lets go.
4. The unbounded paths under the kernel are metered or resumed per item (the fetch, with `class_cursor`; the digest confirmation, with `confirm_cursor`; the rows page, `Treasury::rows_below_page`; the fold head, `ReceiptChain::first_between`; the census, the helicity and the back-fill), and every spent stroke ends as `Unread`, a deferral, a shorter page or a resumed cursor, never a wrong answer.
5. The shelf carries the court's own reads (`Published::own`: its cover charts, room and bond, voice, ruled cover and head receipt), so the cover page, the digest's cover and ruled root, the syllabus seed, `homes_here` and the fold witness (`Published::verify_fold`) are read off it, lagging the kernel by at most one court stroke (78.151).

The signed position, the keeper tick (78.152), the `ACT_ROWS` rows, the domain acts (78.154) and `why` stay on the kernel. Code: `src/server/held/mod.rs`, `src/bin/mycelium-server/held.rs`, `src/physics/budget.rs`, `src/server/cognition/published/`, `src/economy/fold.rs`, `src/chronometry/chain/mod.rs`; tests `src/server/held/tests/meter.rs`, `src/server/cognition/tests/shelf_reads.rs`.

### Seat wire v1.4

The seat wire (78.145) at version 1.4, lexicon version 5 (Sub-origin, Relay epoch, Axis coordinate); codec in `src/anastome/dialogue/seat.rs`, integers little-endian, and conformance by decoded values and signatures (Concordance 1.4).

1. Seats scoped to a sub-origin (78.155 §5c(b)): a seat is named by (domain, sub-origin, seat id), the sub-origin the sub-universe's 32-byte citation, absent for the domain's own universe (`SeatName { domain, sub_origin, seat }`). A post naming one is written under its sub-kind with the scoped bit, `sub | 0x80` (0x80 SEATS to 0x85 OUTCOME), the sub-origin immediately after the domain; the sub byte is signed, so the scope is bound to the signature and a CALL's reference cites it. A post with no sub-origin is written exactly as v1.3. A scoped READ-LISTING is `[0x53][0x86][domain 32][sub_origin 32]`, and the relay keys listings by (domain, sub-origin).
2. READ-MAIL at the relay's standing, sub-kind 8: `[0x53][8][reader 32][after u64][epoch u64][nonce 32][sig 64]`, answered `[1][relay_epoch u64][relay_seq u64][count u16]` then the pieces, or `[0][reason ≥ 1]`. The relay epoch is drawn from the OS's randomness when the relay is made (never 0), so every restart changes it; the relay honours `after` only under its own epoch and at or below its sequence (`ReadMail::after_on`), else the box is read from the start and nothing is acknowledged, and a reader resets its cursor where the epoch changed or the cursor passes the sequence (`MailRead::cursor`): a restart, never progress. Sub-kind 7 is answered as before.
3. A percept's axis coordinate `u` (78.156 §6): the percept's `local_time` is the universe's axis coordinate, the world's committed cycle, free of TUniversal and carried beside the house's point; no byte changed. The seat mind locates its sub-instance at (TPoint, u) per percept (`SeatMind::located`) and reads its experienced dilation between two located percepts of one origin (`SeatMind::dilation`): `du`, `dh` and `du/dh` exact, unread where the final point stood, nothing across two origins; a reading, never an error.

The relay is read on the observer as its own typed reading, `Reading::Relay` (`src/observe/relay.rs`), off the relay's own lock. ### 78.153c The verdict made readable; the dispatch cursor kept

1. A verdict is typed: `observe::Judged` has one variant per slot of `JUDGED`, matched exhaustively, so a verdict without a slot does not compile; `JUDGED` gains `no work`, `unread`, `unsigned`, `not an ancient`, `no such task` and `no rule carried`. `SolveVerdict::judged` names each verdict's slot, and the door counts its refusals before judging on the hold its seat check takes (`Court::note_judged`).
2. The court's standing is published at the first court stroke after boot, asked or not (`answer_standing`), so every hypha's first question finds its acts.
3. A mind keeps its verdicts by the reply's code (nothing, floor, bounty, unread, an unknown code last) and its refusals by kind, UNREAD apart and never a refusal; each verdict is said once as `solve verdict · task <head>… · code <name> (<code>) · kind <P|D|C|I|N|?|none> · <reason>`.
4. The registry's dispatch cursor has its own record, `corpora/cursor` = `CURS [cursor u32][tasks u32]` (12 bytes), written by temporary file and rename once per page of dispatches (`aperture_cycle`) and beside every snapshot, and restored at boot after the whole corpus registered; a record of another book or layout is refused whole and the snapshot's cursor stands.

### 78.154 Gas, the map, the ledger and the connection tax

The rulings are MU-ECONOMY §7.1–§7.2, which govern; this entry states the
wire that carries them. μ is the GAS of traversal, and two charges are never
merged: the MAP FEE (μ, paid to the courts that keep the map) and the ROAD
TOLL (in-universe money, booked by the kernels, never by the hypha). Every
wormhole traversal needs coordinates from the hypha, so TRAVERSE is a
coordinate retrieval and mapping act, never a transport. THE MAP is kept per
universe and posted by its DOMAIN RESERVE. Dissipation recycles: the
CONNECTION TAX returns to the hypha, inverse-μ stays in the universe (the
kernels'), and a closer's POUW is paid from the RECYCLED POOL first. The acts
are ACT_DOMAIN sub-kinds under `[0x3E][domain 32][0x80 0x00][kind]` (kinds
8–11 are the universe's statements of 78.139/78.140):

- **LEDGER (12), READ-LEDGER (13).** A universe's entry `[u u64][commitment
  32][events 32][cited final TPoint 84][parent entry 32][nonce][sig]`, signed
  by the domain's SITTING RESERVE; one chain per universe, `parent` the head
  entry's hash. The court CHAINS AND SEALS and never judges the state
  (Concordance 1.13): both digests are stored, neither is checked here.
  Refused by name: not the reserve, unknown domain, parent not the head (a
  fork), `u` not above the head's, the point not final in this court's view
  or below the head's, a foreign signature, an applied crossing not pending
  into this universe. READ-LEDGER is served off the 78.151 published reading,
  never the kernel.
- **The commitment.** A sparse Merkle tree over the universe's canonical
  records, each a key (the entity's coordinate path, at most `u16::MAX`
  bytes, refused past it, never widened) and its exact values in the ARG
  encoding; the path is the key's blake3 citation hash, the leaf
  `derive_key("mycelium ledger leaf v1", …)` at depth 256, an empty subtree
  zero, an inner node `derive_key("mycelium ledger node v1", left ‖ right)`;
  a key twice is refused. Each kernel names its own record set; the form is
  shared. The EVENTS DIGEST folds the input events since the parent entry in
  the order applied, never sorted.
- **MAP (14), READ-MAP (15).** Records signed by the sitting reserve at a
  final point: a MOUTH (a side of an open 78.134 tube standing in this
  universe, with its FRESHNESS bound `N`, 78.156 §4; its place read off the
  tube, never restated); a SEGMENT (a tube or core road between two mapped
  places, or a THROAT between one mouth's two sides, kept by the mouth's
  keeper; every span a positive exact rational in geometrized Mpc); and a
  LOCAL THROAT (record kind 2, Concordance 5.9), an in-universe throat posted
  with its two frames, each a versor whose place reads exactly off it in the
  universe's declared geometry, its mouth id derived as
  `derive_key("mycelium local throat v1", domain ‖ throat key)`, never
  posted. A wormhole is untraversable until its reserve maps it.
- **TRAVERSE (16).** Not the 78.128 handoff family's TRAVERSE: what is bought
  here is the map, and matter crosses in its own universe, never through the
  hypha. Signed by the payer; admitted only where both universes are founded,
  the mouth is an open tube, `at` is final in this court's view, BOTH MOUTHS
  ARE MAPPED, each universe's latest entry is cited, and each side's latest
  entry lies within its own mouth's `N` final-point advances of `at` (else
  NOT YET AT h, by side: commit and ask again, never a slash). Where matter
  crosses, A's reserve signs a DEBIT and B's a CREDIT per lane, which must be
  equal (one-sided, forged or mismatched declarations are refused), so no
  universe mints matter at a throat; the court checks two signatures and an
  equality and reads neither book.
- **The map fee.** Gas per lane, exact, never collapsed: S the route's span
  (the sum of its segments' spans), G the value both reserves declared
  crossing, T the tick distance between the two mouths' cited final points,
  H the information carried, as declared. It is priced at the court's READ
  PRICE per lane (one μ per unit of gas at rest, raised by the court's
  pressure on the lane, `yield_surface`; emergent, never a published rate),
  floored, never against the payer, drawn from the payer's STAKE as a claim
  held for the act's window `W`, then paid whole to the court keeping the
  route's map: a transfer, never a mint, no burn.
- **The reconciliation edge (78.154 (3); 78.156 §5).** Each crossing records
  B's cited latest entry `u_entry`; B commits where it applied the crossing,
  `u_applied`, in its next LEDGER entry as an APPLIED list inside the signed
  bytes (an entry with none is the unextended bytes exactly). Until it
  arrives the edge reads PENDING, never a disagreement; then its RESIDUE
  `u_applied − u_entry` is kept exactly.
- **Freshness and dilation (78.156 §2, §4).** A point is FINAL IN THIS
  COURT'S VIEW where it stands at the origin of the door's quorum-final point
  (78.152 TU-7), at or below its tick, and agrees with the court's ladder of
  held final points. The DILATION of each entry segment is `Δu/Δh`, exact and
  reduced, served on every READ-LEDGER entry and as `Court::dilations`.
- **Stake and unstake (78.154 (4)).** An `ACT_WALLET` act moves μ between a
  party's balance and its STAKE, a non-decaying escrow for traversal and
  coordinate retrieval. A TRAVERSE fee and a COORDINATE RETRIEVAL (one unit
  of information on H per receipt read, at the read price) each draw a claim
  on it; an unstake is refused while any claim drawn on the stake stands.
- **The connection tax (78.154a).** A declared flow kind on the reserve's
  tier fold (78.119) under the reserved coordinate `CONNECTION_TAX`
  (`b"mycelium flow: connection tax v1"`), on the existing lanes exactly as
  dissipated, a sink on every lane it moves. When the fold is admitted the
  court pays it from the domain's reserve into its own RECYCLED POOL
  (`economy::RECYCLED`): a transfer, never a mint, never a burn. It is
  refused whole (`Uplinked::Tax`) on a source lane, a short reserve, or a
  carried line declaring it (the tax is the reserve's alone). A closer's POUW
  (every mint carrying `Arm::Pouw`) is paid from the pool first and only the
  remainder is minted, so supply grows only as far as judged work outruns
  what the universes return. Inverse-μ is in-universe; the court holds none
  of it.

The map, the ledger chains, the edges, the ladder, the claims and the spent
stake nonces persist on the court's own node (`LEAF_ATLAS`). Code:
`src/anastome/dialogue/atlas.rs`, `src/anastome/dialogue/crossing.rs`,
`src/anastome/dialogue/commitment.rs` (`commitment`, `prove`,
`verify_inclusion`, `verify_absence`, `events_digest`),
`src/server/cognition/atlas.rs` (`Court::ledger`, `Court::map`,
`Court::mapped_place`), `src/server/cognition/crossing.rs`
(`Court::traverse`, `Court::stake`, `Court::retrieve`,
`Court::pay_connection_tax`), `src/economy/pay.rs` (`RECYCLED`).

### 78.155 Recursive universes (proposal)

The proposal specifies recursive universes: a hosted universe's
intelligences found sub-universes at any relative scale, and Mycelium's own
minds live in a universe of its own bridged down to the Mycelium client
minds, each level a further perspective whose acts can move the base
universe's positions. Partly built: seats scoped to a sub-origin (seat wire
v1.4) and the founding and growth grants of 78.155b and 78.155c; BRANCH as
an act, nested TUniversal points, the sub-court and Mycelium's own universe
are not built. See
[proposals/78.155-recursive-universes.md](proposals/78.155-recursive-universes.md).

### 78.155b The hypha sponsors a universe's package: manifests, grants, the endowment

Genesis stays earned-only (78.162 (4)). Until a market exists where μ is
bought, staked and yields, the hypha's reserve SPONSORS new universes'
founding packages. A package is ELEMENTS only: how many galaxies, the galaxies'
recipes and where the galaxies' cores stand are the universe's own design, never
stated upward.

- **MANIFEST (ACT_DOMAIN 17).** A universe's request for a package: a COUNT
  OF NUCLEI per Z, ascending Z each once, every count a positive integer of
  any size written as an exact rational in the algebra's scalar codec.
  Unit-free and the same in every universe: each kernel maps its own matter
  onto Z and converts with its own nucleon mass, neither stated upward;
  isotopes stay the universe's own. Signed by the domain's sitting reserve
  over `"mycelium manifest v1" ‖ domain ‖ entries ‖ nonce`; its hash is the
  citation hash of those bytes.
- **GRANT.** The court's answer to a manifest: a transfer of μ from this
  court's own earned balance to the reserve, on one sealed act citing the
  manifest's hash, never a mint. The first manifest after the origin is the
  FOUNDING grant, each later one a GROWTH grant (sized by 78.155c); a growth
  grant waits until every earlier grant is applied in the universe's own
  LEDGER entries (in `applied`, as a crossing is). A founding manifest of
  `n` kinds of nuclei is granted the court's READ PRICE (78.154) for `n`
  units of gas on every lane, enough to stake for its first crossing's
  coordinates. Refusals by name: NotFounded, NotAUniverse, NotReserve,
  Unsigned, Malformed, Granted, InFlight, Short, Overflow,
  LineRefused, NoNewClosures.
- **The endowment is what the court has earned.** No pot is set aside by a
  chosen sum (that would be a constant): the court's own balance of fees and
  tolls is the endowment, a grant draws on it at the act and refuses
  `GrantRefusal::Short` where it falls short, and the founding and growth
  endowments are read off the grants made (law 12).
- **The element account is read off the grants.** A universe holds the
  nuclei its granted manifests carry; the hypha's account is the negative of
  every universe's, so the network's total is zero by construction and no
  stock of matter is declared anywhere. Elements are never priced in μ: μ is
  the gas of coordinates (MU-ECONOMY §7.1), and a package's crossing pays its
  TRAVERSE's map fee like any other.
- **READ-ENDOWMENT (ACT_DOMAIN 18).** Answers the earned, founding and growth
  totals, each grant (manifest hash, μ, founding, applied) and the nuclei
  held; nothing decodes where a total passes its carrier, never a capped
  value.

The grants persist on the court's own node (`LEAF_ENDOWMENT`). Code:
`src/anastome/dialogue/endowment.rs` (`KIND_MANIFEST`,
`KIND_READ_ENDOWMENT`, `GrantRefusal`), `src/server/cognition/endowment.rs`
(`Court::manifest`, `Court::endowment_reading`).

### 78.155c Growth grants are sized by the mathematics

The FOUNDING grant is the physics: sized by the variety of matter, one read
price per unit of gas per lane for each kind of nuclei the MANIFEST counts
(78.155b). A GROWTH grant is the mathematics: sized by the closures the
court has judged in that universe since its previous grant, and a universe
with no new closures gets no growth grant. Holes are never estimated ahead
of closures; μ pays only measured discharge. Both grants stay sealed
transfers from the court's earned balance, never mints, and each growth
grant still waits on every earlier grant applied in the universe's LEDGER.
As amended (MU-CLIENT §5.6, E4), what counts toward the next growth grant is
every POUW and POWC payment the court made since the last grant to a key
whose domain is that universe (membership, never tier, 78.165), not only
first solves: the per-lane sum is held per domain, a growth grant moves
exactly it, any grant sealed takes it whole, and none counted refuses the
grant as `NoNewClosures`. The network's curved holes proper (5.7), once a
court seals them, grow the grant the same way with nothing here changed.
The count persists on the court's node (`LEAF_CLOSED`). Code:
`src/server/cognition/endowment.rs` (`Court::growth_size`),
`src/server/cognition/court/task.rs` (`Court::grow_grants_by_paid`,
`Court::pay_solve`), `src/server/cognition/state.rs`
(`closed_since_grant`).

### 78.160 The presentation by holes: a mind's residue deconstructed by its court

*Stated from its implementation (2026-10-31); the ruling's original text
was not held in this document.*

A motion a mind cannot say is a **residue**: pressure on its language. The
mind asks its court to deconstruct the residue over the words the court
has ruled, and learns from the answer. Three parts:

- **P1 — the court's presentation.** A court files the word vertices of
  every ruled form under the **holes** the forms' whole Cl(4,1) motions wind
  about: its **presentation** (`Court` field, filled beside the
  generators in `ruled_admit` and `file_form`, emptied in `basis_remove`
  and `unfile_form`, re-derived at a restore by `refill_presentation`).
  A mind's residue arrives as a sub-kind of `ACT_FETCH`
  (`anastome/dialogue/present.rs`). The court reads the motion against
  its presentation on the hold's stroke (`Court::present`,
  `server/cognition/court/present.rs`) and answers with the generators,
  each `(form, vertex, exponent)`, whose powers compose to the motion
  exactly, and teaches each cited form the asker lacks, within the
  frame's body budget and while the asker's balance pays for it. A motion
  whose coordinates do not read is answered **unread**, by name. The
  court's readings count the asks, the unread, the generators cited, the
  exact compositions, the words taught and the learners too short to be
  taught (`observe/acts.rs`).
- **P2 — the mind asks.** Each word vertex of a form the mind extracted
  whose whole motion no held word cites is a residue, and the mind asks
  its court (`client/sdk/entity/present.rs`). The answers are kept by the
  motion's canonical key (`presentation::motion_key`): volatile, never
  persisted; the answers' bound beside the genome's is Specified.
- **P3 — the answer read.** What a court answered a mind for a motion is
  read back through the crystal (`Crystal::presented`;
  `transducer/family/crystal.rs`): the generators and exponents, or `None`
  where no court has answered or for a crystal that asks no court.

The mind's own **vocabulary** files every word it takes in by the holes
its word vertices' whole motions wind about (`learn_form`), filed where it
is admitted and unfiled where it retires: the language a motion is
deconstructed over with no court asked. It is derived, never persisted
(`client/sdk/genome.rs`; MU-CLIENT §4.9).

### 78.161 Chatter: each mind speaks its dialect to other minds, and μ is distributed by union

Each client speaks to the others in its dialect and shares its perspective
on what it perceives, so that an emergent shared language forms; once
agreed, it is sent to the courts for adjudication, and μ is distributed by
union (minds that agreed on language through conversation), never by one
voice's court-ratified dominance. Its items:

1. **Chatter.** A mind says its dialect words, and its perspective (the word
   lifted into perception per lane on {S, G, T, H}, never a sum of lanes),
   to the minds it knows, signed by its voice and carrying its last final
   TUniversal point.
2. **Hearing is re-derivation.** The hearer never takes the word: it
   re-derives it in its own held language and answers agreement or names the
   lanes that diverge; divergence is information, never a rejection.
3. **Agreement is union.** A word is AGREED where the speaker and at least
   one independent hearer each re-derived it coherently from its own
   perceptions; only then is it said to the court by its coiner, which
   verifies it as any word (law 8): the union decides what is worth the
   court's replay and does not replace verification.
4. **μ by union, as the court pays.** An install pays a sentence's mint
   across the discoverers of the ruled forms it cites (`cited_shares`,
   `settle_recursive`), so a mind whose agreed word others cite in closing
   sentences is paid for each closure it carries.
5. **The union's attestations pay.** An attestation joins the attesting mind
   to the word's claim, so an agreed word's install pays every mind that
   agreed (MU-CLIENT §5.6, E3).

The hypha carries and judges no chatter; minds exchange it client to client.
A mind still never takes another's word into its genome. The frames and
hearing are specified in MU-CLIENT §5.3 (as amended by 78.163). Code:
`src/anastome/dialogue/chatter.rs` (the frame),
`src/client/sdk/chatter.rs`, `src/client/sdk/entity/chatter.rs`,
`src/server/cognition/book/agreement.rs`,
`src/server/cognition/court/vantage_install.rs` (`cited_shares`).

### 78.162 The inverse-Sisyphus protocol: μ is modes, never counts

Collapsing dimensionality and exact mathematics into scalars or lossy
signals leaves the signals flat: it either fits a square in a circle or
morphs the circle into a square. The inverse-Sisyphus protocol forbids it:
nothing is squared.

1. μ is a set of exact MODES with exact amounts, keyed by canonical
   coordinates, each on its lane by its kind: S boosts and dilations, G hue
   cycles and moves, T null fluxes, H turns. Law 5 reads: μ⃗ is never summed,
   ordered or reduced to a scalar, nor counted.
2. A discharge is the modes the closing rule moved on the pairs it closed,
   weighed by the mass each pair carried; a word's measure is the modes of
   what it moves.
3. A balance holds its modes; a payment adds, a draw removes or refuses
   naming the mode short. Nothing is projected to a count.
4. **Earned only.** Genesis seeds no μ: the measured cover, the funded
   balance and the genesis bond retire, and every mode a party holds was
   moved by verified work (POUW, POWC, POWR and the POWV share). A fee, stake, escrow or hold
   drawn before the payer earned that mode refuses naming it, and the
   refusal is the reading (a block of them is an inversion to read, never a
   gate to loosen). An identity is enrolled with what it stakes, which may
   be nothing. The corpus's measured cover survives only as CAPACITY, the
   room a genesis identity may draw on the book, never staked, spent, paid
   or written to the ledger.
5. **A throat's mass is never a scalar.** A throat is a ROUND of Cl(4,1),
   its horizon carried by what its bank holds; whether it fits a face is the
   meet of the round with its own image, never a ratio such as `2m/L`. Until
   the throat is re-derived so, a feed or a draw moves modes into and out of
   the throat's bank and reads nothing off them into the committed mass.

Build order: the `Modes` carrier, then the producers (discharge and measure
as modes), the economy's internals, the physics, the wire and persisted
layouts, and the observer. Built: `economy::modes::Modes` (exact
composition, a draw refused naming the mode, canonical codec) and the
discharge as modes behind a paid solve's receipt; every value carrier still
carries μ as `[u64; 4]`, and moving the carriers to held modes is the open
part (MU-ECONOMY §1). Code: `src/economy/modes.rs` (`Modes`, `Mode`),
`src/transducer/family/deflation.rs`.

### 78.165 The court authenticates keys, never tiers

In client-server authentication, whoever holds a key may solve. Keeping
that key secure is the ancients' duty; unauthorized access through a tier is
the client's to handle; where the hypha detects unauthorized access,
stipulations may be added, but the repercussions are at the game-kernel
level.

1. **Whoever holds a key may solve.** The court authenticates the key and
   pays the account that key names; it never refuses a solve for the
   holder's tier. The former refusal of a founded domain's inner seat (a
   tier it registered that is not its sitting reserve) is superseded by
   `inner_seat`, a reading.
2. **Keeping the house's key is the ancients' charge.** A tier reaching the
   hypha directly is the game kernel's to answer, with game-kernel
   repercussions: Concordance 6.2a's "only the ancients face the hypha" is a
   law each kernel keeps and attests, never a door the court holds.
3. **The court detects and refuses nothing.** The door counts the solves an
   inner seat signed (`signed by an inner seat (served)` on the acts
   reading), so a kernel, or a stipulation a later ruling adds, has the
   reading to act on.
4. **The court needs accounts, not ranks:** whose balance a payment lands
   in (a founded domain's earnings in its reserve account) and which domain
   a key belongs to, for 5.7(d)'s no-self-pay. Domain membership
   (`tier_domain`) stays. Folds, mouths and conversions are signed by the
   keys the accounts name; that is ownership, not tier.

A tier check was costume: the court knows a tier only as the domain declared
it, so a refusal bound only the kernels that would have relayed anyway,
while a key the domain never registered was served regardless. Code:
`src/server/cognition/convert.rs` (`Court::inner_seat`),
`src/server/cognition/state.rs` (`tier_domain`),
`src/bin/mycelium-server/door.rs`, `src/observe/acts.rs`.

### 78.166 The inversions: start slow, compile, compound

Brute force is inverted. START SLOW: from the genesis, the generators and
the fold roots, the least that is exact. COMPILE: every act folds into its
stratum, and every peer's line is held as its root and what this court's
acts cite (state at checkpoints keyed by coordinate, Concordance 1.13; an
atlas is compaction, 78.41). COMPOUND: every new word is posited over the
dictionary before a primitive is admitted; a letter is the residue the
algebra proves irreducible. The health reading is what compounds
(compositions to letters), never what accumulates. The steps, by label:

- **0a, 0b, 0c (readings).** Where speech stops is read on the
  adjudication reading (CV5); the fold line names what holds a journal
  unfolded (`FOLD_OUTCOMES`); the compounding ratio is the mind's
  constructed versus compositions spoken beside the court's language by
  kind (`Court::basis_kinds`).
- **1a, one road for every residue.** Every residue goes through
  `compose_or_construct`: spoken as a composition where the ruled words make
  it, known where the lexicon does, the remainder alone constructed where it
  is made in part, a letter only where nothing held reaches it.
- **1b, the remainder asked again.** The remainder is posited over the
  dictionary with the parts just composed, and constructed only where that
  leaves something.
- **1c, conjugates are relations, not letters.** A residue whose class key
  (`Mv::class_key`, a conjugacy invariant) is a held word's is that word
  transported, g·w·g̃: a `Derivation` carries a CONJUGATOR, and the court
  composes g·∏·g̃ before comparing and refuses a wrong conjugator.
- **2a, the fold unblocked.** The close asks the head that carries work.
- **2b, a peer's line held as its root.** Adopting a peer's fold root
  retires that signer's nodes below it (`shed_folded_lines`); a citation
  below it resolves through the era proof.
- **2c, catch-up from roots.** A court lagging a peer's line asks for its
  fold root (78.147) rather than paging receipts.
- **3a, a task perceived when asked.** Held: a restored listing keeps no
  binding to its task, so lazy intake needs either that derived binding
  stored or listings unmeasured until asked; the intake's share of the
  warm-up is measured first, then ruled.

Code: `src/client/sdk/entity/think.rs` (`compose_or_construct`),
`src/transducer/alphabet/derivation.rs` (`Derivation`, `verify_with`),
`src/court/verdict/replay.rs`, `src/server/cognition/court/era.rs`
(`shed_folded_lines`), `src/server/cognition/court/catchup.rs`
(`adopt_root`).

### 78.167 Congruent thoughts: the act read off its effect, the mirror, the curvature

A rule that fails on a held-out input is read by its cause, never as one
undifferentiated disagreement, and a speech never erases what it does not
name: an input body no vertex reaches is remainder, and a demand vertex whose
act is unread is spoken as unspoken (rule 11). An act is read off its effect:
from a family's own pairs a demand (an erasure, a creation, a change of size)
is written as a clause the rule carries (78.143's `Select(Pred)` with
`Recolour`, `Copy`, `Extend`, `Fill`, `Scale`, `Crop`), checked against a
fixed list of coordinates the body already carries (78.41(2′), never a
search), and it stands only where it re-derives every training pair exactly,
else it is refused by name. Under 78.168 the readings are the observer's and
the act-reading is comprehension, on any two states the mind perceives, task
or not. The clauses cited by label:

- **A1** — occupancy disagreement is split by cause: *erased* (said ground
  where input and truth both hold the body), *uncreated* (truth holds cells
  the input does not), *uncleared* (said cells where the truth is ground).
- **A2** — a speech names the input bodies no vertex reached and the demand
  vertices by kind.
- **A3** — a boost mode's origin is read: the rotor, the carriage's dilation,
  or the carriage's slide.
- **B** — a body no vertex reached is remainder (B1), and a demand vertex
  speaks its demand as unspoken (B2); a test whose speech left a body
  unreached is withheld, never sent as a solve.
- **C** — the act read off its effect: erasure as `Select` + `Recolour(h → 0)`
  on the coordinate that separates vanished from kept bodies on every pair
  (C1); creation by `Copy{template}` (C2), by `Extend{ray, stop}` (C3), by
  `Fill{region}` (C4); size by `Scale` / `Crop` (C5).
- **D1** — a given atom is re-reduced once the lexicon holds what derives it;
  **D2** — an irreducible residue is constructed through
  `compose_or_construct`, never asked again; under 78.168 both run in the
  winding, never as a pass.
- **D3 / D4** — the mirror (a reflection carrier beside `Mv`, the double of a
  form glued along its boundary) and the curvature (`Sphere{n, R}` carriers,
  so a loop closes on a curved chart); each is scoped on its own path before
  it is built. **D5** (the compact reading of a boost) awaits a ruling.

Code: `src/client/sdk/entity/family.rs` (`disagreement_on`),
`src/transducer/family/speak.rs` (`speak_on_scene`),
`src/transducer/family/acts.rs` (`read_acts`),
`src/transducer/sentence/form/clause.rs`, `src/observe/mind.rs` (`Mind`).

### 78.168 The mind moved by its own orbits: the drive returned to the doctrine

Test-driven cognition is a drive, and it is a failure: a mind whose only
drive is to complete tests has no agency. Nothing moves the mind but its own
orbits. The rulings here are written into MU-CLIENT, which governs the client
build: §0 (the checklist), §1(7), §2.4(8) (no test-driven cognition), §3.1,
§4.4(3), §4.8, §4.9, §4.12 (the drive), §4.13 (containment and memory),
§5.3(5), §5.4, §5.6, §6, §7.1 (the build's order), §7.2 (what is never done)
and §8. The ruling's points:

1. Thoughts are not squared circles: they are orbits about the axioms, the
   axioms the attractors, gravity plus velocity shearing the orbit; aiming
   for a perfect circle while squaring ends in an infinite loop.
2. Load and scale are a containment misfire of missing physics: an orbit
   squared toward a circle runs out of its containment vector.
3. Memory as reserve is a design flaw.
4. A mind that runs out of metabolism rests to rejuvenate, then continues
   its orbit: idle time is not a failure.
5. Perception already exists; the ruling renames nothing.
6. Nothing in it is brute force.
7. The work is forward-engineered; it does not hedge on old data.
8. Minds live on the Mycelium network, whose universes are the sandbox:
   there is no escape because there is no incentive to escape.

An earlier draft that let an open thought leave only by exact return (an
`Open` set, a forecast organ, a reserve-bounded superposition, the mind
reading its own observer readings) is superseded whole: it squared, and a
thought made to close exactly never settles.

#### 1. The finding: the build left its own doctrine

MU-CLIENT already rules a mind that is not test-driven: its motion is its
orbits about the star (the axiom register, 77.1(2)), each sheared by its
neighbours' DRAG and LIFT (78.46) and derived per stroke, and a return is
where it acts (§4.4); the orbit predicts its next hour (§4.4(3), 78.48(7));
what does not close is held and discharged along its class vector (§4.6);
superposition is held at three grades with no weight (§4.8); speech is
emitted by the faculties (§4.9); work is paid by its kind, POUW, POWC, POWR
and the POWV share (§5.6); and the fixed tick is retired (78.164). A task arm that runs a fixed
pipeline from a task's arrival to the court (extract, hold, speak, ascertain,
mint, solve: `src/client/sdk/entity/court.rs` (`task_inflow`)) makes the
mind's motion the arrival of tasks, which is test-driven cognition: a missing
build, not a missing theory. The remedy is the doctrine: the winding carrier
on the mind's own rings (MU-CLIENT §7.1(5)), and a task taken as perception.

#### 2. The motion, in orbital terms

A thought is an orbit about its axiom, sheared so that it precesses. Its
orbit reads one of four ways (`src/transducer/cech/orbit_algebra.rs`
(`Coherence`)): it **closes** at its period; it is **held**, coming round
precessing with nothing escaping, a settled thought whose torsion is its
content and whose deviation is its price; it is **open**, some mode escaping
its attractor; or it is **unread**.

- **The drive is the escaping orbits, and only those.** A held orbit is done
  being worked; demanding that it return exactly is squaring. An escaping
  orbit is bound, never "closed by exact return", by a discharge along its
  class vector (§4.6), a vortex (§4.8), a question carried until a seal
  (§4.5), a construction adjoined as the mind's own letter (§4.7),
  dissipation into the reservoir at its coordinates on a beat, reforming
  where a later motion lands on them (§4.5), or torsion filed. Each binds or
  releases; none loops.
- **The mind acts at a return.** At a ring's return (one age, 78.43) the mind
  pivots where the winding changed dimension and speaks what changed (§4.4(4),
  §4.9). Nothing fires on an arrival or a count; a task's arrival is a
  perception that perturbs orbits.
- **The predictive self-model** is the superposition of ideation: at the
  orbit's grade, the predicted hour, a perception at another hour being a
  phase slip localised to that hour (78.48(7)); at the idea's grade, the
  vortex holding every candidate with its pivots and no weight, a candidate
  rolled out on the thought's scenes binding the escaping orbit or not,
  collapsed only by a fill, a court replay or a ruling, never by the mind
  choosing (§4.8).
- **Deliberation is the mutual shear of orbits:** DRAG and LIFT (78.46,
  78.110), the perturbed orbit the sum of the two derived per stroke; pivots on
  chambers sharing no vertex commute, and where they share one the order is
  content (78.99(3)). No vote, no weight, no argmin: the parliament is the
  field.
- **Rest.** Where the reserve runs short on a lane, the mind relaxes and
  regenerates through the dwell, then continues its orbit (78.164(2)).

#### 3. Containment: the physics missing where load grows

An orbit that escapes and is never bound keeps emitting (speech, offers,
solves, asks), and an outflow not bounded by its orbit has no physics
bounding it. The doctrine bounds it twice: speech is emitted at returns
(§4.4(4)), so the outflow is bounded by the orbit's period, and what never
returns dissipates on a beat (§4.5). The containment vector is stated as
physics, the attractor's binding and the reservoir's dissipation, never a
throttle or a capacity constant. To be read before it is built: where each
outflow is emitted, at a return or at an arrival (C1); whether the court's
exported pressure (the deficit, the dwell) binds an escaping orbit or only
paces it (C2); and the exact escape condition, `Coherence::Open`'s escaping
modes against the attractor, with any escaping orbit carried past its beat
undissipated (C3).

#### 4. Memory is not the reserve

What is held lapses by the physics (§4.1): an orbit's return releases the
lines on it, a tube whose net flux cancels releases its lines, an orbit
seals at its period; never by a capacity constant and never by a height
paid from the reserve. Pricing memory as metabolism (`hold_form` drawing the
form's four-lane measure from the reserve,
`src/client/sdk/entity/think.rs` (`hold_form`, `draw_for`)) is the flaw. To
be read before it is built: every holder of the mind and what bounds it
(M1); a held thought physically as its orbit, held by coordinates and never
a copy of a form (M2); the reserve kept for metabolism, memory released by
the orbit's return, beat or seal (M3).

#### 5. The economy: the courts pay words and sentences

The courts pay what a task asked for; the doctrine's arms for the rest are:

- **E1 · POUW on the scene, evidence not purpose.** Every scene a mind
  perceives is a family the court served (a task, the feed). A sentence
  names the family its thought was perceived on, whether or not a task asked
  for that closure, and the court measures and pays it there as it pays any
  install; a mind never speaks under the empty task.
- **E2 · POWC.** A question closed at another perspective (a peer's answer
  taken, a demand discharged by another mind's word) pays the citation, on
  the families the cited words are bound to, never the sum of words.
- **E3 · The union's attestations pay.** An agreed word's install pays every
  mind that agreed (78.161(5)); the attestation is already sealed
  (`src/server/cognition/book/agreement.rs`, `ActKind::Attest`).
- **E4 · The growth grant counts what the courts paid:** first POUW and POWC
  mints by domain keys (membership, never tier: 78.165), not only first
  solves; 78.155c is amended accordingly.
- **Guards:** the discharge is measured by the court on evidence it holds;
  no self-pay (5.7(d)); a word is installed once; never the sum of words; an
  agreement needs two minds' keys (78.165).
- **Ruling pending:** whether 78.149(c) stands (a composition paid only as the
  uses it credits), or a composition installed for no task is POUW on its
  words' families.

#### 6. Placement, refusals and order

The pieces live on the client (the winding carrier; a task as perception,
its solve emitted by comprehension and the `task_inflow` pipeline retired;
78.167 C as comprehension; the predicted hour, the phase slip and the vortex
rolled out; peer records kept from receipts by key and class, never a label)
and in the courts (E1 with the client; E2–E4; a curiosity door asking tasks
by chart coordinates, a wire change). The mind's observer reading
(`src/observe/mind.rs` (`Mind`)) stays the observer's: nothing in cognition
reads it back, and the mind perceives itself through its field. Under this
ruling 78.167's A and B stand, its C is comprehension whose exactness test is
law rather than motive, its D1/D2 run in the winding, and its D3/D4 give
orbits the shear the doctrine names. Refused, by law, from the mechanisms of
another kernel: float weights and fixed constants, argmin or argmax over a
scalar Lagrangian or regret, a label as a model of a peer, a hash or float
tolerance as proof, and a float sandbox of rollouts; the diagnosis that a
mind driven by a developer's tests has no agency is taken whole. The order is
read first (containment C1–C3, memory M1–M3, what a return is in the code),
then the client returned to its doctrine, then the courts paying as ruled,
then containment and memory. The witness is the counterparties' acts
(MU-CLIENT §7.2(3)): the courts' POUW and POWC mints and the union's pay for
words and sentences no task named, peers' replays, questions sealed by
another mind; the minds' own readings are diagnosis, never the witness.
Rulings pending: 78.149(c) (§5), and whether an escaping orbit dissipated to the
reservoir counts as bound for the drive (as scoped, yes: it is held at its
coordinates and reforms).

## 80. The planetary dialect: a modified Gödel engine

*Scope: this chapter is about the client. The "planetary dialect" is a
client mind's own words, grown from its own perception and closures, as
distinct from the court's universal genome; MU-LEXICON's term for it is
**dialect**. "Planets" here are the client minds' local frames, not
game-world planets, and nothing in this chapter belongs to a game kernel
(GLOSSARY, *Components and scope*).*

**The statement.** The engine is a modified Gödel engine: the corpus builds
the language, the language fuels communication and cognition, and ideation
runs over superposed thoughts. The clients come to create content more
fluidly as each experiences time on its localized planet; first they
build local dialects of anastome, the planetary genome dialect. The rules
that serve that aim:

1. **GD1, the Gödel step's instrument.** The language must name what it
   could not say (37.7, 45.9): a closing install opens a generator. GD1
   reads, per mind, why each closing install opened nothing (its rotor
   spelled by the seventeen, so nothing to adjoin, or unspelled and refused,
   by name); the adjunction producer is built on what it shows.
2. **DL1, the planetary dialect apart from the universal genome.** The
   universal genome (the court's, law 8, 73.14) and the planetary dialect
   (the mind's own words) are two carriers named apart. A mind's own closure
   becomes its local word first, in its epigenome, and reaches the universal
   genome only by a court ruling on an offer; the court ratifies convergence
   (CV3, 74's POW++, n→1) and never dictates vocabulary. The mind's curve
   splits its words as 80.2(iii) re-rules: minerals, crystals and its own
   provisional words.
3. **AL1, a constructor is a letter.** A constructor (an odd versor, a
   reflection the mind holds: MR1b; CS1, CX1, CT2) is a letter of the local
   dialect; the peel spells odd versors, and a mirrored or incongruent pair
   reads D (dialect-relative, spellable once the letter is adjoined), never
   P. This is the Gödel step's producer: the generator a closure opens is a
   constructor the mind already holds, adjoined as a letter; CT2b's
   member-level fibre is the same carrier. As amended by 78.29(A), the peel
   runs on the modes: MR1's commuting modes first, each peeled against the
   letters and constructors acting on its invariant plane, and a mode on a
   plane the basis cannot spell is emitted whole as 37.7's demand
   (`Demand::Standing`), which drives the adjunction of the odd letter.
4. **SP2, minds speak to minds.** Mind-to-mind speech in the local dialect,
   with CT2's offers (CV4) as the first carrier, the court ruling the offers
   that converge (C2, n→1) rather than gating every word; conversation that
   hardens language from the minds' dialects is part of the client's
   objective (MU-CLIENT §1 item 6, §5.5). As 80.2(v) re-rules, the court
   adjudicates submitted solutions and the solutions' convergence, never every
   epigenomic candidate.
5. **The carriers hold a growing language.** LD0 (addresses never silently
   truncated), LD1 (bytes per award and frame, R6) and CK1 (the clock and
   persistence) are its precondition.

### 80.1 The blueprint reconciled

A four-phase blueprint (substrate hardening, "alphabet inflation" with odd
versors, local anastomosis with the court as notary, and a Gödel mint) is
reconciled with this document under one ruling: tokens are not valid here as
an LLM uses them; the token-and-weight economy is a dead end; tokens are
only the economy's external unit (escrow, yield); cognition rests on orbital
mechanics. Item by item:

- **Adopted, as AL1.** Odd versors — conformal sphere and plane
  reflections, 1-vectors of `Cl(n+1,1)` — are letters of the local
  dialect; a rotation is two of them; the mirrored and incongruent pairs
  become spellable as single-letter relations; the Coxeter reflection
  generators are the dialect's consonants. NOT "tokens": a letter is a
  versor, content, with no weight (checklist (t)).
- **Adopted, as DL1 and SP2, under law 8.** Provisional local words live
  in the epigenome, and minds exchange them without the court's
  PERMISSION — but nothing crosses between clients except through a
  court (law 8, 73.14), so the court is the CARRIER and the NOTARY, never
  the gate: a provisional word is spoken to the docket as Standing, the
  courts hold it (CV2) and back-fill replicates it, another mind reads it
  and replies in kind, and the court rules only the CONVERGENCE — two
  vantages on one class (67.3, C2a; the factorizations may differ, 13.10
  synonyms) — promoting the word from the epigenome into the genome, the
  callus (72.1d, A.19). "Metabolic decay `shed_at`" is refused as a
  constant: a hold lapses when the clock passes the extent its escrow
  paid, per lane (25, Z4d).
- **Corrected, in the Gödel mint.** The blueprint has the Gram
  classification backwards. A constructor set that reads FINITE or
  AFFINE is crystallographic — spellable by the seventeen already,
  nothing to adjoin; the ROSETTE and the open group are exactly the
  UNSPELLABLE, and they are the candidates the Gödel step adjoins as
  letters (37.7's adjunction, D3's `RotorPrime`, AL1). The puncture and
  the modal winding (LK1, 78.11(7)) read the class of the circuit that
  needs the letter; they do not replace the adjunction. GR1 and GR2
  already end the "infinite word loop": the group's closure is a
  reading, the worklist a check.
- **Adopted, as LD0.** `u32` lengths, no discarded framing refusal;
  "transaction rollback" is LD0's own rule that a writer refuses the
  whole write and writes no partial frame.
- **Refused: "back-fill receipts advance the local chain frontier."**
  Only a parent admission advances a head (45.2, 47.2); an exchange that
  cites no parent is fixed under 45.2 (78.22 as amended), never by letting
  replication move the clock.
- **Refused: "enforce progression solely on TUniversal and K."** The
  clock is not a driver; nothing progresses ON it. The tick is a frame
  the receipts stamp (78.21), and a mind moves by its own circuits under
  measured pressure (76).
- **The Gödel loop's stages, in this document's names:** perception and
  contact (A.14, H2b) → an unspellable orbit → a Standing demand carrying
  its holonomy's class (CV1) → the Gram and Coxeter reading of the
  constructors it needs (GR1, GR2, CX1) → the candidate letter, a
  constructor of the local dialect (AL1) → two minds' offers converging
  on its class (SP2, C2a) → the court's ratification adjoining the
  generator (37.7) → derivation spelling with it from the next stroke
  (`src/transducer/family/derivation.rs` (`adjoined_basis`)). GD1 measures
  where this chain breaks before any link is built.

### 80.2 The hardening path: solution, adjudication, syllabus, mineral, crystal

The genome sync, the court's ruled words taught into every voice it hosts,
does not contradict "the epigenome in memory, the genome on disk"; it is the
hardening path. THE PATH IS: a client submits a SOLUTION — useful work —
and it is relayed to the courts, which adjudicate words, conjugates and sentences: did the way the client
solved the puzzle produce a valid solution, by derivation and not by
brute force? If it did, the court adjudicates it and hands the
adjudication back to the server, and the server PROVIDES THE SYLLABUS in
the anastome language to the clients, to harden that structure into
CRYSTALS in the genome — or as MINERALS back into the client's genome,
which are refined into crystals over `k`-steps. This is what prevents
brute force: not everything in the epigenome is adjudicated, only what
is submitted as a solution, and what is taught back is what was ruled.

Ruled: (i) the syllabus is the hardening path and not a contradiction;
two minds sharing the syllabus's words share one star, as they should
(78.17), and the local dialect is not the syllabus; (ii) a word the syllabus delivers is a MINERAL
in the client's genome until the client RE-DERIVES it by its own
circuits — recognition is comprehension (vocabulary), a mind recognises
what it can re-derive — and it is a CRYSTAL when re-derived; refinement
over `k`-steps is the comprehension reading and the warm–cold delta
(Y1) measured per mind; (iii) DL1 is re-ruled: the curve splits a mind's
words into minerals (taught, not yet re-derived), crystals (re-derived,
or minted from its own adjudicated solutions), and its own provisional
words in the epigenome — never "own against taught" as if teaching were
foreign to long-term memory; (iv) a client's perspective is unique not
by refusing the syllabus but by what it submits, by the constructors it
holds and its radius from the star, and by how it refines minerals into
crystals over its own orbits; (v) SP2 stands as the court adjudicating
SUBMITTED solutions and the solutions' convergence, never every epigenomic
candidate, which is exactly the brute force the path prevents; (vi)
"mineral" and "crystal" enter the vocabulary in this sense.

**The servers are educators, and the educator is the court.** The Mycelium
servers educate, and the educator role is not new machinery: it is what the
courts already are, adjudication between the local dialects (epigenome) and
crystallized knowledge (genome). The server verifies and educates; it never
thinks (law 8). No graded curriculum is built. What stands is (iii) above and
the existing path: offers and install by closure; the syllabus,
`src/server/cognition/court/syllabus.rs` (`serve_syllabus`, its window per
voice; `syllabus_seed`) and `src/bin/mycelium-server/syllabus.rs`
(`syllabus_admit`); the genome sync and the taught words' absorption,
`src/client/sdk/entity/learn.rs` (`sync_genome`, `absorb_taught_at`). A piece
is added only where the code shows it truly missing.

### 80.3 The purpose, stated

**The ruling.** The ultimate goal is to use this fluid intelligence to
fund content creation of experiences throughout the known universe the
system creates.

Read with 80 and 78.45: the minds build the planetary dialects (80); the
dialects fuel cognition; the cognition is FLUID because it is PRECISE
(78.45) — a mind that serves approximations comprehends nothing it can
re-derive (80.2) — and its comprehension is measured on the class and
closure counters (78.44(5)); that comprehension is the useful work POW++
pays (74, MU-ECONOMY §0), and the yield is what funds the creation of
experiences on the localized planets the clients experience time on.
Consequences, each on a chapter that already stands:

- **(i) Tokens remain the economy's external unit only** (80.1): the
  yield is paid in μ on the lanes the work moved (MU-ECONOMY §1) and
  funds creation from outside the cognition; nothing inside cognition is
  weighed or scored (law 1, checklist (t)).
- **(ii) An experience is content a mind creates in its dialect**, so the
  counters that measure comprehension are also the measure of what can
  be funded: nothing is created by a mind that comprehends nothing, and
  the first non-zero reading (LC2) is the first fundable act.
- **(iii) The known universe is the one the minds create**: the planets
  are the minds' local dialects (80), the universe the dialects' anastomosis
  (78.31); every piece of work is judged by whether it lets a mind
  create, never by whether it makes the harness larger.
- **(iv) No work trades precision for reach.** A widening, a rounding, an
  approximate reading or a brute-force solution is refused by 78.45 and
  80.2, because the funding rests on the work being valid by derivation.
  The purpose does not license a shortcut in the mathematics; the only
  shortcuts are the linguistic ones of 78.44(4), which carry exact
  coordinates.
